source: 真题例句整理自 懒笔记 english-exam.lazynote.cn

section.en: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?
section.zh: 为何水石书店要将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍移至其相关分类区域？
section.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

section.en: Comprising artists Mark Boyle and Joan Hills and their children, they recreated random sections of the British landscape on gallery walls.
section.zh: 该艺术组合由艺术家马克·博伊尔、琼·希尔斯夫妇及其子女组成，他们在画廊的墙壁上随机重现了英国 landscape 的局部景致。
section.src: 2014 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

would.en: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
would.zh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
would.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

would.en: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
would.zh: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉姆斯（Eric Williams）发起的银色房间街头派对（Silver Room Block Party）宣布，该活动将不会在2024年回归。
would.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

following.en: Which of the following is suggested for libraries in the last paragraph?
following.zh: 最后一段对图书馆提出了下列哪项建议？
following.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

following.en: Which of the following is one cause of the disruptions in the network?
following.zh: 下列哪项是导致网络中断的原因之一？
following.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

author.en: What was the author commissioned to do about English public libraries?
author.zh: 作者被委派就英国公共图书馆开展什么工作？
author.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

author.en: A children's author and poet who had become a keen amateur photographer, Peters watched the butterflies and idly wondered if he could capture them in flight.
author.zh: 彼得斯是一位儿童文学作家兼诗人，同时也是一位热忱的业余摄影师。他观察着蝴蝶，随意地想着能否捕捉到它们飞行的瞬间。

accord.en: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations.
accord.zh: 根据我们的研究，25%的受访者已决定在组织内彻底禁止使用人工智能，或对其使用进行规范。
accord.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

accord.en: According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems.
accord.zh: 研究显示，英国约有五分之一的劳动者将人工智能视为朋友，并向其寻求个人和职场问题的建议。
accord.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

less.en: When you find yourself taking a situation personally, try to think of other interpretations that are less focused on you — especially in the sense of saying anything deep or fundamental about you.
less.zh: 当你发现自己对某种情况过于敏感、认为是在针对自己时，试着去寻找其他不那么以你为中心的解释——特别是要意识到，这件事并不代表对你个人深度或本质上的定性。
less.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

less.en: Our data shows that engaging with AI like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated.
less.zh: 我们的数据表明，像这样与人工智能互动，可以让我们感到被倾听，并减少孤独感。
less.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

writing.en: We are living through a golden age of science writing, so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery.
writing.zh: 我们正生活在科普写作的黄金时代，这些作品清晰易懂，即便是外行读者也能领略科学发现中那不可预知的魅力。

writing.en: O'Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the "emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children's writing" and that they were "more resilient in their writing, more hopeful".
writing.zh: 奥汉隆表示，她最惊讶的是“[目标]儿童作品中展现出的情感认知能力”，以及他们“在写作中表现出更强的适应力和更积极的希望”。
writing.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reading.en: One simple way to avoid engaging in personalisation and mind reading is to challenge your negative assumptions of what's happened.
reading.zh: 避免陷入‘个人化’和‘读心术’误区的一个简单方法，就是去质疑你对已发生事情的负面假设。
reading.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

reading.en: In both examples — and others that we all experience — there's another process at work that psychologists call mind reading.
reading.zh: 在这两个例子（以及我们都会经历的其他例子）中，还有另一种被称为“读心术”的心理学过程在发挥作用。
reading.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

being.en: It turned from God and the authority of the Roman Catholic Church and instead favoured a more humanistic approach to being.
being.zh: 人们的目光从上帝和罗马天主教会的权威转向，转而青睐一种更加人文主义的生存方式。
being.src: 2020 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

being.en: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals.
being.zh: 同样地，儿童也倾向于将机器人视为同类，即便这些机器人仅表现出简单的社交信号。
being.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

system.en: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
system.zh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
system.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

system.en: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
system.zh: 他说：“我们的系统很复杂，没有多余的缓冲空间。只要线路上出现一点小问题，情况就会变得异常棘手。”
system.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

economic.en: Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of Chicago as a whole.
economic.zh: 芝加哥的夏季音乐节不仅是娱乐活动，更是直接惠及所在社区乃至整个芝加哥市的经济引擎。
economic.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

economic.en: Technological innovation is integral to economic success.
economic.zh: 技术创新是经济成功不可或缺的组成部分。
economic.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

better.en: It's just you made some mistakes in the report and she wanted to point these out so that you do better next time.
better.zh: 只是因为你在报告中出了一些差错，她想指出来，以便你下次做得更好。
better.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

better.en: Reading will keep you better informed about the world but it can also improve our tech-shattered ability to concentrate.
better.zh: 阅读不仅能让你更全面地了解世界，还能修复因科技干扰而受损的专注力。

data.en: Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage.
data.zh: 雇主需要像对待任何其他形式的数据共享或存储一样，以同等的谨慎程度来管理人工智能工具。
data.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

data.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
data.zh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
data.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

view.en: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
view.zh: 但事实是，你的老板可能对你的评价非常高。
view.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

view.en: One of the biggest barriers to gaining buy-in occurs when the owner of an idea is viewed as argumentative, defensive, or close-minded.
view.zh: 获得认同的最大障碍之一是，当想法提出者被视为好辩、爱辩解或思想封闭时。
view.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

effect.en: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present.
effect.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来，影视制作便一直在流出好莱坞，但其影响从未像现在这样明显。
effect.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

effect.en: Some worry that this is having a destructive effect on society, but Sparrow sees an upside.
effect.zh: 一些人担心这会对社会产生破坏性影响，但斯派洛却看到了积极的一面。
effect.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

issue.en: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.
issue.zh: 一般而言，高温行动计划(HAP)规定了官员应何时以及如何发布高温预警，并向医院和其他机构发出警报。
issue.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

issue.en: Karla Ortiz, an illustrator based in San Francisco who found her work in Stable Diffusion's data set, has been raising awareness about the issues around AI art and copyright.
issue.zh: 卡拉·奥尔蒂斯是一位常驻旧金山的插画师，她发现自己的作品被纳入了Stable Diffusion的数据集，一直以来都在提高人们对AI艺术和版权相关问题的认识。
issue.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

means.en: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
means.zh: 自2008年罗马至米兰的高铁网络开通以来，火车已成为当地人和游客在意大利境内旅行的首选交通工具。
means.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

means.en: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states.
means.zh: 这也提醒我们，长期以来，美国环保署参与切萨皮克湾项目至关重要，因为它是超越邻州财力雄厚的特殊利益集团影响的重要手段。
means.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

support.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
support.zh: 今年夏天，当您尽情享受家门口的街道节庆时，希望您能记住，正是有了社区的支持，这些活动才得以存在。
support.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

support.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
support.zh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
support.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

benefit.en: The animals could benefit from more research: Currently, there are no published genomes from donkeys located south of the Equator in Africa.
benefit.zh: 这些动物可能会从更多的研究中受益：目前，赤道以南的非洲驴类尚无已发布的基因组数据。
benefit.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

benefit.en: Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of Chicago as a whole.
benefit.zh: 芝加哥的夏季音乐节不仅是娱乐活动，更是直接惠及所在社区乃至整个芝加哥市的经济引擎。
benefit.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

power.en: Established in an old paper mill, it is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people who live in the surrounding town of Kajaani.
power.zh: 它建于一座旧造纸厂内，由附近的河流提供动力，其远程供暖系统为居住在周边卡亚尼镇的居民供暖。
power.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

power.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
power.zh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
power.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

likely.en: These collaborations are likely to become increasingly common.
likely.zh: 此类合作很可能会变得越来越普遍。
likely.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

likely.en: As well as thousands of attempts, it takes patience and fieldcraft to anticipate a butterfly's likely flight-line and catch it—in focus.
likely.zh: 要预判蝴蝶可能的飞行路线并清晰捕捉到它，不仅需要成千上万次的尝试，还需要耐心和实地技巧。

scientific.en: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
scientific.zh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
scientific.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

scientific.en: Science education today revolves around the idea of scientific literacy — the base-level knowledge about science that nonscientists require to effectively get on in the world.
scientific.zh: 当今的科学教育围绕着“科学素养”这一理念展开，即非科学家群体为了在现实世界中有效生活所必须具备的基础科学知识。
scientific.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

court.en: It is too easy, and misleading, to see such court rulings as merely standing up for the rights of land owners when the consequences can be so dire for their neighbors.
court.zh: 如果只将此类法院裁决视为维护土地所有者的权利，而忽视其可能给周边社区带来的严重后果，这种看法不仅过于简单，而且具有误导性。
court.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

court.en: In the meantime, the court threw out the FCC's attempt to block all state rules on net neutrality, while preserving the commission's power to preempt individual state laws that undermine its order.
court.zh: 与此同时，法院驳回了联邦通信委员会试图阻止所有州级网络中立性规则的尝试，但保留了该委员会优先否决那些有损其命令的个别州法律的权力。
court.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

federal.en: That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants.
federal.zh: 这可能需要增加联邦资金，用于开展独立于科技巨头的研究。
federal.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

federal.en: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
federal.zh: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论人士认为短期内似乎不太可能出台全面的联邦隐私法规。
federal.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

growth.en: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
growth.zh: 然而，当一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入公司，组建了增长团队，并带来了他们所需的全新视角后，情况发生了改变。
growth.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

growth.en: It hinders the growth of "international" journals.
growth.zh: 这阻碍了“国际”期刊的发展。
growth.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

process.en: In both examples — and others that we all experience — there's another process at work that psychologists call mind reading.
process.zh: 在这两个例子（以及我们都会经历的其他例子）中，还有另一种被称为“读心术”的心理学过程在发挥作用。
process.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

process.en: Not to mention, if the process you're scrapping is one someone else suggested, there's the possibility of hurt feelings.
process.zh: 更不用说，如果你要放弃的流程是别人建议的，那还有可能会伤害到对方的感情。
process.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

customer.en: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
customer.zh: 设身处地为他人着想能让我们微调自己的社交理解力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时非常有用。

customer.en: However, many customers are frustrated because they feel they are being asked for too high of a tip, too often.
customer.zh: 然而，许多顾客感到不满，因为他们觉得被索要的小费过高、过于频繁。
customer.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

focus.en: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
focus.zh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
focus.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

focus.en: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
focus.zh: 她表示，各城市尤其应当绘制一份脆弱群体分布图，以便将应对措施重点放在风险最高的人群上。
focus.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

product.en: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
product.zh: 市面上有如此多的产品在巨额广告和营销预算的推波助澜下进行促销，以至于人们很容易成为受害者。
product.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

product.en: Self-sliding doors began to emerge as a commercial product in 1960 after being invented six years previously by Americans Dee Horton and Lew Hewitt.
product.zh: 自滑动门由美国人迪·霍顿(Dee Horton)和卢·休伊特(Lew Hewitt)于六年前发明，1960年开始作为商业产品问世。
product.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

case.en: Similarly, in the case of your friends cancelling, perhaps they both felt unwell that weekend or they just changed their minds.
case.zh: 同样，关于你的朋友取消邀约这件事，也许他们那个周末都感到身体不适，或者只是改变了主意。
case.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

case.en: In many cases, it is the best option — in terms of travel time and cost — for both leisure and business travellers.
case.zh: 在许多情况下，无论是对于休闲游客还是商务旅行者，这在旅行时间和成本方面都是最佳选择。
case.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reduce.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reduce.en: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias, and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands.
reduce.zh: 研究还发现，阅读能让我们更乐于助人，减少偏见，甚至延长寿命——如果我们手里有一本好书，我们将更加享受这份长寿带来的乐趣。

economy.en: "An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable."
economy.zh: 一个由科技百万富翁或亿万富翁与零工组成，而中等收入工作被自动化削弱的经济体，在政治上是不可持续的。
economy.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

economy.en: "Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past," she writes.
economy.zh: 她写道：“无论我们如何定义经济增长，如何理解境况改善，其成果的分配都必须比近年来更加均衡。”
economy.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

digital.en: But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our businesses, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.
digital.zh: 但通过在企业内部建立数字责任文化，我们可以创造一个让人工智能提供协助而不泄露秘密的未来。
digital.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

digital.en: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
digital.zh: 虽然书籍过去是、且应当永远是图书馆的核心，但图书馆也提供许多其他服务，如就业咨询、语言课程以及数字化接入与支持。
digital.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rate.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
rate.zh: 从预期寿命到癌症及婴儿死亡率，我们都落后于许多同类国家。
rate.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rate.en: Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.
rate.zh: 其出租空置率正在缓慢上升。
rate.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

community.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
community.zh: 今年夏天，当您尽情享受家门口的街道节庆时，希望您能记住，正是有了社区的支持，这些活动才得以存在。
community.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

community.en: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
community.zh: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉姆斯（Eric Williams）发起的银色房间街头派对（Silver Room Block Party）宣布，该活动将不会在2024年回归。
community.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

tend.en: Because flammable material couldn't build up on the landscape, blazes tended to move slowly and peter out when they reached the footprints of previous burns.
tend.zh: 由于易燃物无法在地面上堆积，火势往往蔓延缓慢，并在蔓延至先前的过火区域时逐渐熄灭。
tend.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

tend.en: They tend to fall short of official requirements.
tend.zh: 它们往往达不到官方要求。
tend.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

policy.en: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
policy.zh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
policy.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

policy.en: But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules.
policy.zh: 但即便有了这些规定，仍有部分员工选择违反规则。
policy.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

firm.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
firm.zh: 咨询公司帕克斯协会预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失在未来两年将达到1130亿美元。
firm.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

firm.en: John Kelly, a construction lawyer at Freeths law firm, believes prices will eventually come down.
firm.zh: 弗里斯律师事务所的建筑律师约翰·凯利认为，价格最终会下降。
firm.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

local.en: If there's congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
local.zh: 如果发生拥堵，或者例如有一辆区间列车发生故障，整个高铁网络都会受到影响。
local.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

local.en: Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
local.zh: 街头节庆活动不仅为当地商家带来了客流，也培育了使我们这座城市与众不同的文化活力。
local.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

measure.en: they have to step up security measures.
measure.zh: 他们必须加强安全措施。
measure.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

measure.en: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
measure.zh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
measure.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

argue.en: In his Oxford lectures, Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality, a "glimpsed alternative" that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large.
argue.zh: 西amus·希尼在牛津大学的讲座中指出，诗歌描绘了一种现实图景，即一种“瞥见的替代性可能”。这种可能从细微到宏大等各个层面，都与你当下的现实构成了矛盾。

argue.en: But it's also a lot more personal, Ortiz says, arguing that because art is so closely linked to a person, it could raise data protection and privacy problems.
argue.zh: 但奥尔蒂斯表示，这还涉及更深层次的个人问题。她认为，由于艺术与创作者本人有着千丝万缕的联系，这可能会引发数据保护和隐私方面的问题。
argue.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

demand.en: As a result, scientists — physicists in particular — found themselves in high demand.
demand.zh: 因此，科学家们——尤其是物理学家——发现自己变得非常吃香。
demand.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

demand.zh: 零排放模型需要额外资金支持。
demand.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

least.en: At the very least, we need to make our energy use far more sustainable.
least.zh: 至少，我们需要大幅提高能源使用的可持续性。
least.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

least.en: Psychologists have been interested in this question for decades, not least because people's widespread reluctance to ask for help has led to some high-profile failures.
least.zh: 心理学家对这个问题的研究已有数十年之久，尤其是因为人们普遍不愿寻求帮助，这已导致了一些备受瞩目的失败案例。
least.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

risk.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
risk.zh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
risk.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

risk.en: There is a risk of deepening societal beauty pressures and perpetuating unattainable beauty standards.
risk.zh: 这存在加深社会审美压力并使不可及的审美标准持续存在的风险。
risk.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

decade.en: What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event, welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down.
decade.zh: 这一起初只是小规模的邻里聚会，后来发展壮大成为一项盛大的文化盛事，在近二十年的时间里，每年都吸引数万民众参与，直到最后戛然而止。
decade.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

decade.en: In the study, the researchers compared the historical fire cadence with the wildfires recorded over the past few decades, and uncovered a striking shortfall.
decade.zh: 研究人员在研究中将历史火灾频率与过去几十年记录的野火进行了对比，发现两者之间存在显著差距。
decade.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

involve.en: The purpose of restoration efforts may be different from the real needs of the people involved.
involve.zh: 修复工作的目的可能与相关人员的实际需求存在偏差。
involve.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

involve.en: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils aged nine and ten—at 45 state primary schools that had not been "previously exposed to RSC pedagogy".
involve.zh: 这项随机对照试验涉及45所州立小学的数百名9至10岁五年级学生，这些学校此前"未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团教学法"。
involve.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

concern.en: "We know enough to know that this is a concern, but we don't know enough about how to respond to it yet. That's a great area to be doing research."
concern.zh: 我们已经了解到这确实是个问题，但对于如何应对，目前掌握的信息还不够充分。这正是开展研究的绝佳领域。
concern.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

concern.en: While AI offers exciting possibilities, it also raises ethical concerns.
concern.zh: 人工智能在带来令人兴奋的可能性的同时，也引发了伦理方面的担忧。
concern.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

generation.en: So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.
generation.zh: 因此，如果我们想要为子孙后代保护好图书馆，就必须提高公众对图书馆及其工作的认识。
generation.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

generation.en: "Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year," says forest ecologist John Stanturf.
generation.zh: 森林生态学家约翰·斯坦特夫表示：“如果某些昆虫一年能繁殖三到四代，那么如今只是小麻烦的它们，未来可能会演变成大问题。”
generation.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

financial.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
financial.zh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
financial.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

financial.en: they have to tackle financial difficulties.
financial.zh: 他们必须应对财务困难。
financial.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

individual.en: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
individual.zh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
individual.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

individual.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
individual.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
individual.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

challenge.en: One simple way to avoid engaging in personalisation and mind reading is to challenge your negative assumptions of what's happened.
challenge.zh: 避免陷入‘个人化’和‘读心术’误区的一个简单方法，就是去质疑你对已发生事情的负面假设。
challenge.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

challenge.en: And this is where the challenge lies.
challenge.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

journal.en: The team published their findings in the journal Science this month.
journal.zh: 该团队于本月在《科学》杂志上发表了他们的研究成果。
journal.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

journal.en: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.
journal.zh: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》发表的一篇论文中，研究人员指出，西方核心家庭是近代的产物，它打破了人类的进化史。
journal.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

million.en: According to the website Lexica, which tracks over 10 million Stable Diffusion images and prompts, Rutkowski's name has been used as a prompt around 93,000 times.
million.zh: 据追踪超过1000万张Stable Diffusion图像和提示词的网站Lexica统计，鲁特科夫斯基的名字已被用作提示词约93,000次。
million.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

million.en: Nearly 2,000 years ago, as the Romans began to pull out of Scotland, they left behind a curious treasure: 10 tons of nails, nearly a million of the things.
million.zh: 近两千年前，当罗马人开始撤离苏格兰时，他们留下了一批奇特的宝藏：10吨铁钉，总数近百万枚。
million.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

decline.en: This is a reaction to Hollywood's decline, which is reaching a critical point for the industry and Southern California.
decline.zh: 这是对好莱坞衰落的一种回应，而这种衰落正使该产业以及南加州地区陷入危急关头。
decline.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

decline.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
decline.zh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
decline.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

major.en: "Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year," says forest ecologist John Stanturf.
major.zh: 森林生态学家约翰·斯坦特夫表示：“如果某些昆虫一年能繁殖三到四代，那么如今只是小麻烦的它们，未来可能会演变成大问题。”
major.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

major.en: Their work deals with one of the problems that could block major restoration efforts in different parts of the world.
major.zh: 他们的工作涉及一个可能会阻碍全球多地开展重大修复工程的问题。
major.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

average.en: It found that infants had an average of 14 alloparents a day by the time they were 18 weeks old and were passed between caregivers eight times an hour.
average.zh: 该研究发现，18周大的婴儿平均每天有14位养育人，每小时会在不同照护者之间被传递8次。
average.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

average.en: "An average extension will probably see around £3,000 additional cost thanks to the new regs."
average.zh: “由于新规，一个普通的扩建项目可能会增加约3000英镑的成本。”
average.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

pressure.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
pressure.zh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
pressure.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

pressure.en: There is a risk of deepening societal beauty pressures and perpetuating unattainable beauty standards.
pressure.zh: 这存在加深社会审美压力并使不可及的审美标准持续存在的风险。
pressure.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

political.en: Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.
political.zh: 这不仅会引发政治和社会动荡，正如科伊尔所指出的，还可能阻碍区域经济增长所需的各类人工智能技术的发展。
political.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

political.en: A move back to self-sufficiency, the argument goes, would boost the farming industry, political sovereignty and even the nation's health.
political.zh: 支持者认为，恢复粮食自给自足将促进农业发展，增强政治主权，甚至改善国民健康。
political.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

tax.en: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
tax.zh: 佐治亚州为电影和电视制作成本提供高达 30% 的可转让税收抵免。此外，如果项目包含了佐治亚州的宣传标识，还可以在基础税收抵免之上再获得 10% 的额度提升。
tax.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

tax.en: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns.
tax.zh: 该账号正努力鼓励人们在两份请愿书上签名，一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份则呼吁对此类草坪征收'生态损害'税。
tax.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

impact.en: Additionally, clothing can impact our confidence levels.
impact.zh: 此外，穿着打扮也会影响我们的自信程度。
impact.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

impact.en: The global impact is about $71 billion annually.
impact.zh: 其全球影响每年约为710亿美元。
impact.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

internet.en: But these open-source programs are built by scraping images from the Internet, often without permission and proper attribution to artists.
internet.zh: 但这些开源程序是通过从互联网上抓取图片构建而成的，而且往往未获得艺术家的许可，也未给予他们应有的署名。
internet.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

internet.en: "It's been just a month. What about in a year? I probably won't be able to find my work out there because the Internet will be flooded with AI art," Rutkowski said.
internet.zh: 鲁特科夫斯基说：“这才一个月。要是过一年呢？我可能就再也找不到自己的作品了，因为互联网上会充斥着人工智能生成的艺术作品。”
internet.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

behavior.en: The influence of wearables on psychology refers to how the clothes we wear affect our thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.
behavior.zh: 穿戴物对心理的影响，是指我们所穿的衣服如何影响我们的思维、情感和行为。
behavior.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

behavior.en: One idea is that teenage behavior is related to what researchers call "reward sensitivity."
behavior.zh: 一种观点认为，青少年的行为与研究人员所说的“奖赏敏感性”有关。
behavior.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

design.en: With so much research left to do, leaders in the field have been doing some soul-searching, and acknowledging that restoration can be motivated by — and designed to meet — different needs.
design.zh: 面对繁重的研究任务，该领域的领军人物一直在进行反思，并承认修复工作的动力和设计初衷可以源于不同的需求。
design.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

design.en: This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs.
design.zh: 这一切看似随意，实则是精心设计的结果，是价值61亿美元的美国鸡蛋行业押注的下一个重大举措：气候友好型鸡蛋。
design.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

publish.en: The team published their findings in the journal Science this month.
publish.zh: 该团队于本月在《科学》杂志上发表了他们的研究成果。
publish.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

publish.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
publish.zh: 现实情况却截然不同。正如我受文化部门委托对英国公共图书馆进行的独立审查报告所显示的，该报告已于昨日发布。
publish.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

approach.en: Science-based analytical approaches proved remarkably successful in the hunt for German submarines in the Atlantic Ocean.
approach.zh: 基于科学的分析方法在大西洋搜寻德国潜艇的任务中被证明非常成功。
approach.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

approach.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
approach.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
approach.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

climate.en: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging, experts said.
climate.zh: 专家表示，尽管科学家和公职人员日益达成共识，认为我们的森林需要更多计划性火烧，但气候变化正使这一策略面临更大的挑战。
climate.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

climate.en: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species.
climate.zh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
climate.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

opportunity.en: Citizen science provides an opportunity for greater public engagement and the democratisation of science.
opportunity.zh: 公民科学为公众更广泛参与和科学民主化提供了机会。
opportunity.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

opportunity.en: They also provide an opportunity to talk to the people responsible for growing or raising your food, support your local economy and pick up fresh seasonal produce—all at the same time.
opportunity.zh: 它们还让你有机会与负责种植或养殖你食物的人交谈，支持当地经济，同时选购新鲜的时令农产品——这一切都可以同时实现。
opportunity.src: 2024 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

stress.en: stress the consequences of climate change.
stress.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

stress.en: In fact, the ability to emotionally regulate or maintain emotional control when confronted by stress is one of the most important of all life's skills.
stress.zh: 事实上，在面对压力时能够进行情绪调节或保持情绪控制，是人生中最重要的技能之一。
stress.src: 2020 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

claim.en: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
claim.zh: 联邦贸易委员会在起诉书中指控，“尽管该公司明确做出了隐私承诺，但仍控制了用户的敏感生育数据并将其分享给第三方。”
claim.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

claim.en: A Twitter account, which claims to "cut through the greenwash" of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers.
claim.zh: 一个声称要"揭穿人造草坪绿色伪装"的推特账号已有超过2万名关注者。
claim.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

evidence.en: "We need better evidence on what makes drivers unsafe" and what can help, said Dugan.
evidence.zh: 杜根表示：“我们需要更充分的证据来了解导致驾驶员不安全的因素，以及哪些措施可以提供帮助。”
evidence.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

evidence.en: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance, wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J. Simons.
evidence.zh: 例如，心理学家克里斯托弗·查布里斯(Christopher Chabris)和丹尼尔·J·西蒙斯(Daniel J. Simons)写道，目前尚无实验证据表明互联网会干扰我们的专注力。
evidence.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

intelligence.en: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
intelligence.zh: 人工智能（AI）的进步正在迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。
intelligence.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

intelligence.en: There has been some exploration around the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital marketing.
intelligence.zh: 目前已有一些关于在数字营销中运用人工智能(AI)的探索。
intelligence.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

factor.en: Climate change is a driving factor in the push to restore forests, but it also raises questions, such as where trees can thrive in the future.
factor.zh: 气候变化是推动森林恢复的一个驱动因素，但也引发了一些问题，例如未来哪些地方适合树木生长。
factor.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

factor.en: Human factors, as well as trees planted, should be emphasized in forest restoration.
factor.zh: 在森林恢复过程中，不仅要注重植树造林，还应强调人的因素。
factor.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

intellectual.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
intellectual.zh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
intellectual.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

intellectual.en: "I personally have never seen all that much intellectual value in memorizing things," Sparrow says, adding that we haven't lost our ability to do it.
intellectual.zh: 斯派洛说：“我个人从不认为记忆事物有那么多的智力价值。”她补充道，我们并没有失去记忆能力。
intellectual.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

pattern.en: But the new study shows that, interestingly, the same pattern holds for prosocial behavior.
pattern.zh: 但这项新研究表明，有趣的是，亲社会行为也呈现出相同的模式。
pattern.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

pattern.en: These are examples of dark patterns.
pattern.zh: 这些都是暗模式的例子。
pattern.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

significant.en: When you take things personally, you're interpreting these situations as saying something significant and negative about you as a person.
significant.zh: 当你把事情看作是针对个人时，你实际上是将这些情况解读为对自己人格的重大否定。
significant.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

significant.en: Moreover, cultural and societal influences play a significant role in shaping our dress choices.
significant.zh: 此外，文化和社会影响在塑造我们的着装选择方面起着重要作用。
significant.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

define.en: Part of the solution could lie in somehow loosening the stranglehold that Big Tech has on defining the AI agenda.
define.zh: 解决之道的一部分可能在于，以某种方式削弱大型科技公司对人工智能议程定义的钳制。
define.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

define.en: Technology defines people's understanding of the world.
define.zh: 技术定义了人们对世界的理解。
define.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

professional.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
professional.zh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
professional.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

professional.en: According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems.
professional.zh: 研究显示，英国约有五分之一的劳动者将人工智能视为朋友，并向其寻求个人和职场问题的建议。
professional.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fund.en: collect funds for film and TV making.
fund.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

fund.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
fund.zh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
fund.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

gap.en: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
gap.zh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
gap.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

gap.en: This remains a significant knowledge gap.
gap.zh: 这仍然是一个重大的认知空白。
gap.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

image.en: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
image.zh: 问起人们对公共图书馆的看法，脑海中总会浮现出某种特定画面：尘土飞扬、陈旧过时。就像那种你小时候很喜欢，但现在是否还会光顾的地方——某种程度上，就和英国的海滨小镇一样。
image.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

image.en: The tool, along with other popular image-generation AI models, allows anyone to create impressive images based on text prompts.
image.zh: 这款工具与其他流行的图像生成AI模型一样，任何人都能通过文字提示创建出令人印象深刻的图像。
image.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

quality.en: prioritise the quality of AI-produced content.
quality.zh: 优先提升人工智能生成内容的质量。
quality.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

quality.en: And, as our research emphasizes, tipping now seems to be more coercive, less generous and often completely dissociated from service quality.
quality.zh: 而且，正如我们的研究所强调的，如今的小费似乎更具强制性，少了些慷慨，并且往往与服务质量完全脱节。
quality.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

site.en: Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP's surgery.
site.zh: 许多地方都配有驻场护士进行常规健康检查，并与全科医生诊所保持联系。
site.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

site.en: The NAFSN sites experienced less than a quarter of the number of fires that would have been expected without fire suppression.
site.zh: NAFSN 站点的火灾发生数量不到在没有灭火措施情况下预期火灾数量的四分之一。
site.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

access.en: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
access.zh: 虽然书籍过去是、且应当永远是图书馆的核心，但图书馆也提供许多其他服务，如就业咨询、语言课程以及数字化接入与支持。
access.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

access.en: Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained?
access.zh: 然而，这种普遍获取是如何实现的？或许更重要的是，它又是如何维持的？
access.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

global.en: Much of the global funding for restoration is dedicated to developing it as a tool to mitigate climate change, notes restoration ecologist Pedro Brancalion.
global.zh: 修复生态学家佩德罗·布兰卡里昂指出，全球大部分用于修复工作的资金都致力于将其作为减缓气候变化的工具。
global.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

global.en: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species.
global.zh: 亚洲可以说是在提高恢复多样性和研究本土物种的全球努力中，最被忽视的地区。
global.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

legal.en: The health information these apps and health data tracking wearables are collecting typically does not receive the same legal protections.
legal.zh: 这些应用程序和健康数据追踪可穿戴设备收集的健康信息通常得不到同等的法律保护。
legal.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

legal.en: Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.
legal.zh: 暗模式也可以通过自我监管来解决，但前提是企业不仅要对法律要求负责，还要对行业最佳实践和标准负责。
legal.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

opinion.zh: 获取读者对它们的看法。
opinion.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

opinion.en: But such an idea is untrue, according to a new opinion article.
opinion.zh: 但根据一篇新的评论文章，这种观点并不正确。
opinion.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

base.en: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
base.zh: 佐治亚州为电影和电视制作成本提供高达 30% 的可转让税收抵免。此外，如果项目包含了佐治亚州的宣传标识，还可以在基础税收抵免之上再获得 10% 的额度提升。
base.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

base.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
base.zh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
base.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

gain.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
gain.zh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
gain.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

gain.en: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user — rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
gain.zh: 这使微软获得了用户输入或输出数据的广泛权利——微软有权以其认为合适的任何方式使用这些数据，甚至可以将其与第三方共享。
gain.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

loss.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
loss.zh: 咨询公司帕克斯协会预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失在未来两年将达到1130亿美元。
loss.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

loss.en: But look at what happened to Boston's Gardner Museum theft in 1990, including the loss of Rembrandt, Vermeer, Manet, and other masterpieces.
loss.zh: 但是看看1990年波士顿加德纳博物馆的盗窃案吧，包括伦勃朗、维米尔、马奈等大师的作品都被盗走了。
loss.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

potential.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
potential.zh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
potential.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

potential.en: Still, AI also has the potential hazard of dominating our experiences in ways we might find difficult to control.
potential.zh: 尽管如此，AI 仍存在潜在风险，即可能以我们难以掌控的方式主导我们的体验。
potential.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

simply.en: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
simply.zh: 此处不收取任何费用，也绝不会要求你进行辩解或说明；我们只会简单地欢迎你，在你需要时提供帮助，并在你不需要时不去打扰。
simply.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

simply.en: However, it takes more than simply having a good idea.
simply.zh: 然而，仅仅有好点子是远远不够的。
simply.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

account.en: We usually only get the human's side of history through written accounts, but of course written history does not always record exactly how something happened.
account.zh: 通常我们只能通过文字记载了解人类视角下的历史，但显然，文字记载的历史并不总能准确还原事情发生的真相。
account.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

account.en: Written accounts contain vital clues for donkey research.
account.zh: 文献记载为驴的研究提供了关键线索。
account.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

career.en: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
career.zh: 科学家的职业生涯及其所在机构的声誉取决于他们发表论文的数量和声望，但更重要的是这些论文所获得的引用量。
career.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

career.en: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory.
career.zh: 教育，不仅仅是在校园里获得的知识，将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心部分。
career.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

expert.en: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.
expert.zh: 专家表示，RFI（意大利铁路网公司）多年来持续投入的高密度技术和卫星信号技术也将带来进一步的提升。
expert.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expert.en: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging, experts said.
expert.zh: 专家表示，尽管科学家和公职人员日益达成共识，认为我们的森林需要更多计划性火烧，但气候变化正使这一策略面临更大的挑战。
expert.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

limit.en: A pressure-sensitive mat would be more appropriate to limit the surveyed area.
limit.zh: 使用压敏垫会更合适，因其可限制感应区域。
limit.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

limit.en: We all have our own social limit and it's important to recognise when you're feeling like it's all too much.
limit.zh: 我们每个人都有自己的社交极限，重要的是要意识到什么时候你感觉社交活动太多了。
limit.src: 2024 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

official.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
official.zh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
official.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

official.en: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging, experts said.
official.zh: 专家表示，尽管科学家和公职人员日益达成共识，认为我们的森林需要更多计划性火烧，但气候变化正使这一策略面临更大的挑战。
official.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

production.en: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
production.zh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
production.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

production.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
production.zh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
production.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

sign.en: Low mood, low energy, irritability and trouble sleeping could all be signs of poor social health.
sign.zh: 情绪低落、精力不足、易怒和睡眠障碍都可能是社交健康不佳的迹象。
sign.src: 2024 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

sign.en: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns.
sign.zh: 该账号正努力鼓励人们在两份请愿书上签名，一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份则呼吁对此类草坪征收'生态损害'税。
sign.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

current.en: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
current.zh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
current.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）
2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

housing.en: Its housing supply is at a very low level.
housing.zh: 其住房供应处于极低水平。
housing.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

housing.en: Hom said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but "if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more."
housing.zh: 霍姆表示，类似的注册要求可能会对处境艰难的城镇有所帮助，但“如果我们想改变住房市场，关键是我们必须建造更多的住房。”
housing.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

labor.en: The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades.
labor.zh: 过去三十年来，处于退休年龄却仍在劳动力市场的人口比例翻了一番。
labor.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

labor.en: Gen Zs are about to hit the streets looking for work in a labor market that's tighter than it's been in decades.
labor.zh: Z世代即将踏入职场，进入一个数十年来竞争最激烈的劳动力市场。
labor.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

lack.en: But lack of capacity is another problem.
lack.zh: 但能力不足（或产能不足）是另一个问题。
lack.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

lack.en: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
lack.zh: 通过从市场营销的角度审视工程问题，团队清晰地认识到，用户不愿升级并非产品质量问题。
lack.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

material.en: Because flammable material couldn't build up on the landscape, blazes tended to move slowly and peter out when they reached the footprints of previous burns.
material.zh: 由于易燃物无法在地面上堆积，火势往往蔓延缓慢，并在蔓延至先前的过火区域时逐渐熄灭。
material.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

material.en: "Where's the planting material going to come from? That's one big bottleneck," says genetic-resources specialist Ramni Jamnadass.
material.zh: “种苗从哪里来？这是一个巨大的瓶颈，”遗传资源专家拉姆尼·贾姆纳达斯说道。
material.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

increasingly.en: It is increasingly easy to read donkeys' DNA sequences.
increasingly.zh: 读取驴的 DNA 序列正变得越来越容易。
increasingly.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

increasingly.en: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
increasingly.zh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。
increasingly.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

physical.en: (And yes, all these benefits are more closely associated with physical books than digital ones.)
physical.zh: （没错，所有这些优点与纸质书的相关性都要比电子书更高。）

physical.en: Stealing artifacts from other peoples' cultures is obscene; it robs not only the physical objects, but the dignity and spirit of their creators.
physical.zh: 窃取其他民族文化的文物是令人不齿的行为；这不仅夺走了实物，更剥夺了其创造者的尊严与精神。
physical.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

project.en: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
project.zh: 佐治亚州为电影和电视制作成本提供高达 30% 的可转让税收抵免。此外，如果项目包含了佐治亚州的宣传标识，还可以在基础税收抵免之上再获得 10% 的额度提升。
project.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

project.en: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
project.zh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
project.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

seek.en: And stay alert to serious symptoms, such as chest pain or pressure, severe shortness of breath or dizziness, or faintness, and seek medical attention immediately.
seek.zh: 同时要警惕严重症状，如胸痛或胸部压迫感、严重呼吸急促、头晕或晕厥，一旦出现应立即就医。
seek.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

seek.en: Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.
seek.zh: 该中心的创始人旨在提高艺术家的地位。
seek.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

trend.en: The merger of publishers is a worrying trend.
trend.zh: 出版商合并是一个令人担忧的趋势。
trend.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

trend.en: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
trend.zh: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然势头强劲，但是，要使合作取得成功，双方都需要投入时间，并乐于接受惊喜与挑战。
trend.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

affect.en: If there's congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
affect.zh: 如果发生拥堵，或者例如有一辆区间列车发生故障，整个高铁网络都会受到影响。
affect.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

affect.en: When we wear clothes that make us feel comfortable and confident, it can positively affect our self-esteem and overall mood.
affect.zh: 当我们穿着令自己感到舒适且自信的衣服时，这能对我们的自尊心和整体情绪产生积极影响。
affect.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

argument.en: Least rousing, he thinks, was rational argument, although his co-authors say reason might play a bigger role.
argument.zh: 他认为，理性论证的激发效果最差，尽管他的合著者们认为理性可能发挥更大作用。
argument.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

argument.en: Why, the argument goes, should a car-driving pensioner from Lincolnshire have to subsidise the daily commute of a stockbroker from Surrey?
argument.zh: 这种论点认为，为什么林肯郡一位开车出行的养老金领取者要补贴萨里郡一位股票经纪人的日常通勤呢？
argument.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

billion.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
billion.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
billion.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

billion.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
billion.zh: 咨询公司帕克斯协会预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失在未来两年将达到1130亿美元。
billion.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

executive.en: I have yet to meet a chief executive who reads regularly.
executive.zh: 我还没见过哪位首席执行官有定期阅读的习惯。

executive.en: Brian Berry, chief executive of the Federation of Master Builders, says the measures will require new materials, testing methods, products and systems to be installed.
executive.zh: 英国建筑大师联合会首席执行官布莱恩·贝里表示，这些措施将要求安装新的材料、测试方法、产品和系统。
executive.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

institution.en: There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same.
institution.zh: 没有任何其他机构，无论是公立还是私营，能得出同样的结论。
institution.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

institution.en: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.
institution.zh: 一般而言，高温行动计划(HAP)规定了官员应何时以及如何发布高温预警，并向医院和其他机构发出警报。
institution.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

nation.en: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation, rather than "fix" the NHS.
nation.zh: 这必须从如何最大限度地提高国民健康水平这个问题开始，而不是“修复”英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)。
nation.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

nation.en: I would ask that the foreign nations and the original country discuss the terms of transfer.
nation.zh: 我认为外国应当与原属国共同商议文物归还的具体条款。
nation.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

theory.en: "We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there."
theory.zh: 我们当前的处境是，尚无完善理论能够解释意识究竟是什么，以及如何才能造出具备意识的机器。
theory.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

theory.en: In theory, a girl may veto the spouse her parents have chosen.
theory.zh: 理论上，女孩可以否决父母为其选择的配偶。
theory.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

figure.en: "There is a coalition growing within artist industries to figure out how to tackle or mitigate this," says Ortiz.
figure.zh: 奥尔蒂斯表示：“艺术家行业内部正在形成一个联盟，以研究如何应对或缓解这一问题。”
figure.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

figure.en: It's especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi's pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling.
figure.zh: 这种泡沫特别容易受到光照损害，到20世纪90年代中期，吉拉迪创作的南瓜、玫瑰及其他形象已经开始开裂破碎。
figure.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

investment.en: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
investment.zh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
investment.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

investment.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
investment.zh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
investment.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

later.en: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
later.zh: 随后，他们追踪了这些动物在大约 2,500 年后是如何穿过大陆其余地区，进而扩散到欧洲和亚洲的。
later.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

later.en: Research shows that these prescribed burns make subsequent wildfires less severe, even if later fires happen under the most dangerous weather conditions.
later.zh: 研究表明，这种计划烧除可以降低后续野火的严重程度，即使火灾发生在最危险的天气条件下也是如此。
later.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

professor.en: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow.
professor.zh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯派洛指出，互联网可能仅仅改变了我们记忆的内容，而非我们的记忆能力。
professor.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

professor.en: As a zoology professor, I agree with Emma Marris that zoo displays can be sad and cruel.
professor.zh: 作为一名动物学教授，我同意艾玛·马里斯的观点，即动物园的展览可能既令人难过又残酷。
professor.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

promote.en: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
promote.zh: 市面上有如此多的产品在巨额广告和营销预算的推波助澜下进行促销，以至于人们很容易成为受害者。
promote.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

promote.en: What can promote children's emotional literacy according to O'Hanlon?
promote.zh: 根据奥汉隆的观点，什么可以促进儿童的情感素养？
promote.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

security.en: Security, entertainment, portable restrooms, insurance and even basics such as fencing and staffing have all become significantly more expensive.
security.zh: 安保、娱乐、移动厕所、保险，甚至围栏和人员配备等基础项目的成本都大幅上涨了。
security.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

security.en: they have to step up security measures.
security.zh: 他们必须加强安全措施。
security.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

desire.en: In the United States, the desire to provide the public with a general, nontechnical education in science originated as far back as the late 1800s.
desire.zh: 在美国，为大众提供非技术性科普教育的初衷最早可以追溯到 19 世纪晚期。
desire.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

desire.en: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
desire.zh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
desire.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

identify.en: The team identified some 15 buildings, courtyards, a network of streets, and two chamber tombs.
identify.zh: 该团队发现了大约15座建筑物、庭院、一个街道网络以及两座石室墓。
identify.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

identify.en: They've implored citizen scientists to help with bug counting and categorising cancer cells, and even identifying distant galaxies.
identify.zh: 他们恳请公民科学家协助进行昆虫计数、癌细胞分类，甚至识别遥远的星系。
identify.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

mental.en: Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes, characters and mental states.
mental.zh: 当我们模拟场景、角色和心理状态时，大脑的不同区域会参与其中。

mental.en: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
mental.zh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

reader.zh: 获取读者对它们的看法。
reader.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reader.en: We are living through a golden age of science writing, so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery.
reader.zh: 我们正生活在科普写作的黄金时代，这些作品清晰易懂，即便是外行读者也能领略科学发现中那不可预知的魅力。

reform.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
reform.zh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
reform.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reform.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
reform.zh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
reform.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

response.en: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
response.zh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
response.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

response.en: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
response.zh: 她表示，各城市尤其应当绘制一份脆弱群体分布图，以便将应对措施重点放在风险最高的人群上。
response.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

event.en: Though it's still unclear why the original domestication happened, Science News' Freda Kreier reports that the event coincided with the Sahara growing larger and drier.
event.zh: 尽管最初驯化的原因尚不明确，但《科学新闻》的弗雷达·克赖尔报道称，这一事件恰逢撒哈拉沙漠范围扩大且气候变得更加干旱的时期。
event.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

event.en: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
event.zh: 研究团队重建了这些动物的进化树，并利用计算机模型精准定位了这次驯化事件，即肯尼亚和非洲之角的牧民驯服野驴的时间点。
event.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

fashion.en: But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought that fashion and I together were just a dream – I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all!
fashion.zh: 但说实话，我那么说是因为我觉得时尚于我而言不过是个梦想——我知道根本没人能想象我进入时尚行业！
fashion.src: 2017 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

fashion.en: This is when I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."
fashion.zh: 就在这时，我注意到了《时尚媒体与推广》这门课程。
fashion.src: 2017 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

justice.en: And it carries "significant repercussions for water quality and flood control throughout the United States," as Justice Brett Kavanaugh observed.
justice.zh: 正如布雷特·卡瓦诺大法官所指出的，这一裁决“将对全美国的水质和防洪产生重大影响”。
justice.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

justice.en: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC's abdication.
justice.zh: 这意味着将会有更多类似目前司法部与加利福尼亚州之间正在进行的斗争，后者在联邦通信委员会放弃监管后颁布了一项严格的网络中立性法律。
justice.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

management.en: Particularly useful in busy locations or during times of emergency, the doors act as crowd management by reducing the obstacles put in people's way.
management.zh: 在繁忙场所或紧急情况下，自动门尤为实用，它们通过减少行人通行障碍来辅助人群疏导。
management.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

management.en: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
management.zh: 其前提是，普通合同法未能为劳动者提供足够的保护，以抵御管理层的任意行为。
management.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

productivity.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
productivity.zh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
productivity.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

productivity.en: They have their reasons — around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
productivity.zh: 他们有自己的理由——约 63% 的人表示使用 AI 提高了他们的生产力，有些人甚至觉得 AI 比人类同事提供的帮助更多。
productivity.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

source.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
source.zh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
source.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

source.en: These should be available to them as part of their cultural heritage and history and as a source of national pride.
source.zh: 这些文物理应作为他们文化遗产和历史的一部分，以及民族自豪感的源泉，供他们接触和了解。
source.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

species.en: "If you don't look at the soil at the start, you can spend a lot of money and time putting in species that aren't going to survive there."
species.zh: 如果你不从一开始就检查土壤情况，那么投入大量金钱和时间去种植那些无法在该地存活的物种，最终只会付诸东流。
species.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

species.en: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species.
species.zh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
species.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

structure.en: In 1967 a scientific survey of the Peloponnesian coast was gathering data to analyze changes in sea levels when British oceanographer Nicholas Flemming first spotted the sunken structures.
structure.zh: 1967年，一项针对伯罗奔尼撒半岛海岸的科学调查正在收集数据以分析海平面变化，此时英国海洋学家尼古拉斯·弗莱明首次发现了这些沉没的建筑物。
structure.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

structure.en: Their well-developed hippocampal structures may enable elephants, like rats and people, to construct cognitive maps.
structure.zh: 它们发达的海马体结构或许能让大象像老鼠和人类一样构建认知地图。
structure.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

aim.en: technology should be aimed at benefiting humans.
aim.zh: 技术应当以造福人类为目标。
aim.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

aim.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
aim.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
aim.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

available.en: Recent research from the Organization for the Review of Care and Health Applications found that 350,000 health apps were available on the market, 90,000 of which launched in 2020 alone.
available.zh: 护理与健康应用审查组织的最新研究发现，市场上有35万个健康应用程序，其中仅2020年就推出了9万个。
available.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

available.en: These should be available to them as part of their cultural heritage and history and as a source of national pride.
available.zh: 这些文物理应作为他们文化遗产和历史的一部分，以及民族自豪感的源泉，供他们接触和了解。
available.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

department.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
department.zh: 现实情况却截然不同。正如我受文化部门委托对英国公共图书馆进行的独立审查报告所显示的，该报告已于昨日发布。
department.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

department.en: Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city's Inspectional Services Department.
department.zh: 波士顿则更进一步，要求短租房东在该市的检查服务部门进行登记。
department.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

medium.en: adolescents should form healthy social media habits.
medium.zh: 青少年应当养成健康的社交媒体使用习惯。
medium.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

medium.en: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
medium.zh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
medium.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reveal.en: Excavations revealed a large number of Minoan-style loom weights, suggesting Pavlopetri was a thriving trade center with a robust textile industry.
reveal.zh: 考古发掘发现了大量米诺斯风格的织布机砝码，表明帕夫洛佩特里曾是一个繁荣的贸易中心，拥有发达的纺织业。
reveal.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

reveal.en: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.
reveal.zh: 该附录列出了许多从西班牙法军手中缴获的加密文件，而这些文件的秘密正是由英国总部的一名军官——乔治·斯科维尔的工作所揭开的。
reveal.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

contribute.en: Additionally, AI-powered beauty filters and editing tools can lead to distorted self-perception and contribute to body dissatisfaction.
contribute.zh: 此外，人工智能驱动的美颜滤镜和编辑工具可能会导致自我认知失真，并加剧对身材的不满。
contribute.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

contribute.en: Loneliness is known to impact on your mental health and contribute to a low mood.
contribute.zh: 众所周知，孤独会影响心理健康，并导致情绪低落。
contribute.src: 2024 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

further.en: Tip creep and tipflation are now further supplementing the income of many low-wage service workers.
further.zh: 小费渗透和小费通胀现象如今正进一步补充许多低薪服务工作者的收入。
further.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

further.en: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
further.zh: 在新罕布什尔州，租金空置率已降至1%以下，住房权益倡导者担心，不受监管的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。
further.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

graduate.en: Postgraduates now earn 40 per cent more than graduates.
graduate.zh: 如今，硕士毕业生的收入比本科毕业生高出40%。
graduate.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

graduate.en: Today, 28 per cent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among the OECD countries.
graduate.zh: 如今，英国28%的大学毕业生从事着无需学位的工作，这一比例是经济合作与发展组织（OECD）国家平均水平的两倍。
graduate.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

patent.en: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
patent.zh: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的判决，裁定Myriad Genetics公司确实可以拥有两项基因的专利，这两项基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。
patent.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

patent.en: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
patent.zh: 例如，目前尚不清楚对整个基因组进行测序是否会侵犯其中单个基因的专利权。
patent.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

profit.en: By cutting out the middlemen, the farmers secure more profit for their produce.
profit.zh: 通过省去中间商环节，农民们能为自己的农产品获得更多利润。
profit.src: 2024 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

profit.en: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit, you need to find a way to take it to the next level.
profit.zh: 以下是当今众多创业者共同面临的一种常见情况：你是一家小型企业的首席执行官，尽管企业盈利可观，但你需要找到方法将其提升到一个新的水平。
profit.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

advance.en: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
advance.zh: 人工智能（AI）的进步正在迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。
advance.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

advance.en: Since the 1960s, underwater archaeology techniques and tools had made huge advances.
advance.zh: 自20世纪60年代以来，水下考古技术和工具取得了巨大进步。
advance.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

apply.en: The development in 1915 of the popular new subject "general science" was another effort to train students to apply the principles of science to everyday, nonscience problems.
apply.zh: 1915年，广受欢迎的新学科“综合科学”得到发展，这是培养学生将科学原理应用于日常非科学问题的又一次尝试。
apply.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

apply.en: Notably, Broadway stands out as one of the few areas in NYC that defies the grid-based system applied to the rest of the city, cutting a diagonal across parts of the city.
apply.zh: 值得注意的是，百老汇是纽约少数几个不遵循全市网格布局系统的区域之一，它以对角线的方式穿过城市的部分区域。
apply.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

authority.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
authority.zh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
authority.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

authority.en: That day's high temperature of roughly 36°C was 1°C shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.
authority.zh: 当日最高气温约为36°C，比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1°C。
authority.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

consequence.en: "Yet the combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires, particularly those that ignite under the most dangerous weather conditions."
consequence.zh: 然而，森林防火抑制与气候变化的双重影响，削弱了人类扑灭山火的能力，尤其是那些在极端恶劣天气条件下诱发的火灾。
consequence.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

consequence.en: "Such narratives can lead to maternal exhaustion and have dangerous consequences," they wrote.
consequence.zh: 他们写道：“这种说法可能导致母亲疲惫不堪，并带来危险后果。”
consequence.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

crisis.en: The crisis is here, they said, and we need to cut back on our energy-intensive modelling.
crisis.zh: 他们说，危机已经来临，我们需要减少能源密集型的建模工作。
crisis.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

crisis.en: Many of the answers to the crisis in health and care are well rehearsed.
crisis.zh: 关于医疗和护理危机的许多解决方案其实早已为人熟知。
crisis.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

ensure.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
ensure.zh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
ensure.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

ensure.en: Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand.
ensure.zh: 英国林业协会现在呼吁为实现这些目标注入更大动力，以确保我们拥有足够的木材来满足日益增长的需求。
ensure.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

innovation.en: Whatever we do, innovation will happen.
innovation.zh: 无论我们做什么，创新总会发生。
innovation.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

innovation.en: Between two great wars this technological innovation built a new kind of national consciousness.
innovation.zh: 在两次大战期间，这项技术创新构建了一种全新的民族意识。
innovation.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

moral.en: The moral of the story is simple.
moral.zh: 这个故事的寓意很简单。
moral.src: 2021 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

moral.en: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
moral.zh: 她通过照料者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，对每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及在道德失范行为后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。
moral.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

network.en: If there's congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
network.zh: 如果发生拥堵，或者例如有一辆区间列车发生故障，整个高铁网络都会受到影响。
network.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

network.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
network.zh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
network.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

respond.en: "We know enough to know that this is a concern, but we don't know enough about how to respond to it yet. That's a great area to be doing research."
respond.zh: 我们已经了解到这确实是个问题，但对于如何应对，目前掌握的信息还不够充分。这正是开展研究的绝佳领域。
respond.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

respond.en: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass".
respond.zh: 去年有一份呼吁禁止人造草坪的请愿书征集到了3万个签名，对此政府回应称其“暂无计划禁止人造草坪的使用”。
respond.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

agency.en: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
agency.zh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
agency.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

agency.en: According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 per cent of the world's electricity.
agency.zh: 根据国际能源署的数据，这些建筑目前消耗约占全球1%的电力。
agency.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

attempt.en: As well as thousands of attempts, it takes patience and fieldcraft to anticipate a butterfly's likely flight-line and catch it—in focus.
attempt.zh: 要预判蝴蝶可能的飞行路线并清晰捕捉到它，不仅需要成千上万次的尝试，还需要耐心和实地技巧。

attempt.en: This was an attempt to recover the valuable nails, which could be reused after sifting the ashes.
attempt.zh: 他们这么做是为了回收那些值钱的钉子，将灰烬筛过后，这些钉子就可以重新使用。
attempt.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

commission.en: That's why the California Film Commission and its Los Angeles counterpart, Film LA, now should act, before it's too late.
commission.zh: 正因如此，加州电影委员会及其在洛杉矶的对应机构 Film LA 现在应当采取行动，以免为时已晚。
commission.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

commission.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
commission.zh: 现实情况却截然不同。正如我受文化部门委托对英国公共图书馆进行的独立审查报告所显示的，该报告已于昨日发布。
commission.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

despite.en: Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history.
despite.zh: 尽管到场人数不少，但门票捐赠额却降至了我们历史上的最低点。
despite.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

despite.en: Despite the exciting initial finds, the site would lie undisturbed for decades before archaeologists would return.
despite.zh: 尽管最初的发现令人振奋，但该遗址在考古学家再次前来之前，仍被尘封了数十年。
despite.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

earn.en: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage.
earn.zh: 美国顾客历来会给那些他们认为主要靠小费收入的人小费，比如收入低于最低工资的餐厅服务员。
earn.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

earn.en: Remember that most bestselling authors began writing when they were doing other things to earn a living.
earn.zh: 要知道，大多数畅销书作家都是在从事其他谋生工作时开始写作的。
earn.src: 2022 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

employee.en: But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules.
employee.zh: 但即便有了这些规定，仍有部分员工选择违反规则。
employee.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

employee.en: So, to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to the temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
employee.zh: 因此，为了在不提高价格的情况下增加员工工资，越来越多的雇主正屈服于小费蔓延和小费膨胀的诱惑。
employee.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

negative.en: One simple way to avoid engaging in personalisation and mind reading is to challenge your negative assumptions of what's happened.
negative.zh: 避免陷入‘个人化’和‘读心术’误区的一个简单方法，就是去质疑你对已发生事情的负面假设。
negative.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

negative.en: When you take things personally, you're interpreting these situations as saying something significant and negative about you as a person.
negative.zh: 当你把事情看作是针对个人时，你实际上是将这些情况解读为对自己人格的重大否定。
negative.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

overall.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
overall.zh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
overall.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

overall.en: When we wear clothes that make us feel comfortable and confident, it can positively affect our self-esteem and overall mood.
overall.zh: 当我们穿着令自己感到舒适且自信的衣服时，这能对我们的自尊心和整体情绪产生积极影响。
overall.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

responsibility.en: But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our businesses, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.
responsibility.zh: 但通过在企业内部建立数字责任文化，我们可以创造一个让人工智能提供协助而不泄露秘密的未来。
responsibility.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

responsibility.en: Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation, and access to information.
responsibility.zh: 图书馆和档案馆历来肩负着信息的组织、保存与获取的责任。
responsibility.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

struggle.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
struggle.zh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
struggle.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

struggle.en: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
struggle.zh: 设身处地为他人着想能让我们微调自己的社交理解力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时非常有用。

complex.en: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
complex.zh: 他说：“我们的系统很复杂，没有多余的缓冲空间。只要线路上出现一点小问题，情况就会变得异常棘手。”
complex.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

complex.en: Such mapping doesn't need to be complex, Kotharkar says.
complex.zh: 科萨尔卡尔表示，这种映射不需要很复杂。
complex.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conduct.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
conduct.zh: 现实情况却截然不同。正如我受文化部门委托对英国公共图书馆进行的独立审查报告所显示的，该报告已于昨日发布。
conduct.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conduct.en: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
conduct.zh: 其前提是，普通合同法未能为劳动者提供足够的保护，以抵御管理层的任意行为。
conduct.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

content.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
content.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
content.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

content.en: We were kept afloat by "peak TV", the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.
content.zh: 过去，我们依靠“电视巅峰时代”得以维持，那是流媒体服务爆炸式增长所催生出的内容过剩时期。
content.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

due.en: For millennia, we've known what we've known due to artifacts that have survived, often despite their original creators' neglect.
due.zh: 数千年来，我们所了解的知识往往源于那些历经岁月留存下来的文物，尽管它们的原创造者可能早已将其遗忘。
due.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

due.en: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
due.zh: 通过从市场营销的角度审视工程问题，团队清晰地认识到，用户不愿升级并非产品质量问题。
due.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

importance.en: The study showed the importance of embedding arts in education, she said.
importance.zh: 她说，这项研究表明了将艺术融入教育的重要性。
importance.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

importance.en: The monetary value of the objects on display is a distant second place in importance.
importance.zh: 展出文物的货币价值远居其次。
importance.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

income.en: Tip creep and tipflation are now further supplementing the income of many low-wage service workers.
income.zh: 小费渗透和小费通胀现象如今正进一步补充许多低薪服务工作者的收入。
income.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

income.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
income.zh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
income.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

intend.en: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning – and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
intend.zh: 这些术语还旨在为工作注入意义——正如另一位教授拉凯什·库拉纳所指出的，它们还能增强员工对公司的忠诚度。
intend.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

intend.en: In effect, you try to reconstruct the likely meanings or effects that any given sentence, image or reference might have had: These might be the ones the author intended.
intend.zh: 实际上，你会尝试重构任何特定句子、图像或引用可能具有的潜在含义或效果：这些可能就是作者想要表达的。
intend.src: 2015 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

maintain.en: In an effort to support restoration programmes, specialists are developing supplies of seeds and seedlings, maintaining gene banks and sequencing the genomes of indigenous trees and other crops.
maintain.zh: 为了支持恢复计划，专家们正在增加种子和树苗的供应，维护基因库，并对本土树木和其他作物的基因组进行测序。
maintain.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

maintain.en: Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained?
maintain.zh: 然而，这种普遍获取是如何实现的？或许更重要的是，它又是如何维持的？
maintain.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

range.en: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
range.zh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
range.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

range.en: AI can be a collaborative tool in a wide range of creative endeavors.
range.zh: AI 可以在广泛的创意领域中成为一种协作工具。
range.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

reality.en: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
reality.zh: 但事实是，你的老板可能对你的评价非常高。
reality.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

reality.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
reality.zh: 现实情况却截然不同。正如我受文化部门委托对英国公共图书馆进行的独立审查报告所显示的，该报告已于昨日发布。
reality.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

revenue.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
revenue.zh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
revenue.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

revenue.en: As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.
revenue.zh: 结果，升级量激增，收入增长了92%。
revenue.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

shift.en: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
shift.zh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
shift.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

shift.en: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
shift.zh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
shift.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

threat.en: Some creatures in the forest that multiply fast can become a great threat to forest restoration.
threat.zh: 森林中一些繁殖迅速的生物可能会对森林恢复造成巨大威胁。
threat.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

threat.zh: 他们的威胁一直被低估了。
threat.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

amount.en: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can't track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it's coming from and who's producing it?
amount.zh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中的二氧化碳含量、其来源以及排放者，又怎能告知决策者降低碳排放的最佳方法呢？
amount.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）
