amount.en: This increase is sometimes called tipflation—the expectation of ever-higher tip amounts.
amount.zh: 这种增长有时被称为小费膨胀——即期望获得越来越高的小费金额。
amount.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

attract.en: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
attract.zh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
attract.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

attract.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
attract.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
attract.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

balance.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
balance.zh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
balance.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

balance.zh: 它们可能会影响工作与生活的平衡。
balance.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

feature.en: AI algorithms can analyze facial features and skin conditions to provide personalized beauty recommendations.
feature.zh: AI 算法可以分析面部特征和皮肤状况，从而提供个性化的美容建议。
feature.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

feature.en: They started out as a novelty feature, but as their use has grown, their benefits have extended within our technologically advanced world.
feature.zh: 它们最初只是新奇的特色装置，但随着使用范围的扩大，其优势在我们这个技术先进的世界中得到了进一步拓展。
feature.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

finding.en: Researchers say these findings could help put donkeys in the spotlight.
finding.zh: 研究人员表示，这些发现有助于让驴受到大众的关注。
finding.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

finding.en: The team published their findings in the journal Science this month.
finding.zh: 该团队于本月在《科学》杂志上发表了他们的研究成果。
finding.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

largely.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
largely.zh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
largely.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

largely.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
largely.zh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
largely.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

performance.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

performance.en: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
performance.zh: 这场演出是在11月英国格拉斯哥联合国气候变化大会召开前发出的富有创意的行动号召。
performance.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

preserve.en: Yet researchers can take some comfort in the fact that there are a multitude of librarians devoted to discovering, organizing, and preserving digital information for researchers current and future.
preserve.zh: 然而，研究人员可以稍感慰藉的是，有众多图书管理员致力于为当下及未来的研究人员发现、整理和保存数字信息。
preserve.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

preserve.en: Even when a digital object is preserved, it may only be the carrier that's saved, not the information itself.
preserve.zh: 即使数字对象得到了保存，也可能只是保存了载体，而非信息本身。
preserve.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

privacy.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
privacy.zh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
privacy.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

privacy.en: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
privacy.zh: 联邦贸易委员会在起诉书中指控，“尽管该公司明确做出了隐私承诺，但仍控制了用户的敏感生育数据并将其分享给第三方。”
privacy.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rely.en: Innovation and research have relied on public participation in science for centuries.
rely.zh: 几个世纪以来，创新与研究一直依赖公众对科学的参与。
rely.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

rely.en: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open.
rely.zh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
rely.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

replace.en: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
replace.zh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
replace.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

replace.en: Replacing swing doors, these allow smaller buildings to maximise the usable space inside without having to clear the way for a large, sticking-out door.
replace.zh: 相比传统平开门，自动平移门能让小型建筑最大限度地利用内部空间，无需为向外开启的大型门板预留空间。
replace.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

type.en: Different cultures have their norms and expectations regarding dress, which can influence the types of clothing people wear and the meanings attributed to them.
type.zh: 不同的文化对着装有各自的规范和预期，这会影响人们选择的服装类型及其所代表的含义。
type.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

type.en: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open.
type.zh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
type.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

concept.en: This concept has served as a central goal for curriculum developers, local school boards, business and community leaders, and policymakers ever since its introduction nearly 80 years ago.
concept.zh: 自近80年前被提出以来，这一概念一直是课程开发者、地方学校委员会、商业与社区领袖以及决策者们的中心目标。
concept.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

concept.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
concept.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
concept.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

employment.en: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
employment.zh: 虽然书籍过去是、且应当永远是图书馆的核心，但图书馆也提供许多其他服务，如就业咨询、语言课程以及数字化接入与支持。
employment.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

employment.en: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
employment.zh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
employment.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

humanity.en: "Yet the combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires, particularly those that ignite under the most dangerous weather conditions."
humanity.zh: 然而，森林防火抑制与气候变化的双重影响，削弱了人类扑灭山火的能力，尤其是那些在极端恶劣天气条件下诱发的火灾。
humanity.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

humanity.en: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges.
humanity.zh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
humanity.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

lawyer.en: John Kelly, a construction lawyer at Freeths law firm, believes prices will eventually come down.
lawyer.zh: 弗里斯律师事务所的建筑律师约翰·凯利认为，价格最终会下降。
lawyer.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

lawyer.en: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.
lawyer.zh: 新技术的影响已有足够多是清晰可见、甚至显而易见的，因此法官们能够而且应当为警方、律师和被告提供更新后的指导方针。
lawyer.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

link.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
link.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
link.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

link.en: Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP's surgery.
link.zh: 许多地方都配有驻场护士进行常规健康检查，并与全科医生诊所保持联系。
link.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

status.en: You might see such refusals as implying something negative about the status of your relationship with them.
status.zh: 你可能会把这种拒绝视为暗示你与他们的关系状况存在某种负面问题。
status.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

status.en: Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.
status.zh: 该中心的创始人旨在提高艺术家的地位。
status.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

target.en: "Reducing deaths in an emergency is a good target to have, but it's the lowest target," says climate researcher Chandni Singh.
target.zh: 气候研究员钱德妮·辛格表示：“将紧急情况下的死亡人数降至最低是一个合理目标，但这只是最基本的目标。”
target.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

target.en: The peer-reviewed results showed that the target group of pupils drew on a wider vocabulary, used words "classed as more sophisticated or rarer", and wrote at greater length.
target.zh: 经过同行评审的结果显示，目标学生群体使用的词汇范围更广，会使用“被归类为更复杂或更罕见”的词汇，且写作篇幅更长。
target.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

union.en: The responsibility for the latest wave of strikes rests on the unions.
union.zh: 最近一波罢工的责任在于工会。
union.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

union.en: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
union.zh: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国以及其他几个国家都在认真考虑征收数字服务税。
union.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

academic.en: Anyone can be a citizen scientist, regardless of age, nationality or academic experience.
academic.zh: 无论年龄、国籍或学术经历如何，任何人都可以成为公民科学家。
academic.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

academic.en: Today is no different, with academics, writers, and activists once again warning that technology is replacing human workers.
academic.zh: 如今也不例外，学者、作家和活动家们再次发出警告，称技术正在取代人类劳动者。
academic.src: 2017 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

boost.en: Pay greater attention to boosting rural economies.
boost.zh: 更加重视促进农村经济发展
boost.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

boost.en: Congress allocates only $3 billion a year to the national park system—an amount that has been flat since 2001 (in inflation-adjusted dollars) with the exception of a onetime boost in 2009.
boost.zh: 国会每年仅为国家公园系统拨款30亿美元——经通货膨胀调整后，这一金额自2001年以来基本持平，仅在2009年有过一次临时增加。
boost.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

contact.en: The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
contact.zh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来实现知识交流、提供选择和展现不同声音。
contact.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

contact.en: Biological factors behind eye contact are being investigated
contact.zh: 眼神交流背后的生物学因素正在研究中
contact.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

exist.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
exist.zh: 今年夏天，当您尽情享受家门口的街道节庆时，希望您能记住，正是有了社区的支持，这些活动才得以存在。
exist.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

exist.en: What does the author imply about existing health privacy law?
exist.zh: 作者对现有健康隐私法暗示了什么？
exist.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

explore.en: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
explore.zh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
explore.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

explore.en: Chaudhary said that Britain should explore the possibility that older siblings helping their parents "might also enhance their own social development".
explore.zh: 乔杜里表示，英国应当探索让哥哥姐姐帮助父母照料弟妹这一可能性，这"或许也能促进他们自身的社会发展"。
explore.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

giant.en: That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants.
giant.zh: 这可能需要增加联邦资金，用于开展独立于科技巨头的研究。
giant.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

giant.en: It caused conflicts among tech giants.
giant.zh: 这导致了科技巨头之间的冲突。
giant.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

highly.en: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
highly.zh: 但事实是，你的老板可能对你的评价非常高。
highly.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

highly.en: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
highly.zh: 他说：“我们的系统很复杂，没有多余的缓冲空间。只要线路上出现一点小问题，情况就会变得异常棘手。”
highly.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

insurance.en: Security, entertainment, portable restrooms, insurance and even basics such as fencing and staffing have all become significantly more expensive.
insurance.zh: 安保、娱乐、移动厕所、保险，甚至围栏和人员配备等基础项目的成本都大幅上涨了。
insurance.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

insurance.zh: 这让保险公司感到失望。
insurance.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

organization.en: Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation, and access to information.
organization.zh: 图书馆和档案馆历来肩负着信息的组织、保存与获取的责任。
organization.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

organization.en: Recent research from the Organization for the Review of Care and Health Applications found that 350,000 health apps were available on the market, 90,000 of which launched in 2020 alone.
organization.zh: 护理与健康应用审查组织的最新研究发现，市场上有35万个健康应用程序，其中仅2020年就推出了9万个。
organization.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

regulation.en: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations.
regulation.zh: 高空平台系统还可以指导住宅翻新工作或修改建筑法规。
regulation.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

regulation.en: The group is in its early days of mobilization, which could involve pushing for new policies or regulation.
regulation.zh: 该团体正处于动员初期，未来可能会推动新政策或法规的制定。
regulation.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

relationship.en: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species.
relationship.zh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
relationship.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

relationship.en: You might see such refusals as implying something negative about the status of your relationship with them.
relationship.zh: 你可能会把这种拒绝视为暗示你与他们的关系状况存在某种负面问题。
relationship.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

specific.en: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open.
specific.zh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
specific.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

specific.en: Students who stand out in a specific extracurricular activity will be favored by top-tier institutions.
specific.zh: 在特定课外活动中表现突出的学生将受到顶尖院校的青睐。
specific.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

strategy.en: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the heavy price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.
strategy.zh: 更糟糕的是，当国家肥胖战略这类政策被取消后，纳税人最终要为治疗由此引发的糖尿病等疾病支付高昂费用。
strategy.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

strategy.en: Much more important are the places we live, work and socialise—yet there is no clear cross-government strategy for improving these social determinants of health.
strategy.zh: 更为重要的是我们生活、工作和社交的场所——然而，目前并没有明确的跨政府战略来改善这些健康的社会决定因素。
strategy.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

supreme.en: On Tuesday, the appeals court unanimously upheld the 2017 order deregulating broadband providers, citing a Supreme Court ruling from 2005 that upheld a similarly deregulatory move.
supreme.zh: 周二，上诉法院一致维持了2017年那份放松宽带提供商监管的命令，并援引了最高法院2005年的一项裁决，该裁决同样支持了放松监管的举措。
supreme.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

supreme.en: It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.
supreme.zh: 最高法院对此表示欢迎。
supreme.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

appeal.en: So what's the appeal of a long, sweaty day in pursuit of an elusive, fast-moving wild animal?
appeal.zh: 那么，花上漫长而汗流浃背的一天，去追逐一只难以捉摸、行动迅速的野生动物，究竟有什么吸引力呢？

appeal.en: "They were a symbol of fragile life, of hope and defiance, and something appealed to my soul."
appeal.zh: 它们象征着脆弱的生命、希望与抗争，有某种东西触动了我的灵魂。

association.en: This deficit is a testament to the effectiveness of modern firefighting, said Kelly Martin, a past president of the International Association of Wildland Fire.
association.zh: 国际野地火灾协会前任主席凯利·马丁表示，这一缺口证明了现代消防工作的卓有成效。
association.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

association.en: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors.
association.zh: 然而，当地房地产经纪人协会首席执行官瑞安·卡斯尔指出，短期租赁也为游客提供了住宿。
association.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

criticism.en: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
criticism.zh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
criticism.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

criticism.en: Lesser-known PRH writers become the target of criticism.
criticism.zh: 那些知名度较低的企鹅兰登书屋作家正成为这场风波的受害者。
criticism.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

essential.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
essential.zh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
essential.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

essential.en: Accessing databases is essential to researchers.
essential.zh: 访问数据库对研究人员来说至关重要。
essential.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

establish.en: Established in an old paper mill, it is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people who live in the surrounding town of Kajaani.
establish.zh: 它建于一座旧造纸厂内，由附近的河流提供动力，其远程供暖系统为居住在周边卡亚尼镇的居民供暖。
establish.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

establish.en: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
establish.zh: 英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)成立之初便极具远见：提供高质量、及时的医疗服务，以满足其所服务人群的主要需求。
establish.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

immigrant.en: Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants.
immigrant.zh: 美国大约一半的农场劳工是无证移民。
immigrant.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

immigrant.en: The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic more than a hundred years after the 15th- and 16th-century explorations of North America.
immigrant.zh: 在15和16世纪北美探索活动的一百多年后，第一批满载移民的船只跨越大西洋，驶向如今美国所在的领土。
immigrant.src: 2015 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

judge.en: She found similar interference when participants watched 15-second clips of pairs of people and judged whether they were strangers, friends, or dating partners.
judge.zh: 当参与者观看15秒的双人片段并判断他们是陌生人、朋友还是约会对象时，她发现了类似的干扰现象。
judge.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

judge.en: It has been opposed by a judge.
judge.zh: 一位法官已否决了这一决定。
judge.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

particular.en: As a result, scientists — physicists in particular — found themselves in high demand.
particular.zh: 因此，科学家们——尤其是物理学家——发现自己变得非常吃香。
particular.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

particular.en: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.
particular.zh: 植物产生的挥发性化学物质可以传播很远，并且具有非常独特的特征：每种植物或树木都有其特定的气味特征。
particular.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

peer.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
peer.zh: 从预期寿命到癌症及婴儿死亡率，我们都落后于许多同类国家。
peer.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

peer.en: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
peer.zh: 其他科学家也免费从事专业的同行评审工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心要素。
peer.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

per.en: According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 per cent of the world's electricity.
per.zh: 根据国际能源署的数据，这些建筑目前消耗约占全球1%的电力。
per.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

per.en: Meanwhile, the number of annual visitors has increased by more than 50% since 1980, and now stands at 330 million visitors per year.
per.zh: 与此同时，自1980年以来，年游客量增长了50%以上，目前已达到每年3.3亿人次。
per.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

positive.en: Most of us strive for self-respect — to see ourselves in a positive light, to be proud of who we are.
positive.zh: 我们大多数人都在追求自尊——希望以积极的眼光看待自己，并为自己的身份感到自豪。
positive.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

positive.en: A new study published in the journal Child Development, by Eveline Crone of the University of Leiden and colleagues, suggests that the positive and negative sides of teenagers go hand in hand.
positive.zh: 莱顿大学的伊芙琳·克朗(Eveline Crone)及其同事在《儿童发展》(Child Development)杂志上发表的一项新研究表明，青少年的积极面和消极面是并存的。
positive.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

publication.en: What is important is not truth, but publication, which has become almost an end in itself.
publication.zh: 重要的不是真相，而是发表论文，发表论文本身几乎已成为目的。
publication.src: 2019 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

publication.en: Boiling down an individual's output to simple metrics, such as number of publications or journal impacts, entails considerable savings in time, energy and ambiguity.
publication.zh: 将个人成果简化为简单的指标，如发表论文数量或期刊影响因子，确实能大幅节省时间、精力，并减少评估中的模糊性。
publication.src: 2019 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

web.en: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives.
web.zh: WhatsApp为Facebook提供的，是其用户的友谊和社交生活所构成的一个复杂而精细的网络。
web.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

web.en: During the 2016 presidential campaign, nearly a quarter of web content shared by Twitter users in the politically critical state of Michigan was fake news, according to the University of Oxford.
web.zh: 牛津大学的研究显示，在2016年总统竞选期间，在政治关键州密歇根州，Twitter用户分享的网络内容中近四分之一是虚假新闻。
web.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

associate.en: (And yes, all these benefits are more closely associated with physical books than digital ones.)
associate.zh: （没错，所有这些优点与纸质书的相关性都要比电子书更高。）

associate.en: Mandatory in-person renewal was associated with a 31 percent reduction in fatal crashes involving drivers 85 or older, according to one study.
associate.zh: 一项研究显示，强制本人到场续领驾照与85岁及以上驾驶员致命车祸减少31%相关。
associate.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

capacity.en: "We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there's a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex," he said.
capacity.zh: 他说：“我们的系统很复杂，没有多余的缓冲空间。只要线路上出现一点小问题，情况就会变得异常棘手。”
capacity.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

capacity.en: But lack of capacity is another problem.
capacity.zh: 但能力不足（或产能不足）是另一个问题。
capacity.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

critical.en: This is a reaction to Hollywood's decline, which is reaching a critical point for the industry and Southern California.
critical.zh: 这是对好莱坞衰落的一种回应，而这种衰落正使该产业以及南加州地区陷入危急关头。
critical.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

critical.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
critical.zh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
critical.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

historical.en: In the study, the researchers compared the historical fire cadence with the wildfires recorded over the past few decades, and uncovered a striking shortfall.
historical.zh: 研究人员在研究中将历史火灾频率与过去几十年记录的野火进行了对比，发现两者之间存在显著差距。
historical.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

historical.en: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
historical.zh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
historical.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

purchase.en: In the early 2010s, a wide range of businesses started processing purchases with iPads and other digital payment systems.
purchase.zh: 2010年代初期，各类企业开始使用iPad和其他数字支付系统处理交易。
purchase.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

purchase.en: Having said that, I do feel that whatever artifacts find their way to public museums should, in fact, be sanctioned as having been obtained on loan, legally purchased, or obtained by treaty.
purchase.zh: 话虽如此，我确实认为，任何进入公共博物馆的文物，事实上都应当是以租借、合法购买或条约获取等正当方式获得的。
purchase.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

requirement.en: They tend to fall short of official requirements.
requirement.zh: 它们往往达不到官方要求。
requirement.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

requirement.en: Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
requirement.zh: 目前，英国木材需求量中仅有20%来自本土供应，而该国仍是全球第二大木材净进口国。
requirement.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reward.en: That timing could reward high-quality service and give workers an incentive to provide it.
reward.zh: 这种时间安排能够奖励高质量服务，并激励员工提供优质服务。
reward.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reward.en: "Reward sensitivity" measures how much reward it takes to outweigh risk.
reward.zh: "奖励敏感性"衡量的是需要多少奖励才能抵消风险。
reward.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

solution.en: In other words, don't throw old solutions under the bus to make your improvement stand out.
solution.zh: 换句话说，不要贬低旧方案来凸显你的改进。
solution.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

solution.en: Everyone wants to be that person—the one who looks at the same information as everyone else, but who sees a fresh, innovative solution.
solution.zh: 每个人都想成为那样的人——与其他人看到相同的信息，却能想出全新且富有创意的解决方案。
solution.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

ban.en: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations.
ban.zh: 根据我们的研究，25%的受访者已决定在组织内彻底禁止使用人工智能，或对其使用进行规范。
ban.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

ban.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
ban.zh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
ban.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

belief.en: And while it is wonderful to take a walk with anything in your headphones, infinite choice encourages us to shrink into niche interests and sympathetic beliefs.
belief.zh: 虽然戴着耳机随心所欲地漫步确实惬意，但无穷无尽的选择也在促使我们萎缩在小众兴趣和同质化的信念之中。
belief.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

belief.en: Much of the time, however, this belief is false.
belief.zh: 然而，在大多数情况下，这种想法是错误的。
belief.src: 2021 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

congress.en: He asked Jackson to print out large copies and distributed them, along with reproductions of Moran's paintings, to each member of Congress.
congress.zh: 他请杰克逊冲印了大幅照片，并将这些照片连同莫兰画作的复制品一起分发给每位国会议员。

congress.en: The bill proved largely popular and sailed through Congress with large majorities in favor.
congress.zh: 该法案获得了广泛支持，并以压倒性多数在国会顺利通过。

emerge.en: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
emerge.zh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

emerge.en: Self-sliding doors began to emerge as a commercial product in 1960 after being invented six years previously by Americans Dee Horton and Lew Hewitt.
emerge.zh: 自滑动门由美国人迪·霍顿(Dee Horton)和卢·休伊特(Lew Hewitt)于六年前发明，1960年开始作为商业产品问世。
emerge.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

journalist.en: What political journalist, what party whip, would not want to know the makeup of the WhatsApp groups in which Theresa May's enemies are currently plotting?
journalist.zh: 哪个政治记者、哪个党鞭不想知道特蕾莎·梅的政敌们目前正在哪些WhatsApp群组里密谋策划呢？
journalist.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

journalist.zh: 新闻记者需要更严格的行业监管。
journalist.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

jury.en: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
jury.zh: 陪审团也被认为是现存最能体现直接民主而非代议制民主的典范。
jury.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

jury.en: This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
jury.zh: 这种做法的理由是女性需要留在家中，这使得整个20世纪60年代的陪审团都无法代表女性群体。
jury.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

majority.en: Specifically, a 5-4 majority decided that wetlands protected by the EPA under its Clean Water Act authority must have a "continuous surface connection" to bodies of water.
majority.zh: 具体而言，以5票对4票的多数意见裁定，美国环境保护局根据《清洁水法》授权所保护的湿地必须与水体具有“持续的地表连接”。
majority.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

majority.en: The bill proved largely popular and sailed through Congress with large majorities in favor.
majority.zh: 该法案获得了广泛支持，并以压倒性多数在国会顺利通过。

mass.en: However, the signaling in a plant is only superficially similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity," Taiz said.
mass.zh: 然而，泰兹指出，植物体内的信号传导与复杂动物大脑中的神经冲动只是表面相似，而动物大脑远不止是'一团通过电流进行交流的细胞'。
mass.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

mass.en: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
mass.zh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
mass.src: 2021 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

possibility.en: While AI offers exciting possibilities, it also raises ethical concerns.
possibility.zh: 人工智能在带来令人兴奋的可能性的同时，也引发了伦理方面的担忧。
possibility.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

possibility.en: Not to mention, if the process you're scrapping is one someone else suggested, there's the possibility of hurt feelings.
possibility.zh: 更不用说，如果你要放弃的流程是别人建议的，那还有可能会伤害到对方的感情。
possibility.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

prospect.en: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
prospect.zh: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论人士认为短期内似乎不太可能出台全面的联邦隐私法规。
prospect.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

prospect.en: Although only a research project at this stage, the request has raised the prospect of regulators wading into early-stage tech markets that until now have been beyond their reach.
prospect.zh: 尽管目前这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已经引发了监管机构介入早期科技市场的可能性，而这些市场此前一直是他们难以触及的领域。
prospect.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reflect.en: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood, and identity.
reflect.zh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
reflect.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

reflect.en: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
reflect.zh: 此类争论反映了全美范围内的激烈讨论，研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生都在不断呼吁，要求学校更加重视气候变化事实的教学。
reflect.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

remove.en: It swiftly became an obsession as he recovered from a successful operation to remove the cancer.
remove.zh: 在他成功接受癌症切除手术后康复期间，这件事迅速成为了他的执念。

remove.en: The credit limit will be removed.
remove.zh: 信用额度限制将会被取消。
remove.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

represent.en: It inspired me to learn more about the culture that it represented.
represent.zh: 它激发了我去更多地了解这件雕塑所代表的文化。
represent.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

represent.en: Simply, there are people in Nigeria who cannot travel to the Smithsonian Institution to see that part of their history and culture represented by the Benin Bronzes.
represent.zh: 简而言之，尼日利亚有些人无法前往史密森学会，去亲眼目睹贝宁青铜器所代表的那部分本国历史与文化。
represent.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

signal.en: Each automatic door system analyses the light, sound, weight or movement in its vicinity as a signal to open.
signal.zh: 每个自动门系统都会分析其附近的光线、声音、重量或移动情况，并将这些作为开门信号。
signal.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

signal.en: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open.
signal.zh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
signal.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

statement.en: "Through their DNA, the animals are telling their history themselves," co-author Samantha Brooks, an equine researcher at the University of Florida, says in a statement.
statement.zh: 佛罗里达大学马类研究员、论文共同作者萨曼莎·布鲁克斯在一份声明中表示：‘这些动物正通过它们的 DNA 亲自讲述着自己的历史。’
statement.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

statement.en: What message is conveyed in Brooks' statement?
statement.zh: 布鲁克斯的陈述传达了什么信息？
statement.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

tip.en: However, many customers are frustrated because they feel they are being asked for too high of a tip, too often.
tip.zh: 然而，许多顾客感到不满，因为他们觉得被索要的小费过高、过于频繁。
tip.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

tip.en: So, to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to the temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
tip.zh: 因此，为了在不提高价格的情况下增加员工工资，越来越多的雇主正屈服于小费蔓延和小费膨胀的诱惑。
tip.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

understanding.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
understanding.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
understanding.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

understanding.en: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
understanding.zh: 设身处地为他人着想能让我们微调自己的社交理解力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时非常有用。

agent.en: They are the agents of restoration.
agent.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

agent.en: "This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power," says literary agent Andrew Lownie.
agent.zh: 文学经纪人安德鲁·劳尼表示：“这一切都是权力集中这一更大趋势的一部分。”
agent.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

analysis.en: Genetic analysis offers insight into the history of donkeys.
analysis.zh: 基因分析为研究驴的历史提供了见解。
analysis.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

analysis.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
analysis.zh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
analysis.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

beauty.en: Additionally, AI-powered beauty filters and editing tools can lead to distorted self-perception and contribute to body dissatisfaction.
beauty.zh: 此外，人工智能驱动的美颜滤镜和编辑工具可能会导致自我认知失真，并加剧对身材的不满。
beauty.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

beauty.en: There is a risk of deepening societal beauty pressures and perpetuating unattainable beauty standards.
beauty.zh: 这存在加深社会审美压力并使不可及的审美标准持续存在的风险。
beauty.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

character.en: Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes, characters and mental states.
character.zh: 当我们模拟场景、角色和心理状态时，大脑的不同区域会参与其中。

character.en: A moralist, satirist, and social reformer, Dickens crafted complex plots and striking characters that capture the panorama of English society.
character.zh: 作为道德家、讽刺作家和社会改革家，狄更斯精心设计了复杂的情节和鲜明的人物，捕捉了英国社会的全貌。

cite.en: The "ZIP disk" is cited as an example to show ________.
cite.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cite.en: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
cite.zh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
cite.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conclude.en: That fall, they concluded the survey in Fort Bridger, Wyoming.
conclude.zh: 那年秋天，他们在怀俄明州的布里杰堡完成了这项调查。

conclude.en: What can be concluded about Generation Z from the last two paragraphs?
conclude.zh: 从最后两段中可以得出关于Z世代的什么结论？
conclude.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

connection.en: Long gaps there saw increased connection.
connection.zh: 这些长时间的间隔反而促进了更强的联系。
connection.src: 2025 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

connection.en: But such feelings of connection markedly dip when entering a long gap.
connection.zh: 但当进入一段长时间的间隔时，这种连接感会显著下降。
connection.src: 2025 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

conservation.en: "When you talk about conservation or restoration, the first question has to be restoration by whom, for whom?" says Daniel Janzen, a biologist at the University of Pennsylvania.
conservation.zh: “当你谈论保护或修复时，第一个问题必须是：由谁来修复，为了谁修复？”宾夕法尼亚大学的生物学家丹尼尔·詹森（Daniel Janzen）说道。
conservation.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

conservation.en: One of the turning points in public support for land conservation efforts—and recognizing the magnificence of the Yellowstone region in particular—came in the form of vivid photographs.
conservation.zh: 公众对土地保护工作的支持，尤其是对黄石地区壮丽景色的认识，其转折点之一便是这些生动的照片。

construction.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
construction.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
construction.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

construction.en: The miracle of the Chesapeake Bay lies not in its depths, but in the complexity of its natural construction, the interaction of fresh and saline waters, and the mix of land and water.
construction.zh: 切萨皮克湾的奇迹不在于其深度，而在于其复杂的自然构造、淡水与咸水的交汇融合，以及陆地与水域的相互交织。
construction.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

critic.en: To Microsoft's critics, the fates of Wunderlist and Sunrise are examples of a remorseless drive by Big Tech to chew up any innovative companies that lie in their path.
critic.zh: 在微软的批评者看来，Wunderlist和Sunrise的命运是科技巨头无情打压创新企业的例证——它们会吞噬任何阻碍其发展道路的创新公司。
critic.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

critic.en: "Hooray! At last!" wrote Anthony Tommasini, a sober-sided classical-music critic.
critic.zh: “太棒了！终于尘埃落定了！”以严肃著称的古典音乐评论家安东尼·托马西尼如是写道。
critic.src: 2011 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

employer.en: Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage.
employer.zh: 雇主需要像对待任何其他形式的数据共享或存储一样，以同等的谨慎程度来管理人工智能工具。
employer.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

employer.en: Employers are taking note and taking action.
employer.zh: 雇主们正对此予以关注并采取行动。
employer.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

enhance.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
enhance.zh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
enhance.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

enhance.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
enhance.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
enhance.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

failure.en: Psychologists have been interested in this question for decades, not least because people's widespread reluctance to ask for help has led to some high-profile failures.
failure.zh: 心理学家对这个问题的研究已有数十年之久，尤其是因为人们普遍不愿寻求帮助，这已导致了一些备受瞩目的失败案例。
failure.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

failure.en: The UK is facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood, Confor has warned.
failure.zh: 英国林业与木材贸易协会（Confor）警告称，由于未能通过植树造林来保障木材供应，英国正面临未来的建筑业危机。
failure.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

favor.en: Students who stand out in a specific extracurricular activity will be favored by top-tier institutions.
favor.zh: 在特定课外活动中表现突出的学生将受到顶尖院校的青睐。
favor.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

favor.en: The bill proved largely popular and sailed through Congress with large majorities in favor.
favor.zh: 该法案获得了广泛支持，并以压倒性多数在国会顺利通过。

imply.en: You might see such refusals as implying something negative about the status of your relationship with them.
imply.zh: 你可能会把这种拒绝视为暗示你与他们的关系状况存在某种负面问题。
imply.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

imply.en: What does the author imply about existing health privacy law?
imply.zh: 作者对现有健康隐私法暗示了什么？
imply.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

indeed.en: Indeed, it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and stock up on supplies for their own journeys.
indeed.zh: 事实上，这里往往是商人们寻找销售商品并为自己的旅程补充 supplies 的第一站。
indeed.src: 2023 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

indeed.en: With the pandemic, unemployment is very high indeed.
indeed.zh: 疫情期间，失业率确实非常高。
indeed.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

invest.en: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.
invest.zh: 专家表示，RFI（意大利铁路网公司）多年来持续投入的高密度技术和卫星信号技术也将带来进一步的提升。
invest.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

invest.en: Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years.
invest.zh: 意大利国家铁路公司（Ferrovie）将在未来10年内投入总计1240亿欧元的资金用于基础设施建设。
invest.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

previous.en: Because flammable material couldn't build up on the landscape, blazes tended to move slowly and peter out when they reached the footprints of previous burns.
previous.zh: 由于易燃物无法在地面上堆积，火势往往蔓延缓慢，并在蔓延至先前的过火区域时逐渐熄灭。
previous.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

previous.en: One previous study looked at the Efé people of the Democratic Republic of Congo.
previous.zh: 此前有一项研究关注了刚果民主共和国的埃费族人。
previous.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

recognize.en: Contributions of librarians should be recognized.
recognize.zh: 图书馆员的贡献应当得到认可。
recognize.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

recognize.en: The real value of artifacts can only be recognized in their countries of origin rather than anywhere else.
recognize.zh: 文物的真正价值只有在其原产国才能被认知，而非其他任何地方。
recognize.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

resource.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
resource.zh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
resource.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

resource.en: New research suggests that smell is a crucial factor in guiding elephants—and probably other herbivores—to the best food resources.
resource.zh: 新研究表明，嗅觉是引导大象——很可能还有其他食草动物——找到最佳食物资源的关键因素。
resource.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

select.en: With multiple networks and countless podcasts, a smartphone user selects what to hear and when.
select.zh: 面对众多的网络平台和无数的播客节目，智能手机用户可以自主选择收听的内容和时间。
select.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

select.en: Elephants are very choosy eaters, but until recently little was known about how they selected their food.
select.zh: 大象在饮食方面非常挑剔，但直到最近，人们对它们如何选择食物仍知之甚少。
select.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

threaten.en: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model.
threaten.zh: 越来越多的美国人选择在退休后继续工作，这一日益增长的趋势可能会颠覆旧有的劳动力模式。
threaten.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

threaten.en: Discussing the issue in private will make the powerful person feel less threatened.
threaten.zh: 私下讨论这个问题会让位高权重者感觉威胁较小。
threaten.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

track.en: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
track.zh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
track.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

track.en: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can't track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it's coming from and who's producing it?
track.zh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中的二氧化碳含量、其来源以及排放者，又怎能告知决策者降低碳排放的最佳方法呢？
track.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

unique.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
unique.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
unique.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

unique.en: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
unique.zh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
unique.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

ambition.en: If the world is to meet its net-zero ambitions, we must think hard about how we can deliver sustainable computing and deliver more LUMIs.
ambition.zh: 若要实现全球净零排放的宏伟目标，我们必须认真思考如何提供可持续计算，并打造更多类似LUMI的超级计算机。
ambition.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ambition.en: While the UK government has stated its ambition for more tree planting, there has been little action on the ground.
ambition.zh: 尽管英国政府已表达了扩大植树规模的雄心，但实际行动却寥寥无几。
ambition.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

asset.en: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
asset.zh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
asset.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

asset.en: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
asset.zh: 新的人工智能技术集中度尤其高：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占据了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。
asset.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

assume.en: This is when you assume to know what other people are thinking about you, when you can't really know without asking them directly.
assume.zh: 这指的是在没有直接询问的情况下，你就假定自己知道别人对你的看法。
assume.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

assume.en: As the war unfolded, science rapidly assumed a central role.
assume.zh: 随着战争的展开，科学迅速占据了中心地位。
assume.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

basis.en: Their North American tree-ring fire-scar network (NAFSN) provided the basis for a study published last month.
basis.zh: 他们建立的北美树木年轮火灾遗迹网络 (NAFSN) 为上个月发表的一项研究提供了基础。
basis.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

basis.en: Light was something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration.
basis.zh: 光正是艺术家和科学家共同感兴趣的东西，因此可以成为合作的基础。
basis.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

colleague.en: They have their reasons — around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
colleague.zh: 他们有自己的理由——约 63% 的人表示使用 AI 提高了他们的生产力，有些人甚至觉得 AI 比人类同事提供的帮助更多。
colleague.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

colleague.en: A new study published in the journal Child Development, by Eveline Crone of the University of Leiden and colleagues, suggests that the positive and negative sides of teenagers go hand in hand.
colleague.zh: 莱顿大学的伊芙琳·克朗(Eveline Crone)及其同事在《儿童发展》(Child Development)杂志上发表的一项新研究表明，青少年的积极面和消极面是并存的。
colleague.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

commercial.en: Without the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential in improving disabled access to buildings and helping provide general convenience to commercial buildings.
commercial.zh: 自动门无需手动触碰即可开关，对于改善残障人士的建筑物出入条件以及为商业建筑提供普遍便利至关重要。
commercial.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

commercial.en: Artists say they risk losing income as people start using AI-generated images based on copyrighted material for commercial purposes.
commercial.zh: 艺术家们表示，随着人们开始将基于受版权保护材料生成的AI图像用于商业目的，他们面临着收入损失的风险。
commercial.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

directly.en: This is when you assume to know what other people are thinking about you, when you can't really know without asking them directly.
directly.zh: 这指的是在没有直接询问的情况下，你就假定自己知道别人对你的看法。
directly.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

directly.en: Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of Chicago as a whole.
directly.zh: 芝加哥的夏季音乐节不仅是娱乐活动，更是直接惠及所在社区乃至整个芝加哥市的经济引擎。
directly.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

function.en: But while aging is inevitable, scientists are finding out that certain changes in brain function may not be.
function.zh: 但是，尽管衰老是不可避免的，科学家们却发现，大脑功能的某些变化或许并非如此。
function.src: 2021 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

function.en: It turns out that the brain needs exercise in much the same way our muscles do, and the right mental workouts can significantly improve our basic cognitive functions.
function.zh: 事实证明，大脑和我们的肌肉一样，也需要锻炼；而适当的脑力训练可以显著改善我们的基本认知功能。
function.src: 2014 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

gender.en: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provides a case in point.
gender.zh: 马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德提出的两项法案旨在确保各委员会和董事会实现"性别平等"，这就是一个恰当的例子。
gender.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

gender.en: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
gender.zh: 这些法案与加州最近通过的一项措施类似，加州去年成为首个要求私营公司实行性别配额的州。
gender.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

generate.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
generate.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
generate.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

generate.en: At the same time AI can also be used to generate content for social media posts and chat sites.
generate.zh: 同时，人工智能还可用于为社交媒体帖子和聊天网站生成内容。
generate.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

illustrate.en: The example of Green in Paragraph 5 is used to illustrate ________.
illustrate.zh: 第5段中的格林的例子是用来说明________。
illustrate.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

illustrate.en: With characteristic confidence, Dickens successfully insisted that Seymour's pictures illustrate his own story instead.
illustrate.zh: 狄更斯以其特有的自信，坚持要求西摩的插画应转而描绘他自己的故事，这一要求最终获得了成功。

indicate.en: "Our findings indicate that people do not only feel different when they are the centre of attention but that their brain reactions also differ."
indicate.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，当人们成为关注的焦点时，他们不仅会有不同的感受，其大脑反应也会有所不同。
indicate.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

indicate.en: "This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
indicate.zh: 巴纳集团总编辑罗克珊·斯通表示：“这表明，在应对这一问题上，个人确实负有重大责任。”
indicate.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

infrastructure.en: Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years.
infrastructure.zh: 意大利国家铁路公司（Ferrovie）将在未来10年内投入总计1240亿欧元的资金用于基础设施建设。
infrastructure.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

infrastructure.en: The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
infrastructure.zh: 意大利国家铁路公司表示，该国陈旧基础设施的大规模改造工程是造成交通中断的部分原因。
infrastructure.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

net.en: Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
net.zh: 目前，英国木材需求量中仅有20%来自本土供应，而该国仍是全球第二大木材净进口国。
net.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

net.en: The rules, which came into effect on Wednesday in England, are part of government plans to reduce the UK's carbon emissions to net zero by 2050.
net.zh: 这些新规于周三在英格兰生效，是英国政府计划的一部分，旨在到2050年将英国的碳排放降至净零水平。
net.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

payment.en: The prevalence of digital payment devices has made it easier to ask customers for a tip.
payment.zh: 数字支付设备的普及使得向顾客索要小费变得更加容易。
payment.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

payment.en: In the early 2010s, a wide range of businesses started processing purchases with iPads and other digital payment systems.
payment.zh: 2010年代初期，各类企业开始使用iPad和其他数字支付系统处理交易。
payment.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

principle.en: The development in 1915 of the popular new subject "general science" was another effort to train students to apply the principles of science to everyday, nonscience problems.
principle.zh: 1915年，广受欢迎的新学科“综合科学”得到发展，这是培养学生将科学原理应用于日常非科学问题的又一次尝试。
principle.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

principle.en: Although these methods differ, the main principles remain the same.
principle.zh: 尽管这些方法各不相同，但其主要原理保持一致。
principle.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

style.en: Whether we opt for bold, colorful outfits or prefer more understated styles, our dress choices convey messages about who we are and how we want to be perceived.
style.zh: 无论我们选择大胆鲜艳的装扮，还是倾向于低调内敛的风格，我们的着装都在传递信息，展现我们的个性以及我们希望在他人眼中的形象。
style.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

style.en: A Polish digital artist who uses classical painting styles to create dreamy fantasy landscapes, Greg Rutkowski has made illustrations for games such as Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering.
style.zh: 格雷格·鲁特科夫斯基是一位波兰数字艺术家，他运用古典绘画风格创作梦幻般的奇幻风景，曾为《龙与地下城》和《万智牌》等游戏绘制插画。
style.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

willing.en: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
willing.zh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
willing.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

willing.en: Some 81% of respondents said they would be willing to pay additional taxes for the next 10 years to avoid any cuts to the national parks.
willing.zh: 约81%的受访者表示，他们愿意在未来10年缴纳额外税款，以避免国家公园的任何经费削减。
willing.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

advocate.en: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
advocate.zh: 在新罕布什尔州，租金空置率已降至1%以下，住房权益倡导者担心，不受监管的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。
advocate.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

advocate.en: As a fellow environmentalist, animal-protection advocate and longtime vegetarian, I could properly be in the same camp as Emma Marris on the issue of zoos.
advocate.zh: 作为一名环保主义者、动物保护倡导者和长期素食者，在动物园这个问题上，我本可以和艾玛·马里斯站在同一阵营。
advocate.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

application.en: For example, try, "I can see lots of applications for this new approach" rather than, "This innovation is the only way."
application.zh: 例如，可以说“我能看到这种新方法有很多应用场景”，而不是“这项创新是唯一的途径”。
application.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

application.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
application.zh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
application.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

charge.en: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
charge.zh: 此处不收取任何费用，也绝不会要求你进行辩解或说明；我们只会简单地欢迎你，在你需要时提供帮助，并在你不需要时不去打扰。
charge.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

charge.en: Domingos says, "Before, they might not insure the ones who felt like a high risk or charge them too much, or they would charge them too little and then it would cost the company money."
charge.zh: 多明戈斯表示：“以前，他们可能不会为那些看似高风险的人提供保险，或者向他们收取过高费用，又或者收费过低，最终导致公司蒙受损失。”
charge.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

emphasize.en: Human factors, as well as trees planted, should be emphasized in forest restoration.
emphasize.zh: 在森林恢复过程中，不仅要注重植树造林，还应强调人的因素。
emphasize.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

emphasize.en: Which of the following is emphasized in the text?
emphasize.zh: 文中强调了下列哪一项？
emphasize.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

evolution.en: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
evolution.zh: 这场冲突凸显了公共空间自发的、用户驱动的演变与打造视觉上精心策划和受控制的城市环境的愿望之间持续存在的矛盾。
evolution.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

evolution.en: On one hand, that viewpoint is a logical product of America's evolution.
evolution.zh: 一方面，这种观点是美国发展演变的必然产物。
evolution.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expression.en: Between friends, longer gaps seem to provide natural moments for reflection and expression.
expression.zh: 在朋友之间，较长时间的间隔似乎能自然地提供反思和表达的契机。
expression.src: 2025 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

expression.en: Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression.
expression.zh: 尤为重要的是他对自由的看法，在他看来，自由与个人的权利和责任息息相关：他倡导思想自由和个人表达自由。
expression.src: 2014 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

ignore.en: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
ignore.zh: 由于无法判断用户是真的反对行为广告，还是只是沿用了微软的默认设置，一些广告商可能会无视DNT信号，继续追踪用户。
ignore.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ignore.zh: 快时尚产业忽视可持续发展。
ignore.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

learning.en: the change in instruction enhances learning outcomes
learning.zh: 教学指令的改变提高了学习成果
learning.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

learning.en: It may reform our learning approach.
learning.zh: 这可能会改变我们的学习方式。
learning.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

powerful.en: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
powerful.zh: 这种合作方式既能催生新的研究，也能孕育出富有感染力的艺术作品。
powerful.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

powerful.en: Here's how to disagree with someone more powerful than you.
powerful.zh: 以下是如何向上级表达不同意见的方法。
powerful.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

stock.en: Indeed, it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and stock up on supplies for their own journeys.
stock.zh: 事实上，这里往往是商人们寻找销售商品并为自己的旅程补充 supplies 的第一站。
stock.src: 2023 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

stock.zh: 他们的库存量被低估了。
stock.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

suffer.en: If you feel like you're always doing something and there is never any space in your calendar for downtime, you could suffer social burnout or social fatigue.
suffer.zh: 如果你感觉自己总是在做事，日程表上永远没有留给休息的时间，你可能会遭遇社交倦怠或社交疲劳。
suffer.src: 2024 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

suffer.en: Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.
suffer.zh: 水石书店各分店收入大幅减少。
suffer.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

thus.en: Dean Gallea: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.
thus.zh: 迪恩·加利亚：动物园使人们无需前往荒野地区，从而为野生动物保护做出贡献。
thus.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

thus.en: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.
thus.zh: 动物园让人们无需前往荒野地区，从而为野生动物保护做出贡献。
thus.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

variety.en: I loved the man from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered "a lot of variety…things I thought I'd never be interested in…ice hockey perhaps".
variety.zh: 我很喜欢那项三十年代研究中的那位受访者，他发现广播突然间提供了“极其丰富的内容……那些我原以为自己永远不会感兴趣的东西……比如冰球”。
variety.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

variety.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
variety.zh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
variety.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

artificial.en: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
artificial.zh: 人工智能（AI）的进步正在迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。
artificial.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

artificial.en: That makes it sound easy, and artificial, but Peters insists it is still a massive challenge.
artificial.zh: 这听起来简单又做作，但彼得斯坚持认为这仍然是一个巨大的挑战。

demonstrate.en: Neuroscientists have been at pains to demonstrate that the pleasure a book provides isn't indulgence; it's good for you.
demonstrate.zh: 神经科学家一直致力于证明，阅读书籍带来的愉悦感并非一种放纵，而是大有裨益。

demonstrate.en: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges.
demonstrate.zh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
demonstrate.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

determine.en: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
determine.zh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
determine.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

determine.en: Today's tip requests are often not connected to the salary and service norms that used to determine when and how people tip.
determine.zh: 如今的小费请求往往与过去决定人们何时以及如何给小费的薪资和服务规范脱节。
determine.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

eliminate.en: It's past time for transparency with these institutions, and it's past time to eliminate zoos from our culture.
eliminate.zh: 这些机构早就该提高透明度了，而我们也早就该将动物园从我们的文化中剔除了。
eliminate.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

eliminate.en: India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022."
eliminate.zh: 印度刚刚宣布将在2022年前“在全国范围内消除所有一次性塑料制品。”
eliminate.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

gene.en: In an effort to support restoration programmes, specialists are developing supplies of seeds and seedlings, maintaining gene banks and sequencing the genomes of indigenous trees and other crops.
gene.zh: 为了支持恢复计划，专家们正在增加种子和树苗的供应，维护基因库，并对本土树木和其他作物的基因组进行测序。
gene.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

gene.en: Why this similarity exists in smell genes is difficult to explain, for now.
gene.zh: 目前，这种嗅觉基因相似性存在的原因尚难以解释。
gene.src: 2015 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

genetic.en: Genetic analysis offers insight into the history of donkeys.
genetic.zh: 基因分析为研究驴的历史提供了见解。
genetic.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

genetic.en: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
genetic.zh: 去年，一个联邦特别工作组敦促对基因检测相关专利进行改革。
genetic.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

impose.en: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
impose.zh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
impose.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

impose.en: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
impose.zh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对向法国消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收全新税费。
impose.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

obtain.zh: 获取读者对它们的看法。
obtain.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

obtain.en: Parenting tips obtained from hunter-gatherers in Africa may be the key to bringing up more contented children, researchers have suggested.
obtain.zh: 研究人员指出，从非洲狩猎采集部落获取的育儿技巧或许是培养更满足孩子的关键。
obtain.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

regular.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
regular.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
regular.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

regular.en: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
regular.zh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
regular.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

senior.en: "The concept of retirement is evolving," said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade.
senior.zh: “退休的概念正在演变，”德美利证券退休业务高级经理克里斯汀·拉塞尔表示。
senior.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

senior.en: Your senior colleague outlines a project timeline you believe is unrealistic.
senior.zh: 你的资深同事制定了你认为不切实际的项目时间表。
senior.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

sensitive.en: This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world.
sensitive.zh: 这意味着任何敏感的业务信息都可能面临暴露给全世界的风险。
sensitive.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

sensitive.en: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
sensitive.zh: 联邦贸易委员会在起诉书中指控，“尽管该公司明确做出了隐私承诺，但仍控制了用户的敏感生育数据并将其分享给第三方。”
sensitive.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

series.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
series.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
series.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

series.en: They then set up a "food station" experiment, in which they gave the elephants a series of choices based only on smell.
series.zh: 随后，研究人员设置了一个“食物站”实验，在实验中，他们仅让大象依靠嗅觉进行一系列选择。
series.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

staff.en: Say your boss picks holes in your sales report, and you come away feeling like this means she thinks you're a poor member of staff.
staff.zh: 假设你的老板对你的销售报告百般挑剔，你离开时觉得这意味着她认为你是个表现不佳的员工。
staff.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

staff.en: The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
staff.zh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来实现知识交流、提供选择和展现不同声音。
staff.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

aspect.en: One aspect of this influence is self-expression.
aspect.zh: 这种影响的一个方面是自我表达。
aspect.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

aspect.en: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
aspect.zh: 人工智能（AI）的进步正在迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。
aspect.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

broad.en: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user — rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
broad.zh: 这使微软获得了用户输入或输出数据的广泛权利——微软有权以其认为合适的任何方式使用这些数据，甚至可以将其与第三方共享。
broad.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

broad.en: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
broad.zh: 一位受访者表示：“艺术家帮助科学家接触更广泛的受众，并建立情感联系，从而促进学习。”
broad.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

campaign.en: Mayor José Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality.
campaign.zh: 市长何塞·路易斯·马丁内斯-阿尔梅达将反对该区域作为其竞选活动的核心议题，尽管该区域在改善空气质量方面已取得成功。
campaign.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

campaign.en: However, their campaign risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective.
campaign.zh: 然而，他们的宣传运动有可能给人留下一种强硬且过度保护的印象。
campaign.src: 2020 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

carbon.en: Thanks to his invention, we have a real chance to decrease the world's carbon emissions.
carbon.zh: 多亏了他的发明，我们才有真正的机会减少全球碳排放。
carbon.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

carbon.en: The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
carbon.zh: 技术研究产生的碳排放是值得的：这项研究最终将守护我们星球的未来。
carbon.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

chief.en: I have yet to meet a chief executive who reads regularly.
chief.zh: 我还没见过哪位首席执行官有定期阅读的习惯。

chief.en: Brian Berry, chief executive of the Federation of Master Builders, says the measures will require new materials, testing methods, products and systems to be installed.
chief.zh: 英国建筑大师联合会首席执行官布莱恩·贝里表示，这些措施将要求安装新的材料、测试方法、产品和系统。
chief.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

creative.en: AI can be a collaborative tool in a wide range of creative endeavors.
creative.zh: AI 可以在广泛的创意领域中成为一种协作工具。
creative.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

creative.en: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
creative.zh: 这场演出是在11月英国格拉斯哥联合国气候变化大会召开前发出的富有创意的行动号召。
creative.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

dam.en: Beavers build dams and birds make nests.
dam.src: 2012 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

dam.en: What is the myth concerning giant dams?
dam.zh: 关于巨型水坝的迷思是什么？
dam.src: 1998 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

damage.en: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns.
damage.zh: 该账号正努力鼓励人们在两份请愿书上签名，一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份则呼吁对此类草坪征收'生态损害'税。
damage.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

damage.en: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
damage.zh: 负责在伦敦西部举办这一年度展会的英国皇家园艺学会(RHS)表示，实施这项禁令是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。
damage.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

display.en: What intrinsic factors make the West a suitable home for these artifacts but preclude them from being preserved and displayed by their countries of origin?
display.zh: 究竟是哪些内在因素让西方成为这些文物的合适存放地，却又妨碍它们回归原产国进行保存和展示呢？
display.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

display.en: The monetary value of the objects on display is a distant second place in importance.
display.zh: 展出文物的货币价值远居其次。
display.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

effective.en: A citizen science-based approach can extend the field of vision and include more ideas and different brains to problem-solve and create, making innovation faster and more effective.
effective.zh: 基于公民科学的方法能够拓展视野，汇集更多创意和多元智慧来解决问题与创新，从而使创新过程更快、更有效。
effective.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

effective.en: As an effective Washington operator, Hayden sensed that he could capitalize on the expedition's stunning visuals.
effective.zh: 作为一名在华盛顿颇具影响力的活动家，海登意识到他可以利用这次探险中令人惊叹的视觉资料。

efficiency.en: New building regulations aimed at improving energy efficiency are set to increase the price of new homes, as well as those of extensions and loft conversions on existing ones.
efficiency.zh: 旨在提高能源效率的新建筑法规将推高新房价格，同时也会增加现有住房扩建和阁楼改建的成本。
efficiency.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

efficiency.en: They set new standards for ventilation, energy efficiency and heating, and state that new residential buildings must have charging points for electric vehicles.
efficiency.zh: 这些新规设定了通风、能源效率和供暖方面的新标准，并规定新建住宅必须配备电动汽车充电设施。
efficiency.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

eventually.en: The rule changes will benefit homeowners eventually.
eventually.zh: 这些规则变更最终将使房主受益。
eventually.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

eventually.en: John Kelly, a construction lawyer at Freeths law firm, believes prices will eventually come down.
eventually.zh: 弗里斯律师事务所的建筑律师约翰·凯利认为，价格最终会下降。
eventually.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

extend.en: A citizen science-based approach can extend the field of vision and include more ideas and different brains to problem-solve and create, making innovation faster and more effective.
extend.zh: 基于公民科学的方法能够拓展视野，汇集更多创意和多元智慧来解决问题与创新，从而使创新过程更快、更有效。
extend.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

extend.en: They started out as a novelty feature, but as their use has grown, their benefits have extended within our technologically advanced world.
extend.zh: 它们最初只是新奇的特色装置，但随着使用范围的扩大，其优势在我们这个技术先进的世界中得到了进一步拓展。
extend.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

harm.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures.
harm.zh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
harm.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

harm.en: Thinking too much can also harm our ability to form preferences.
harm.zh: 思虑过多还会损害我们形成偏好的能力。
harm.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

historian.en: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
historian.zh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
historian.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

historian.en: "The visualization, particularly those photographs, really hit home that this is something that has to be protected," says Alicia Murphy, Yellowstone's park historian.
historian.zh: 黄石国家公园历史学家艾丽西亚·墨菲表示：“这些可视化作品，尤其是那些照片，真正让人们深刻认识到这是一个必须加以保护的地方。”

ideal.en: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
ideal.zh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
ideal.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

ideal.en: Instead of saying what is wrong, broken, or suboptimal, talk about what is right, fixable, or ideal.
ideal.zh: 与其谈论问题、不足或不够理想之处，不如多说说积极面、可改进的地方或理想状态。
ideal.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

improvement.en: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.
improvement.zh: 专家表示，RFI（意大利铁路网公司）多年来持续投入的高密度技术和卫星信号技术也将带来进一步的提升。
improvement.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

improvement.en: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
improvement.zh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
improvement.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

movement.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
movement.zh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
movement.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

movement.en: Each automatic door system analyses the light, sound, weight or movement in its vicinity as a signal to open.
movement.zh: 每个自动门系统都会分析其附近的光线、声音、重量或移动情况，并将这些作为开门信号。
movement.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

origin.en: It is clear that the countries of origin have never been compensated for the stolen artifacts.
origin.zh: 显然，文物的原产国从未因被盗文物获得过任何赔偿。
origin.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

origin.en: It is a flawed line of reasoning to argue against returning artifacts to their countries of origin.
origin.zh: 反对将文物归还给其原产国的论点存在逻辑缺陷。
origin.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

pain.en: Neuroscientists have been at pains to demonstrate that the pleasure a book provides isn't indulgence; it's good for you.
pain.zh: 神经科学家一直致力于证明，阅读书籍带来的愉悦感并非一种放纵，而是大有裨益。

pain.en: Plants can't run away from danger, so investing energy in a body system which recognizes a threat and can feel pain would be a very poor evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
pain.zh: 文章指出，植物无法逃离危险，因此将能量投入到一个能够识别威胁并感知疼痛的身体系统中，将是一种非常糟糕的进化策略。
pain.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

participant.en: Half of the participants were told the information would be erased, while the other half were told it would be saved.
participant.zh: 一半的参与者被告知信息将会被删除，而另一半则被告知信息会被保存。
participant.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

participant.en: In 2011, Sparrow led a study in which participants were asked to record 40 factoids in a computer ("an ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain," for example).
participant.zh: 2011年，斯派洛主导了一项研究，参与者被要求在电脑中记录40条趣闻知识（例如，“鸵鸟的眼睛比它的大脑还大”）。
participant.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

politics.en: His status in Lord Wellington's headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.
politics.zh: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及因其工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队中的阶级政治紧密相连。
politics.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

politics.en: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion.
politics.zh: 正是这种思维方式导致许多人试图避免争论，尤其是关于政治和宗教的争论。

propose.en: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
propose.zh: 帕特·哈迪（Pat Hardy）对能源行业的观点持同情态度，她正抵制针对青春期前学生科学课程标准的拟议修改。
propose.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

propose.en: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
propose.zh: 然而，该法案提出的机制过于繁琐，并且在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
propose.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

scale.en: This year, we've been forced to scale back the footprint of the fest.
scale.zh: 今年，我们被迫缩小了活动的规模。
scale.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

scale.en: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
scale.zh: 最近得知一些科学家为了减少碳排放而打算缩减研究规模，我感到十分震惊。
scale.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

tough.en: The supply of seeds is a tough problem that has to be dealt with.
tough.zh: 种子供应是一个必须解决的棘手问题。
tough.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

tough.en: Experts say it is tougher to distinguish oneself in a school-affiliated extracurricular activity that is common among high school students than it is to stand out while doing an uncommon activity.
tough.zh: 专家表示，在高中生普遍参与的学校附属课外活动中脱颖而出，要比通过一项不常见的活动崭露头角更加困难。
tough.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

tradition.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

tradition.en: Even if families don't sit down to eat together as frequently as before, millions of Britons will nonetheless have got a share this weekend of one of that nation's great traditions: the Sunday roast.
tradition.zh: 即便家庭成员不像以前那样频繁围坐一起用餐，但数百万英国人本周末仍会共同享用一项国家传统美食：周日烤肉大餐。
tradition.src: 2020 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

valuable.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

valuable.en: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
valuable.zh: 城市规划师认为， desire paths 不仅仅是便捷的捷径；它们还为理解规划与行为之间的动态关系提供了宝贵见解。
valuable.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

various.en: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
various.zh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
various.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

various.en: Caravanserais served as an informal meeting point for the various people who travelled the Silk Road.
various.zh: 商队驿站成为了丝绸之路上各色旅人的非正式聚集地。
various.src: 2023 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

wrong.en: Instead of saying what is wrong, broken, or suboptimal, talk about what is right, fixable, or ideal.
wrong.zh: 与其谈论问题、不足或不够理想之处，不如多说说积极面、可改进的地方或理想状态。
wrong.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

wrong.en: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
wrong.zh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
wrong.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

citizen.en: The rise of citizen science has grown alongside the rise of do-it-yourself biology laboratories around the world.
citizen.zh: 公民科学的兴起与全球范围内DIY生物实验室的增多相伴而行。
citizen.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

citizen.en: A citizen science-based approach can extend the field of vision and include more ideas and different brains to problem-solve and create, making innovation faster and more effective.
citizen.zh: 基于公民科学的方法能够拓展视野，汇集更多创意和多元智慧来解决问题与创新，从而使创新过程更快、更有效。
citizen.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

conflict.en: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
conflict.zh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

conflict.en: That conflicted with how I needed to train to reach my goals.
conflict.zh: 这与我为实现目标所需要的训练方式相冲突。
conflict.src: 2019 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

corporation.en: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.
corporation.zh: 如今，美国顶级企业首席执行官的年薪约为1890万美元。
corporation.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

corporation.en: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
corporation.zh: 根据Catalyst的一项研究，2010年至2015年间，全球企业董事会中的女性占比增长了54%。
corporation.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

detail.en: Visit any antiques store and you'll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-65 World's Fair, the ephemera of history.
detail.zh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会邂逅往昔的遗物：照片、信件、一本详述1964-1965年世界博览会上辛克莱恐龙展的小册子，以及各种历史短存之物。
detail.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

detail.en: The lesson is not that you should make your personal life an open book, but rather, when given the option to offer up details about yourself or studiously stash them away, you should just be honest.
detail.zh: 其中的经验并非是让你将个人生活完全公开，而是说，当你可以选择透露一些个人细节或刻意隐瞒时，你应该选择诚实。
detail.src: 2020 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

engage.en: One simple way to avoid engaging in personalisation and mind reading is to challenge your negative assumptions of what's happened.
engage.zh: 避免陷入‘个人化’和‘读心术’误区的一个简单方法，就是去质疑你对已发生事情的负面假设。
engage.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

engage.en: Our data shows that engaging with AI like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated.
engage.zh: 我们的数据表明，像这样与人工智能互动，可以让我们感到被倾听，并减少孤独感。
engage.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

estimate.en: It is estimated, for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.
estimate.zh: 例如，据估计医疗保健对健康结果的贡献率仅约为20%。
estimate.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

estimate.en: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
estimate.zh: 新的人工智能技术集中度尤其高：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占据了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。
estimate.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expand.en: Prehistoric humans may have tamed donkeys to help navigate the expanding Sahara.
expand.zh: 史前人类可能已经驯化了驴，以帮助他们在不断扩大的撒哈拉沙漠中穿行。
expand.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

expand.en: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
expand.zh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
expand.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

handle.en: A woman says there have been fewer street fights since the arrival of the wireless but also less stopping and "talking on the brush handle".
handle.zh: 一位女性表示，自无线电广播出现以来，街头斗殴变少了，但停下来“倚着扫帚把聊天”的情况也随之减少了。
handle.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

handle.en: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy though, the focus usually turns to government to handle.
handle.zh: 然而，当技能不匹配问题存在于更广泛的经济层面时，人们通常会期望政府来解决。
handle.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

inevitable.en: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
inevitable.zh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
inevitable.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

inevitable.zh: 能源密集型研究工作是不可避免的。
inevitable.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

legislation.en: Virginia, Colorado and Utah have also recently passed state consumer data privacy legislation.
legislation.zh: 弗吉尼亚州、科罗拉多州和犹他州最近也通过了本州的消费者数据隐私法规。
legislation.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

legislation.en: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
legislation.zh: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论人士认为短期内似乎不太可能出台全面的联邦隐私法规。
legislation.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

liberal.en: The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence.
liberal.zh: 自由民主党正在失去政治影响力。
liberal.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

liberal.zh: 自由民主党则保持沉默。
liberal.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

limited.en: Glenn Branch, the centre's deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards.
limited.zh: 该中心副主任格伦·布兰奇提醒说，在一个将决策权下放给地方学区委员会的国家，制定州级科学标准只是一个有限的基准。
limited.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

limited.en: They will have a limited choice of jobs.
limited.zh: 他们的就业选择将会很有限。
limited.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

nail.en: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
nail.zh: 18世纪末以后，是什么在降低钉子价格方面起了主要作用？
nail.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

nail.en: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.
nail.zh: 为收回钉子而不惜烧毁整栋房屋的想法，凸显了这项看似简单的技术在当时是多么稀缺、昂贵且珍贵。
nail.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

option.en: In many cases, it is the best option — in terms of travel time and cost — for both leisure and business travellers.
option.zh: 在许多情况下，无论是对于休闲游客还是商务旅行者，这在旅行时间和成本方面都是最佳选择。
option.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

option.en: Customers now routinely see menus of suggested default options—often well above 20% of what they owe.
option.zh: 顾客现在经常会看到建议的默认选项菜单——通常远高于账单金额的20%。
option.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

original.en: Though it's still unclear why the original domestication happened, Science News' Freda Kreier reports that the event coincided with the Sahara growing larger and drier.
original.zh: 尽管最初驯化的原因尚不明确，但《科学新闻》的弗雷达·克赖尔报道称，这一事件恰逢撒哈拉沙漠范围扩大且气候变得更加干旱的时期。
original.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

original.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
original.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
original.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

perceive.en: Whether we opt for bold, colorful outfits or prefer more understated styles, our dress choices convey messages about who we are and how we want to be perceived.
perceive.zh: 无论我们选择大胆鲜艳的装扮，还是倾向于低调内敛的风格，我们的着装都在传递信息，展现我们的个性以及我们希望在他人眼中的形象。
