perceive.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

perceive.en: And while you might fear coming across as incompetent, there's actually research that shows that advice-seekers are perceived as more competent, not less.
perceive.zh: 虽然你可能担心自己会显得无能，但实际上有研究表明，寻求建议的人往往被认为更有能力，而非相反。
perceive.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

perform.en: It is closely related to song and even when written it is usually created to be performed out loud.
perform.zh: 诗歌与歌曲渊源深厚，即便被书写成文，也通常是为了能够被大声吟诵而创作的。
perform.src: 2023 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

perform.en: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons.
perform.zh: 上个月，悉尼交响乐团演奏了安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》的改编版本，这正是艺术家与科学家携手共创精彩的一个范例。
perform.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

phenomenon.en: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
phenomenon.zh: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人认为虚假新闻现象的首要原因是“读者错误”，这一因素超过了虚构故事或报道中的事实错误。
phenomenon.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

phenomenon.en: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
phenomenon.zh: 公园跑这一现象最初由十几位朋友发起，如今已在英国催生了400场活动，在国外的活动更多。
phenomenon.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

presence.en: They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
presence.zh: 其中包括英国的DPT（转移利润税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国反避税法）以及印度的SEP（显著经济存在）测试，仅举几例。
presence.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

presence.en: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
presence.zh: 这项裁决对在多州设有实体门店的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常已经对在线购物征收销售税。
presence.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

responsible.en: They also provide an opportunity to talk to the people responsible for growing or raising your food, support your local economy and pick up fresh seasonal produce—all at the same time.
responsible.zh: 它们还让你有机会与负责种植或养殖你食物的人交谈，支持当地经济，同时选购新鲜的时令农产品——这一切都可以同时实现。
responsible.src: 2024 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

responsible.en: The growth leader is also responsible for keeping the team focused on moving forward and steering them clear of distractions.
responsible.zh: 增长团队领导者还负责保持团队专注于前进方向，并引导他们避开干扰。
responsible.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

sector.en: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
sector.zh: 帕特·哈迪（Pat Hardy）对能源行业的观点持同情态度，她正抵制针对青春期前学生科学课程标准的拟议修改。
sector.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

sector.en: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.
sector.zh: 要做到恰到好处并非易事，这需要非凡的远见卓识，以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的通力合作。
sector.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

secure.en: By cutting out the middlemen, the farmers secure more profit for their produce.
secure.zh: 通过省去中间商环节，农民们能为自己的农产品获得更多利润。
secure.src: 2024 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

secure.en: Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility.
secure.zh: 教育不再是实现社会流动的可靠途径。
secure.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

spot.en: In 1967 a scientific survey of the Peloponnesian coast was gathering data to analyze changes in sea levels when British oceanographer Nicholas Flemming first spotted the sunken structures.
spot.zh: 1967年，一项针对伯罗奔尼撒半岛海岸的科学调查正在收集数据以分析海平面变化，此时英国海洋学家尼古拉斯·弗莱明首次发现了这些沉没的建筑物。
spot.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

spot.en: These pauses typically occur at about three per second, and the eyes then jump to another spot, until several important points in the image are registered like a series of snapshots.
spot.zh: 这些注视停顿通常每秒约三次，随后眼睛会跳转到另一个位置，直到图像中的几个重要点像一系列快照一样被记录下来。
spot.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

survive.en: Looking at these DNA sequences, we get a biological testimony to the environment these animals lived in and the experiences they survived.
survive.zh: 通过观察这些 DNA 序列，我们可以看到这些动物所处环境及其生存经历在生物学上留下的印记。
survive.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

survive.en: "If you don't look at the soil at the start, you can spend a lot of money and time putting in species that aren't going to survive there."
survive.zh: 如果你不从一开始就检查土壤情况，那么投入大量金钱和时间去种植那些无法在该地存活的物种，最终只会付诸东流。
survive.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

amateur.en: A children's author and poet who had become a keen amateur photographer, Peters watched the butterflies and idly wondered if he could capture them in flight.
amateur.zh: 彼得斯是一位儿童文学作家兼诗人，同时也是一位热忱的业余摄影师。他观察着蝴蝶，随意地想着能否捕捉到它们飞行的瞬间。

amateur.en: His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition.
amateur.zh: 他的作品并未遵循业余评论的传统。
amateur.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

annual.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
annual.zh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
annual.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

annual.en: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
annual.zh: 负责在伦敦西部举办这一年度展会的英国皇家园艺学会(RHS)表示，实施这项禁令是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。
annual.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

collection.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
collection.zh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
collection.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

collection.en: What was more, many original French dispatches had been preserved in this collection, which I realized was priceless.
collection.zh: 更重要的是，这组档案中还保存了许多法国原始公文，我意识到这可是无价之宝。
collection.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

comment.en: Any comments or experiences that undermine those feelings of self-worth can be uncomfortable and it's only natural to want to avoid them.
comment.zh: 任何贬低自我价值感的言论或经历都会让人感到不适，而想要逃避这些自然是人之常情。
comment.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）
2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

database.en: In 2022, Swetnam and other scientists teamed up to compile a database of fire-scarred trees from across the continent.
database.zh: 2022 年，斯韦特纳姆与其他科学家合作，编制了一个涵盖整个大陆的火灾痕迹树木数据库。
database.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

database.en: Accessing databases is essential to researchers.
database.zh: 访问数据库对研究人员来说至关重要。
database.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

donkey.en: Prehistoric humans may have tamed donkeys to help navigate the expanding Sahara.
donkey.zh: 史前人类可能已经驯化了驴，以帮助他们在不断扩大的撒哈拉沙漠中穿行。
donkey.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

donkey.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
donkey.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
donkey.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

former.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
former.zh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
former.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

former.en: "It's a complete life-changer" when someone stops—or is forced to stop—driving, said former risk manager Anne M. Menke.
former.zh: 前风险经理安妮·M·门克表示：“当一个人停止驾驶——或被迫停止驾驶时，这完全是一场生活的巨变。”
former.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

freedom.en: No matter how you "enhance" enclosures, they do not allow for freedom, a natural diet or adequate exercise.
freedom.zh: 无论你如何“改善”圈养环境，它们都无法提供自由、自然饮食或充足的活动空间。
freedom.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

freedom.en: The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.
freedom.zh: 不过，法院或许希望为警方留出一定空间，使其能够援引一些有权获得更大行动自由的情形。
freedom.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

illegal.en: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
illegal.zh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
illegal.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

illegal.en: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
illegal.zh: 她认为，这种道德目标的缺失正损害着像新闻国际这样的公司，使其更有可能迷失方向，就像其在大规模非法电话窃听事件中那样。
illegal.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

influential.en: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.
influential.zh: 例如，如果社交网络中仅与初始影响者相隔两层的人表现出抵制态度，那么这一连串的变化就不会传播得很远，也不会影响很多人。
influential.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

influential.en: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.
influential.zh: 然而，根据两级传播理论，恰恰是这些非名人影响者应该通过直接影响他们的朋友和同事来推动社会流行潮。
influential.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

occur.en: One of the biggest barriers to gaining buy-in occurs when the owner of an idea is viewed as argumentative, defensive, or close-minded.
occur.zh: 获得认同的最大障碍之一是，当想法提出者被视为好辩、爱辩解或思想封闭时。
occur.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

occur.en: The Government has pledged to change the law to introduce a minimum service requirement so that, even when strikes occur, services can continue to operate.
occur.zh: 政府已承诺修改法律，引入最低服务要求，以确保即使发生罢工，铁路服务也能继续运营。
occur.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

procedure.en: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedures?
procedure.zh: 《雇佣关系法》中关于不当解雇的条款可能会产生什么影响？
procedure.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

procedure.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures.
procedure.zh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
procedure.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

profession.en: There are groups aimed at new parents, at those who want to try a new sport for the first time, or networking events for those in the same profession to meet up and share ideas.
profession.zh: 有专门面向新手父母的团体，有供初次尝试新运动的人参与的群体，也有供同行相聚交流想法的社交活动。
profession.src: 2024 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

profession.en: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions.
profession.zh: 毕竟，其他国家，如澳大利亚和英国，已经开始对其法律行业实行自由化改革。
profession.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

recommend.en: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
recommend.zh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
recommend.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

recommend.en: All the experts we spoke with highly recommend walking because it's the easiest, most accessible form of exercise.
recommend.zh: 我们采访的所有专家都极力推荐步行，因为它是最简单、最容易开展的运动形式。
recommend.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

version.en: Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.
version.zh: 基于这一洞见，市场营销团队与工程团队联手合作，通过向免费版用户重点推广高级版来提高用户认知度。
version.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

version.en: Most customers were simply unaware of the premium version and what it offered.
version.zh: 大多数客户根本不知道高级版的存在及其提供的功能。
version.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

wave.en: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
wave.zh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
wave.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

wave.en: That day's high temperature of roughly 36°C was 1°C shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.
wave.zh: 当日最高气温约为36°C，比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1°C。
wave.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

assess.en: it is urgent to assess the use of planned fires.
assess.zh: 评估计划火烧的使用已刻不容缓。
assess.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

assess.en: The experiment showed that elephants may well use smell to identify patches of trees that are good to eat, and secondly to assess the quality of the trees within each patch.
assess.zh: 实验表明，大象很可能利用嗅觉来识别宜食树丛区域，其次是评估每个区域内树木的品质。
assess.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

blame.en: Who Are to Blame for the Strikes?
blame.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

blame.en: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it "controlled" the data and DeepMind merely "processed" it.
blame.zh: 德纳姆女士选择将责任集中归咎于英国国家医疗服务体系信托机构，因为根据现行法律，该机构对数据拥有'控制权'，而DeepMind仅仅是进行'数据处理'。
blame.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

capture.en: After he's captured the butterfly taking off, he layers 10 to 15 frames together in Photoshop.
capture.zh: 在捕捉到蝴蝶起飞的瞬间后，他在Photoshop中将10到15帧画面叠加在一起。

capture.en: A children's author and poet who had become a keen amateur photographer, Peters watched the butterflies and idly wondered if he could capture them in flight.
capture.zh: 彼得斯是一位儿童文学作家兼诗人，同时也是一位热忱的业余摄影师。他观察着蝴蝶，随意地想着能否捕捉到它们飞行的瞬间。

consumption.en: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.
consumption.zh: 首先，大多数人没有意识到，一些强大的商业议程正在起作用，目的是让他们一直处于被动消费模式。
consumption.src: 2012 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

consumption.en: Laughter does produce short-term changes in the function of the heart and its blood vessels, boosting heart rate and oxygen consumption.
consumption.zh: 笑的确会使心脏及其血管功能产生短期变化，提高心率和氧气消耗量。
consumption.src: 2011 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

contrast.en: By contrast, in hunter-gatherer societies adults other than the parents can provide almost half of a child's care.
contrast.zh: 相比之下，在狩猎采集社会中，父母以外的成年人可以提供儿童近一半的照料。
contrast.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

contrast.en: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
contrast.zh: 相反，假设你提出一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应被迫生活在贫困中。

crop.en: In an effort to support restoration programmes, specialists are developing supplies of seeds and seedlings, maintaining gene banks and sequencing the genomes of indigenous trees and other crops.
crop.zh: 为了支持恢复计划，专家们正在增加种子和树苗的供应，维护基因库，并对本土树木和其他作物的基因组进行测序。
crop.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

crop.en: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
crop.zh: 拉里·布朗为总部位于丹佛的Nest Fresh Eggs公司供应鸡蛋，他表示：“我对我们的进展感到兴奋。”目前，他正在种植更多覆盖作物，以吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用。
crop.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

crucial.en: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges.
crucial.zh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
crucial.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

crucial.en: New research suggests that smell is a crucial factor in guiding elephants—and probably other herbivores—to the best food resources.
crucial.zh: 新研究表明，嗅觉是引导大象——很可能还有其他食草动物——找到最佳食物资源的关键因素。
crucial.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

employ.en: The team employed robotics, sonar mapping, and state-of-the-art graphics to survey the site.
employ.zh: 该团队采用了机器人技术、声纳测绘和最先进的图形技术对遗址进行了勘测。
employ.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

employ.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
employ.zh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
employ.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

evolve.en: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
evolve.zh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
evolve.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

evolve.en: "For consciousness to evolve, a brain with a threshold level of complexity and capacity is required," he added.
evolve.zh: 他补充道：“意识的进化需要一个达到阈值水平的复杂大脑和相应能力。”
evolve.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

expectation.en: Different cultures have their norms and expectations regarding dress, which can influence the types of clothing people wear and the meanings attributed to them.
expectation.zh: 不同的文化对着装有各自的规范和预期，这会影响人们选择的服装类型及其所代表的含义。
expectation.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

expectation.en: This increase is sometimes called tipflation—the expectation of ever-higher tip amounts.
expectation.zh: 这种增长有时被称为小费膨胀——即期望获得越来越高的小费金额。
expectation.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expose.en: This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world.
expose.zh: 这意味着任何敏感的业务信息都可能面临暴露给全世界的风险。
expose.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expose.en: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils aged nine and ten—at 45 state primary schools that had not been "previously exposed to RSC pedagogy".
expose.zh: 这项随机对照试验涉及45所州立小学的数百名9至10岁五年级学生，这些学校此前"未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团教学法"。
expose.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

extra.zh: 零排放模型需要额外资金支持。
extra.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

extra.en: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
extra.zh: 在线教育可以降低额外培训和教学的成本，使其更加经济实惠。
extra.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

fake.en: The RHS's decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
fake.zh: 英国皇家园艺学会做出这一决定之际，活动人士正努力提高公众对人造草坪所引发问题的认识。
fake.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fake.en: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass".
fake.zh: 去年有一份呼吁禁止人造草坪的请愿书征集到了3万个签名，对此政府回应称其“暂无计划禁止人造草坪的使用”。
fake.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

flight.en: At a pinch, they might pick up a business book before a long flight, in the hope that, like a cookbook, it will provide a foolproof recipe.
flight.zh: 在必要时，他们可能会在长途飞行前买一本商业书籍，希望它能像菜谱一样提供一套万无一失的成功秘诀。

flight.en: A children's author and poet who had become a keen amateur photographer, Peters watched the butterflies and idly wondered if he could capture them in flight.
flight.zh: 彼得斯是一位儿童文学作家兼诗人，同时也是一位热忱的业余摄影师。他观察着蝴蝶，随意地想着能否捕捉到它们飞行的瞬间。

flow.en: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.
flow.zh: 但电池存储容量的提升正使可再生能源具备全天候持续供电能力的可能性越来越大。
flow.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

flow.en: You'd think this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but in fact, Eberle notes, such ritualistic behaviour helps us "step outside time's flow" into "soul time."
flow.zh: 你可能会认为这会加剧效率至上的心态，但事实上，埃伯利指出，这种仪式化的行为帮助我们“走出时间的流逝”，进入“灵魂时间”。
flow.src: 2016 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

formal.en: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
formal.zh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
formal.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

formal.en: Millennials, it seems, face the paradox of being the least formal generation yet the most conscious of style and personal branding.
formal.zh: 千禧一代似乎面临着一个矛盾：他们是最不讲究正式着装的一代，却又是最注重时尚风格和个人品牌塑造的一代。
formal.src: 2016 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

grant.en: That March, President Ulysses S. Grant signed an act into law that established Yellowstone as the world's first national park.
grant.zh: 同年3月，尤利西斯·S·格兰特总统签署法案，正式将黄石确立为世界上第一个国家公园。

grant.en: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
grant.zh: 住房建设部门需要接受这样一个事实：我们极不可能回到大规模公共拨款的时代了。
grant.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

guarantee.en: Take measures to guarantee its quality.
guarantee.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

guarantee.en: A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular 'pearly whites' was a rare sight in Victorian society, the preserve of the super-rich (and even then, dental hygiene was not guaranteed).
guarantee.zh: 在维多利亚时代的社会中，拥有一口健康洁净、整齐洁白的“珍珠皓齿”实属罕见，这是超级富豪的专属（即便如此，牙齿卫生也无法保证）。
guarantee.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

industrial.en: However, there is a strong case that those who have been worst affected by industrial action should receive compensation for the disruption they have suffered.
industrial.zh: 然而，有充分理由认为，那些受劳工行动影响最严重的乘客应该就其所遭受的出行中断获得赔偿。
industrial.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

industrial.en: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
industrial.zh: 工业革命对那些工作被机械化织布机取代的卢德派分子来说并不是什么好事，但它最终提高了生活水平，创造的就业机会也多于其摧毁的数量。
industrial.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

instance.en: Your father may never remember birthdays because your mother does, for instance.
instance.zh: 例如，你的父亲可能永远记不住家人的生日，因为你母亲会记住。
instance.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

instance.en: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance, wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J. Simons.
instance.zh: 例如，心理学家克里斯托弗·查布里斯(Christopher Chabris)和丹尼尔·J·西蒙斯(Daniel J. Simons)写道，目前尚无实验证据表明互联网会干扰我们的专注力。
instance.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

justify.en: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
justify.zh: 此处不收取任何费用，也绝不会要求你进行辩解或说明；我们只会简单地欢迎你，在你需要时提供帮助，并在你不需要时不去打扰。
justify.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

justify.en: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
justify.zh: 然而，仅仅是平庸已不足以成为解雇的正当理由。
justify.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

observe.en: And it carries "significant repercussions for water quality and flood control throughout the United States," as Justice Brett Kavanaugh observed.
observe.zh: 正如布雷特·卡瓦诺大法官所指出的，这一裁决“将对全美国的水质和防洪产生重大影响”。
observe.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

observe.en: The most immediate changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
observe.zh: 最立即可见的变化将体现在技能水平、力量和腰围尺寸的减小上。
observe.src: 2019 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

obvious.en: In the medical field, to take an obvious example, the pandemic meant that there were still clear shortages of doctors, nurses and other medical personnel.
obvious.zh: 举一个明显的例子，在医疗领域，疫情意味着医生、护士和其他医疗人员仍然存在明显短缺。
obvious.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

obvious.en: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don't pay for them.
obvious.zh: 当前所阐释的竞争法主要处理对消费者造成的经济损害问题，然而当这些服务的用户无需付费使用时，这种损害就显得不那么明显了。
obvious.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

outcome.en: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
outcome.zh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
outcome.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

outcome.en: the change in instruction enhances learning outcomes
outcome.zh: 教学指令的改变提高了学习成果
outcome.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

pace.en: Last year marked the third year in a row that Indonesia's bleak rate of deforestation has slowed in pace.
pace.zh: 去年是印度尼西亚严峻的森林砍伐率连续第三年放缓。
pace.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

pace.en: Simply slowing the pace and talking in an even tone helps the other person cool down and does the same for you.
pace.zh: 只需放慢语速，用平稳的语调说话，就能帮助对方冷静下来，同时也能让自己平静。
pace.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

phrase.en: Through carefully selected words and phrases, poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.
phrase.zh: 通过精心挑选的词语和短语，诗歌可以充满戏剧性、幽默风趣、优美动人、感人肺腑且鼓舞人心。
phrase.src: 2023 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

phrase.en: What does the phrase "to be aligned" (Line 5, Para. 6) most probably mean?
phrase.zh: 短语“to be aligned”（第六段第五行）最可能的含义是什么？
phrase.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

press.en: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
press.zh: 真正成功的称号获得者所做的远不止于在一年内填满酒店客房、举办引人注目的艺术活动以及获得媒体的正面报道。
press.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

press.en: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
press.zh: 接下来，研究人员将机器人关进笼子，并给老鼠们通过按压杠杆来释放它们的机会。
press.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

priority.zh: 流媒体平台改变了其战略重心。
priority.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

priority.en: Give priority to pursuing its net-zero strategy.
priority.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

royal.en: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
royal.zh: 负责在伦敦西部举办这一年度展会的英国皇家园艺学会(RHS)表示，实施这项禁令是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。
royal.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

royal.en: A recent paper, titled "The Natural Selection of Bad Science", published on the Royal Society's open science website, attempts to answer this intriguing and important question.
royal.zh: 最近，一篇题为《不良科学的自然选择》的论文发表在英国皇家学会的开放科学网站上，试图回答这个有趣而重要的问题。
royal.src: 2019 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

selection.en: A recent paper, titled "The Natural Selection of Bad Science", published on the Royal Society's open science website, attempts to answer this intriguing and important question.
selection.zh: 最近，一篇题为《不良科学的自然选择》的论文发表在英国皇家学会的开放科学网站上，试图回答这个有趣而重要的问题。
selection.src: 2019 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

selection.en: But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals.
selection.zh: 但就在1968年，陪审团遴选程序仍与这些民主理想相冲突。
selection.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

severe.en: Research shows that these prescribed burns make subsequent wildfires less severe, even if later fires happen under the most dangerous weather conditions.
severe.zh: 研究表明，这种计划烧除可以降低后续野火的严重程度，即使火灾发生在最危险的天气条件下也是如此。
severe.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

severe.en: The fact that fires happened so often meant they couldn't have been severe enough to kill most trees.
severe.zh: 火灾发生得如此频繁，这一事实意味着它们当时的烈度不足以烧死大多数树木。
severe.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

shortage.en: Which of the following causes the shortage of wood supply in the UK?
shortage.zh: 以下哪项导致了英国木材供应短缺？
shortage.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

shortage.en: In the medical field, to take an obvious example, the pandemic meant that there were still clear shortages of doctors, nurses and other medical personnel.
shortage.zh: 举一个明显的例子，在医疗领域，疫情意味着医生、护士和其他医疗人员仍然存在明显短缺。
shortage.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

switch.en: "They bought the seedlings and closed them down," complained Paul Arnold, a partner at San Francisco-based Switch Ventures, putting an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors.
switch.zh: 总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道：“他们买下这些幼苗企业，然后就把它们扼杀了”，终止了那些有朝一日可能成为竞争对手的企业。
switch.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

switch.en: But switching to a mainly plant-based diet wouldn't help.
switch.zh: 但是转向以植物为主的饮食也无济于事。
switch.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

administration.en: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
administration.zh: 例如，高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政结构，尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。
administration.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

administration.en: In March, for the first time, wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US, reported the US Energy Information Administration.
administration.zh: 美国能源信息署报告称，今年3月，风能和太阳能发电量首次占美国总发电量的10%以上。
administration.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

appropriate.en: A pressure-sensitive mat would be more appropriate to limit the surveyed area.
appropriate.zh: 使用压敏垫会更合适，因其可限制感应区域。
appropriate.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

appropriate.en: Which of the following could be the most appropriate title for the text?
appropriate.zh: 以下哪项最适合作为本文的标题？
appropriate.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

audience.en: She draws on letters, diaries and fiction, and a 1939 field notebook of verbatim audience research by Winifred Gill.
audience.zh: 她参考了信件、日记和小说，以及温妮弗雷德·吉尔于 1939 年通过现场调研记录的一本观众研究逐字稿。
audience.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

audience.en: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
audience.zh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
audience.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

category.en: More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories.
category.zh: 就在不久前，人们对益生菌和植物基肉类也有类似的疑虑，但这两类产品如今都已迅速崛起，成为超市中的主要品类。
category.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

category.en: This year, it was proposed that the system be changed: Horizon 2020, a new program to be enacted in 2014, would not have such a category.
category.zh: 今年，有人提议改变这一体系：将于2014年启动的新计划"地平线2020"将不再设置这一专项。
category.src: 2013 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

centre.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
centre.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
centre.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

centre.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
centre.zh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
centre.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

confidence.en: Additionally, clothing can impact our confidence levels.
confidence.zh: 此外，穿着打扮也会影响我们的自信程度。
confidence.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

confidence.en: It may be a well-informed, well-researched opinion, but it's still an opinion, so talk tentatively and slightly understate your confidence.
confidence.zh: 你的观点可能是基于充分了解和深入研究得出的，但终究只是个人观点，因此表达时应措辞委婉，并略微收敛自信。
confidence.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

conservative.en: Yet that demand has been almost impossible to fill—in part because of pushback from broadband providers, anti-regulatory conservatives and the courts.
conservative.zh: 然而，这一诉求几乎不可能实现——部分原因是来自宽带提供商、反监管的保守派以及法院的抵制。
conservative.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

conservative.en: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible demise.
conservative.zh: 七个月后，经过一场选举，新当选的保守派市议会暂停了清洁空气区的执行，这是该区域可能走向终结的第一步。
conservative.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

consume.en: According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 per cent of the world's electricity.
consume.zh: 根据国际能源署的数据，这些建筑目前消耗约占全球1%的电力。
consume.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

consume.en: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
consume.zh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
consume.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

curiosity.en: But by utilising the natural curiosity of the general public it is possible to overcome many of these challenges by engaging non-scientists directly in the research process.
curiosity.zh: 但通过利用公众的天然好奇心，可以让非科研人员直接参与研究过程，从而克服其中许多挑战。
curiosity.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

curiosity.en: Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.
curiosity.zh: 在表达完你的观点（是作为一种立场，而非事实）之后，要对他人的看法表现出同样的好奇心。
curiosity.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

debate.en: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
debate.zh: 此类争论反映了全美范围内的激烈讨论，研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生都在不断呼吁，要求学校更加重视气候变化事实的教学。
debate.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

debate.en: But it can also be antagonistic, such as when a political candidate turns toward their competitor during a debate and makes eye contact that signals hostility.
debate.zh: 但眼神交流也可能带有对抗性，例如在辩论中，当一位政治候选人转向对手时，其眼神交流可能传递出敌意。
debate.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

device.en: The prevalence of digital payment devices has made it easier to ask customers for a tip.
device.zh: 数字支付设备的普及使得向顾客索要小费变得更加容易。
device.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

device.en: Using tracking devices, researchers have shown that they have "remarkable spatial acuity."
device.zh: 通过追踪设备，研究人员发现大象拥有“非凡的空间感知能力”。
device.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

editor.en: In one example, an individual—acting as author, editor, and consultant—was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.
editor.zh: 举个例子，有个人身兼作者、编辑和顾问三职，竟然能利用至少15家期刊为三所大学的五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。
editor.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

editor.en: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals.
editor.zh: 奇怪的是，编辑理应效力的期刊根本没有从中获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用。
editor.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

female.en: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female.
female.zh: 哈达德和刘易斯担心，超过半数的州政府委员会中女性占比不足40%。
female.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

female.en: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
female.zh: 雷丁呼吁各企业签署承诺书，致力于实现女性在董事会成员中占40%的性别平衡目标。
female.src: 2013 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

guilt.en: And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt.
guilt.zh: 反之亦然：高共情能力可以弥补低愧疚感的不足。
guilt.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

guilt.en: Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses.
guilt.zh: 一些缺乏同情心的孩子可能会通过体验更多内疚感来弥补这一不足，这种内疚感可以抑制他们更恶劣的冲动。
guilt.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

highlight.en: Mumbai's April heatstroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say.
highlight.zh: 研究人员表示，孟买4月的中暑死亡事件凸显了对更细致、更本地化预警的需求。
highlight.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

highlight.en: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
highlight.zh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
highlight.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

incentive.en: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
incentive.zh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
incentive.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

incentive.en: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.
incentive.zh: 美国其他地区、加拿大以及欧洲都在稳步加大力度，通过激励措施吸引影视剧组入驻，这使得加利福尼亚州望尘莫及。
incentive.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

lower.en: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
lower.zh: 18世纪末以后，是什么在降低钉子价格方面起了主要作用？
lower.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

lower.zh: 这会暂时降低森林的碳承载能力。
lower.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

multiple.zh: 它们经历了多次驯化过程。
multiple.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

multiple.en: With multiple networks and countless podcasts, a smartphone user selects what to hear and when.
multiple.zh: 面对众多的网络平台和无数的播客节目，智能手机用户可以自主选择收听的内容和时间。
multiple.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

native.en: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species.
native.zh: 亚洲可以说是在提高恢复多样性和研究本土物种的全球努力中，最被忽视的地区。
native.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

native.en: In recent summers, he has travelled the length and breadth of Britain to photograph all 58 native species of butterfly.
native.zh: 近年来的每个夏天，他都走遍英国各地，拍摄了所有58种本土蝴蝶。

neglect.en: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species.
neglect.zh: 亚洲可以说是在提高恢复多样性和研究本土物种的全球努力中，最被忽视的地区。
neglect.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

neglect.en: For millennia, we've known what we've known due to artifacts that have survived, often despite their original creators' neglect.
neglect.zh: 数千年来，我们所了解的知识往往源于那些历经岁月留存下来的文物，尽管它们的原创造者可能早已将其遗忘。
neglect.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

optimistic.en: Be optimistic but realistic, and you will stand out.
optimistic.zh: 保持乐观但也要务实，这样你就能脱颖而出。
optimistic.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

optimistic.en: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
optimistic.zh: 它们改变了当地居民的愿景抱负；它们将城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的新高度。
optimistic.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

otherwise.en: "Otherwise, you miss the boat, you lose all the seed and you've got to wait another seven years," says Kettle.
otherwise.zh: “否则，你就会错失良机，失去所有的种子，并且必须再等上七年，”凯特尔说道。
otherwise.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

otherwise.en: AI replaces the boring parts of your job. If you're doing research, you can have AI go out and look for relevant sources and information that otherwise you just wouldn't have time for.
otherwise.zh: 人工智能可以取代工作中枯燥乏味的部分。如果你正在做研究，人工智能可以帮你查找相关的资料和信息，而这些工作要是你自己做的话根本没时间完成。
otherwise.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

poverty.en: Even if this program didn't reduce poverty, Ferraro says, "the value of the avoided deforestation just for carbon dioxide emissions alone is more than the program costs."
poverty.zh: 费拉罗表示，即便该项目未能减轻贫困，"单是在减少二氧化碳排放方面，避免森林砍伐所产生的价值就已超过项目成本。"
poverty.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

poverty.en: That's because economic growth can be correlated with environmental degradation, while protecting the environment is sometimes correlated with greater poverty.
poverty.zh: 这是因为经济增长可能与环境退化相关联，而保护环境有时又与加剧贫困相关联。
poverty.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

pursuit.en: So what's the appeal of a long, sweaty day in pursuit of an elusive, fast-moving wild animal?
pursuit.zh: 那么，花上漫长而汗流浃背的一天，去追逐一只难以捉摸、行动迅速的野生动物，究竟有什么吸引力呢？

pursuit.en: It is in pursuit of quality service.
pursuit.zh: 这是为了追求优质服务。
pursuit.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reputation.en: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
reputation.zh: 科学家的职业生涯及其所在机构的声誉取决于他们发表论文的数量和声望，但更重要的是这些论文所获得的引用量。
reputation.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reputation.en: From then on his sketches, which appeared under the pen name "Boz" in The Evening Chronicle, earned him a modest reputation.
reputation.zh: 从那以后，他以“博兹”为笔名在《纪事晚报》上发表的速写为他赢得了小小的名气。

route.en: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
route.zh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
route.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

route.en: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
route.zh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
route.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

solve.en: Remember that in light of whatever the problem the old system solved—or, maybe, has failed to solve in recent memory—it was a great idea at the time.
solve.zh: 要记住，无论旧系统曾经解决了什么问题——或者，或许在最近的记忆中未能解决什么问题——它在当时都是一个很棒的想法。
solve.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

solve.en: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges.
solve.zh: 然而，若要解决人类面临的最大挑战，证明科学的有效性将至关重要。
solve.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

undergraduate.en: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
undergraduate.zh: 专家表示，在至少一项课外活动中展现才华有助于大学申请，尤其是在顶尖本科院校的申请过程中。
undergraduate.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

undergraduate.en: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
undergraduate.zh: 但如今，除了许多顶尖院校外，大多数大学都允许所有本科生，甚至研究生，将低分成绩进行重修覆盖。
undergraduate.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

unemployment.en: In February, at 3.5 per cent and 5.5 per cent respectively, unemployment rates in Canada and the United States were at generational lows and worker shortages were everywhere.
unemployment.zh: 2月份，加拿大和美国的失业率分别为3.5%和5.5%，处于世代最低水平，劳动力短缺现象随处可见。
unemployment.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

unemployment.en: With the pandemic, unemployment is very high indeed.
unemployment.zh: 疫情期间，失业率确实非常高。
unemployment.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

upgrade.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
upgrade.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
upgrade.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

upgrade.en: As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.
upgrade.zh: 结果，升级量激增，收入增长了92%。
upgrade.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

urban.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
urban.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
urban.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

urban.en: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
urban.zh: 为了帮助改进健康行动计划（HAPs），城市规划师拉贾什里·科萨尔卡尔的团队正在制定一个模型计划，其中概述了最佳实践，并可根据当地情况进行调整。
urban.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

wage.en: So, to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to the temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
wage.zh: 因此，为了在不提高价格的情况下增加员工工资，越来越多的雇主正屈服于小费蔓延和小费膨胀的诱惑。
wage.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

wage.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
wage.zh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
wage.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

additional.en: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
additional.zh: 佐治亚州为电影和电视制作成本提供高达 30% 的可转让税收抵免。此外，如果项目包含了佐治亚州的宣传标识，还可以在基础税收抵免之上再获得 10% 的额度提升。
additional.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

additional.en: Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated.
additional.zh: 如果缺乏额外保护措施，企业可能会以消费者未授权或未预料的方式分享（并可能通过商业化手段利用）个人健康信息。
additional.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

automation.en: "An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable."
automation.zh: 一个由科技百万富翁或亿万富翁与零工组成，而中等收入工作被自动化削弱的经济体，在政治上是不可持续的。
automation.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

automation.en: Issues arising from automation need to be tackled.
automation.zh: 自动化带来的问题需要得到解决。
automation.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

burden.en: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
burden.zh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
burden.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

burden.en: They put too much burden on individual motorists.
burden.zh: 它们将过多负担加在了个体驾车者身上。
burden.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

characteristic.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
characteristic.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
characteristic.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

characteristic.en: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.
characteristic.zh: 植物产生的挥发性化学物质可以传播很远，并且具有非常独特的特征：每种植物或树木都有其特定的气味特征。
characteristic.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

code.en: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.
code.zh: 该附录列出了许多从西班牙法军手中缴获的加密文件，而这些文件的秘密正是由英国总部的一名军官——乔治·斯科维尔的工作所揭开的。
code.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

code.en: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
code.zh: 正如密码破译在西班牙争夺战中具有更广泛的意义一样，斯科维尔在军阶晋升之路上的种种努力也充分反映了英国社会的风貌。
code.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

complain.en: People often complain that plastics are too durable.
complain.zh: 人们常抱怨塑料太过耐用。
complain.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

complain.en: "They bought the seedlings and closed them down," complained Paul Arnold, a partner at San Francisco-based Switch Ventures, putting an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors.
complain.zh: 总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道：“他们买下这些幼苗企业，然后就把它们扼杀了”，终止了那些有朝一日可能成为竞争对手的企业。
complain.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

continent.en: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
continent.zh: 随后，他们追踪了这些动物在大约 2,500 年后是如何穿过大陆其余地区，进而扩散到欧洲和亚洲的。
continent.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

continent.en: In 2022, Swetnam and other scientists teamed up to compile a database of fire-scarred trees from across the continent.
continent.zh: 2022 年，斯韦特纳姆与其他科学家合作，编制了一个涵盖整个大陆的火灾痕迹树木数据库。
continent.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

contribution.en: Appreciating the older contributions as you suggest future innovations helps bolster the credibility of your idea.
contribution.zh: 在提出未来创新建议的同时，对前人的贡献表示赞赏，有助于增强你的想法的可信度。
contribution.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

contribution.en: Contributions of librarians should be recognized.
contribution.zh: 图书馆员的贡献应当得到认可。
contribution.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cure.en: The cure is right at hand.
One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.
cure.zh: 关于劳动力短缺，有一个常被讨论的解决方案始终如一地不切实际：美国本土工人不会回到农场。
cure.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

debt.en: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
debt.zh: 尽管经济蓬勃发展，但似乎难以缓解这一代人内心深处的焦虑紧迫感，尤其是那些背负大学债务的年轻人。
debt.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

debt.en: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
debt.zh: 专业人士想要学习新技能时，将能够在不负债的情况下实现这一目标。
debt.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

efficient.en: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient.
efficient.zh: 当我们的大脑在专注和不专注于某项任务之间切换时，往往会变得更加高效。
efficient.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

efficient.en: Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient.
efficient.zh: 深度阅读不仅需要时间，还需要一种特殊的时间，这种时间无法仅通过提高效率来获得。
efficient.src: 2016 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

electronic.en: The advent of electronic publishing and authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.
electronic.zh: 电子出版的出现以及作者为其论文寻找发表渠道的需求，催生了数千种新期刊。
electronic.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

electronic.en: Your home colleagues – your family – have no clear rewards for their labor; they need to be talked into it, or if they're teenagers, threatened with complete removal of all electronic devices.
electronic.zh: 你家里的"同事"——也就是你的家人——付出劳动却没有明确的回报；你得好说歹说才能让他们干活，要是碰上青少年，还得威胁他们要没收所有电子设备才行。
electronic.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

elite.en: Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities.
elite.zh: 相反，科伊尔指出，由于人们认为科技带来的好处都流向了少数繁华城市的精英阶层，许多人心中的不满正在悄然升温。
elite.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

elite.en: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
elite.zh: 为了确保精英女性获得更多此类机会，他们提议实施政府配额制度。
elite.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

elsewhere.en: They serve no purpose in a museum in the United States or elsewhere except as curious objects.
elsewhere.zh: 这些文物若留在美国或其他地方的博物馆，除了作为猎奇之物外，毫无意义。
elsewhere.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

elsewhere.en: Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
elsewhere.zh: 到19世纪90年代，抓拍自然流露的笑容已相对容易，因此我们必须从其他方面来解释为什么维多利亚时代的人们仍然不愿在拍照时微笑。
elsewhere.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

enable.en: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
enable.zh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
enable.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

enable.en: Their well-developed hippocampal structures may enable elephants, like rats and people, to construct cognitive maps.
enable.zh: 它们发达的海马体结构或许能让大象像老鼠和人类一样构建认知地图。
enable.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

exchange.en: "There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing," said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week.
exchange.zh: 美国证券交易委员会委员丹尼尔·加拉格尔在本周的一次演讲中表示：“以牺牲长期投资为代价的短期思维似乎占据了主导地位。”
exchange.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

exchange.en: However, Obamacare has allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance through Medicaid or the exchanges.
exchange.zh: 然而，奥巴马医改已使超过1200万人能够通过医疗补助计划或医保交易所获得保险。
exchange.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

finally.en: Finally, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the marks we leave on the landscape.
finally.zh: 最后，假设你在人类常去的区域迷了路，请寻找我们在地面上留下的痕迹。
finally.src: 2019 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

finally.en: Now comes word that everyone involved – Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system's heaviest users – has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
finally.zh: 现在有消息称，所有相关方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政总局、工会以及邮政系统的最大用户——终于就一项系统改革计划达成了一致。
finally.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

formation.en: It has been documented that during World War Ⅱ, America's armed forces once tried formation flight to save fuel.
formation.zh: 有记录显示，二战期间美国军队曾尝试编队飞行以节省燃油。
formation.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

formation.en: The role that weather plays in formation flight has not yet been clearly defined.
formation.zh: 天气在编队飞行中所起的作用尚未明确界定。
formation.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fundamental.en: When you find yourself taking a situation personally, try to think of other interpretations that are less focused on you — especially in the sense of saying anything deep or fundamental about you.
fundamental.zh: 当你发现自己对某种情况过于敏感、认为是在针对自己时，试着去寻找其他不那么以你为中心的解释——特别是要意识到，这件事并不代表对你个人深度或本质上的定性。
fundamental.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

fundamental.en: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness? What makes humans humans?"
fundamental.zh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引发了一些根本性问题：“何为智能、身份或意识？是什么让人类成为人类？”
fundamental.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

institute.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
institute.zh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
institute.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

institute.en: "There's not a National Institute of Older Driver Studies," she said.
institute.zh: 她说：“目前还没有专门针对老年驾驶员研究的国家机构。”
institute.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

literacy.en: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
literacy.zh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
literacy.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

literacy.en: Science education today revolves around the idea of scientific literacy — the base-level knowledge about science that nonscientists require to effectively get on in the world.
literacy.zh: 当今的科学教育围绕着“科学素养”这一理念展开，即非科学家群体为了在现实世界中有效生活所必须具备的基础科学知识。
literacy.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

literary.en: "This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power," says literary agent Andrew Lownie.
literary.zh: 文学经纪人安德鲁·劳尼表示：“这一切都是权力集中这一更大趋势的一部分。”
literary.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

literary.en: Everything he achieved in life was earned the hard way and his success in the literary field was no exception.
literary.zh: 他一生中所取得的一切成就都是靠不懈奋斗换来的，在文学领域的成功也不例外。
literary.src: 2019 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

objective.en: There is no good reason that these artifacts should be beyond the ordinary reach of the educational objectives or inspiration of the generations to which they were left.
objective.zh: 没有充分理由让这些文物脱离其本应传承给的后代子孙的教育目标或灵感启迪的寻常可达范围。
objective.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

objective.en: You'll want to state it overtly, contextualizing your statements so that you're seen not as a disagreeable subordinate but as a colleague who's trying to advance a common objective.
objective.zh: 你需要明确地表达这一点，并为你的言论提供背景，这样你就不会被视为一个不合作的下属，而是一个致力于推进共同目标的同事。
objective.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

panel.en: Automatic doors often open to the side, with the panels sliding across one another.
panel.zh: 自动门通常向侧面开启，门片相互滑动。
panel.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

panel.en: Solar panels had a few niche uses until they became cheap; now they are transforming the global energy system.
panel.zh: 太阳能电池板在价格亲民之前仅有少数特定用途；如今，它们正在改变全球能源系统。
panel.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

perspective.en: Instead, listen to their concerns fully, try to understand their perspective, and include their concerns (and possible remedies) in future discussions.
perspective.zh: 相反，要充分倾听他们的顾虑，努力理解他们的观点，并在未来的讨论中纳入他们的担忧（以及可能的解决办法）。
perspective.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

perspective.en: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
perspective.zh: 然而，当一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入公司，组建了增长团队，并带来了他们所需的全新视角后，情况发生了改变。
perspective.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

poetry.en: No one knows for sure when poetry began but it has been around for thousands of years, even before people could write.
poetry.zh: 没人确切知道诗歌起源于何时，但它已经存在了数千年，甚至在人类掌握书写能力之前就已出现。
poetry.src: 2023 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

poetry.en: So poor in one sense was it that he never could remember for more than a few days a single date or a line of poetry.
poetry.zh: 从某种意义上说，他的记忆力如此糟糕，以至于连一个日期或一行诗句都记不住几天以上。
poetry.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

rail.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
rail.zh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
rail.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rail.en: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
rail.zh: 自2008年罗马至米兰的高铁网络开通以来，火车已成为当地人和游客在意大利境内旅行的首选交通工具。
rail.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reduction.en: Mandatory in-person renewal was associated with a 31 percent reduction in fatal crashes involving drivers 85 or older, according to one study.
reduction.zh: 一项研究显示，强制本人到场续领驾照与85岁及以上驾驶员致命车祸减少31%相关。
reduction.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reduction.en: Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.
reduction.zh: 水石书店各分店收入大幅减少。
reduction.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

region.en: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.
region.zh: 美国其他地区、加拿大以及欧洲都在稳步加大力度，通过激励措施吸引影视剧组入驻，这使得加利福尼亚州望尘莫及。
region.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

region.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
region.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
region.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

release.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
release.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
release.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

release.en: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
release.zh: 因此，除非客户愿意签署数据使用授权协议，否则人工智能的应用在未来可能会受到一定限制。
release.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

religious.en: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
religious.zh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
religious.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

religious.en: Durkheim proposed that religious beliefs functioned to reinforce social solidarity.
religious.zh: 涂尔干提出，宗教信仰的功能在于加强社会团结。
religious.src: 2009 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

revolution.en: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
revolution.zh: 我们仍处于这场革命的开端，当下的微小选择未来可能会产生巨大的影响。
revolution.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

revolution.en: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
revolution.zh: 工业革命对那些工作被机械化织布机取代的卢德派分子来说并不是什么好事，但它最终提高了生活水平，创造的就业机会也多于其摧毁的数量。
revolution.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

root.en: "They even claimed that plants have 'brain-like command centers' at their root tips."
root.zh: 他们甚至声称植物的根尖处存在'类似大脑的指挥中心'。
root.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

root.en: The drive to discover is deeply rooted in humans, much the same as the basic drives for food or shelter, says Christopher Hsee of the University of Chicago.
root.zh: 芝加哥大学的奚恺元表示，人类探索未知的驱动力根深蒂固，与对食物或住所的基本需求大致相同。
root.src: 2018 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

scholar.en: Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.
scholar.zh: 该委员会的51名成员包括顶尖大学校长、学者、律师、法官、企业高管，以及外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻领域的知名人士。
scholar.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

scholar.en: Whole new realms of understanding – from gender to race to cultural studies – were opened up as scholars unpicked the multiplicity of lost societies.
scholar.zh: 随着学者们深入剖析那些被遗忘的社会的多样性，从性别研究到种族研究再到文化研究，全新的理解领域被开辟出来。
scholar.src: 2012 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

slave.en: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."
slave.zh: 这本薄薄的书充满了各种实用建议，无论是工薪阶层还是彩票中奖者，都能从中学会如何'让每一分钱都带来最大的快乐价值'。
slave.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

slave.en: His affair with a slave stained his prestige.
slave.zh: 他与一名奴隶的暧昧关系玷污了他的声望。
slave.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

strengthen.en: Conversations are links, which means when you have a conversation with a new person a link gets formed and every conversation you have after that moment will strengthen the link.
strengthen.zh: 对话是一种纽带。这意味着当你与一个陌生人交谈时，便形成了一条纽带，而此后的每一次交谈都会加固这条纽带。
strengthen.src: 2018 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

strengthen.en: Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress.
strengthen.zh: 大法官们希望加强与国会的协调。
strengthen.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

therefore.en: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
therefore.zh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
therefore.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

therefore.en: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
therefore.zh: 因此，除非客户愿意签署数据使用授权协议，否则人工智能的应用在未来可能会受到一定限制。
therefore.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

vehicle.en: They've helped pull wheeled vehicles, carry travelers and move goods across the world.
vehicle.zh: 它们曾帮助人们拉动轮式车辆、运送旅客以及在全球范围内搬运货物。
vehicle.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

vehicle.en: In this way, AI can be a fun vehicle for self-discovery.
vehicle.zh: 通过这种方式，人工智能可以成为自我发现的有趣媒介。
vehicle.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

acknowledge.en: With so much research left to do, leaders in the field have been doing some soul-searching, and acknowledging that restoration can be motivated by — and designed to meet — different needs.
acknowledge.zh: 面对繁重的研究任务，该领域的领军人物一直在进行反思，并承认修复工作的动力和设计初衷可以源于不同的需求。
acknowledge.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

acknowledge.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's.
acknowledge.zh: 我们必须承认，环境并非每个人的首要关切——甚至也不是大多数人的。
acknowledge.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

adjust.en: That tells me whether I need to adjust my training program.
adjust.zh: 这能告诉我是否需要调整训练计划。
adjust.src: 2019 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

adjust.en: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
adjust.zh: 但在中期内，中产阶级劳动者可能需要大量帮助来适应这种变化。
adjust.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

adopt.en: people should adopt a sensible attitude to innovations.
adopt.zh: 人们应当对创新持理性的态度。
adopt.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

adopt.en: In other words, you can't mention your suggestion once and expect it to be adopted.
adopt.zh: 换句话说，你不能只提一次建议就期望它被采纳。
adopt.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

arise.en: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations.
arise.zh: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和法规时，问题就出现了。
arise.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

arise.en: In fact, creative problem-solving skills are incredibly useful in daily life, with which you're more likely to be able to find a solution when a problem arises.
arise.zh: 事实上，创造性解决问题的能力在日常生活中极为有用，有了这种能力，当问题出现时，你更有可能找到解决方案。
arise.src: 2022 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

award.en: A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
award.zh: 支持者认为，“文化之镇”奖项可以成为一项年度盛事，吸引资金投入并创造就业机会。
award.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

award.en: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
award.zh: 该提案建议，这一奖项应与现有的“文化之城”称号并行设立，赫尔市曾于2017年获得该称号，考文垂市则被授予2021年“文化之城”称号。
award.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

bias.en: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias, and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands.
bias.zh: 研究还发现，阅读能让我们更乐于助人，减少偏见，甚至延长寿命——如果我们手里有一本好书，我们将更加享受这份长寿带来的乐趣。

bias.en: It uses analytics to help identify where there may be bias in the hiring process.
bias.zh: 该公司利用分析技术帮助识别招聘过程中可能存在偏见的环节。
bias.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

celebrity.en: Having children contributes little to the glamour of celebrity moms.
celebrity.zh: 生育子女对明星妈妈的光环魅力几乎没有什么贡献。
celebrity.src: 2011 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

celebrity.en: Celebrity moms have influenced our attitude towards child rearing.
celebrity.zh: 明星妈妈已经影响了我们对养育子女的态度。
celebrity.src: 2011 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cell.en: They've implored citizen scientists to help with bug counting and categorising cancer cells, and even identifying distant galaxies.
cell.zh: 他们恳请公民科学家协助进行昆虫计数、癌细胞分类，甚至识别遥远的星系。
cell.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

cell.en: However, the signaling in a plant is only superficially similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity," Taiz said.
cell.zh: 然而，泰兹指出，植物体内的信号传导与复杂动物大脑中的神经冲动只是表面相似，而动物大脑远不止是'一团通过电流进行交流的细胞'。
cell.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

collective.en: The effort was a collective one and involved other companies as well as a Swedish university.
collective.zh: 这是一项集体努力，有其他公司以及一所瑞典大学共同参与。
collective.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

collective.en: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
collective.zh: 我们需要能够引导集体行动（并约束污染企业）的前瞻性政策，同时也需要积极参与的公民推动变革。
collective.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

combine.en: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
combine.zh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
combine.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

combine.en: Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two.
combine.zh: 通过视力测试也能使这些驾驶员的致命撞车事故率产生类似幅度的下降，不过将这两项措施结合起来似乎并无额外益处。
combine.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conscious.en: Another set of participants had to count backward from 1,000 by nines as they watched the clips, occupying their conscious working memory.
conscious.zh: 另一组参与者在观看视频片段时，需要从1000开始倒数，每次减9，这占用了他们的有意识工作记忆。
conscious.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conscious.en: This forces users to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
conscious.zh: 这迫使用户更加意识到自己在信息传播中的作用。
conscious.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

deliver.en: The thing itself is the medium that delivers the information.
deliver.zh: 事物本身就是传递信息的媒介。
deliver.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

deliver.en: If the world is to meet its net-zero ambitions, we must think hard about how we can deliver sustainable computing and deliver more LUMIs.
deliver.zh: 若要实现全球净零排放的宏伟目标，我们必须认真思考如何提供可持续计算，并打造更多类似LUMI的超级计算机。
deliver.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

deny.en: Will those jurisdictions extend the same protections now denied under Sackett v. EPA?
deny.zh: 那些辖区会提供萨基特诉美国环保局案中被剥夺的同等保护吗？
deny.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

deny.en: She denies the value of scientific work.
deny.zh: 她否定科学研究的价值。
deny.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

estate.en: Many of the aspects of homebuying aren't a consideration for children, said Tracey Hampson, a real estate agent based in Santa Clarita, Calif.
estate.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣克拉丽塔的房地产经纪人特蕾西·汉普森表示，购房的许多方面都不在孩子们的考虑范围内。
estate.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

estate.en: Younger children should feel like they're choosing their home – without actually getting a choice in the matter, said Adam Bailey, real estate attorney based in New York.
estate.zh: 纽约房地产律师亚当·贝利表示，年幼的孩子应该感觉像是自己在选择家——但实际上并不让他们真正做决定。
estate.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

explanation.en: It can be hard for scientists to make the case because our work is complex, often takes place behind closed doors and does not always lend itself to easy interpretation or explanation.
explanation.zh: 科学家们往往难以阐明自己的工作价值，因为我们的研究复杂难懂，常常在闭门情况下进行，而且并非总能轻易解释或说明。
explanation.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

explanation.en: The likely explanation is that the withdrawal was rushed, and they didn't want the local Caledonians getting their hands on 10 tons of weapon-grade iron.
explanation.zh: 最可能的解释是，罗马军队撤退仓促，不愿让当地的喀里多尼亚人得到这10吨可用于制造武器的铁。
explanation.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

fuel.en: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels – especially coal – as the path to economic growth.
fuel.zh: 特朗普总统强调化石燃料——尤其是煤炭——是实现经济增长的途径。
fuel.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fuel.en: While fossil fuels – coal, oil, gas – still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
fuel.zh: 虽然化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍占全球能源供应的约85%，但未来属于风能和太阳能等可再生能源这一点比以往任何时候都更加明确。
fuel.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

identity.en: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood, and identity.
identity.zh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
identity.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

identity.en: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness? What makes humans humans?"
identity.zh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引发了一些根本性问题：“何为智能、身份或意识？是什么让人类成为人类？”
identity.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

immediate.en: Kids tend to get stuck in the features and the immediate benefits to them personally, Norris said.
immediate.zh: 诺里斯说，孩子们往往只关注房子的特色以及这些特色给自己带来的即时利益。
immediate.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

immediate.en: The most immediate changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
immediate.zh: 最立即可见的变化将体现在技能水平、力量和腰围尺寸的减小上。
immediate.src: 2019 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

insect.en: "Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year," says forest ecologist John Stanturf.
insect.zh: 森林生态学家约翰·斯坦特夫表示：“如果某些昆虫一年能繁殖三到四代，那么如今只是小麻烦的它们，未来可能会演变成大问题。”
insect.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

insect.en: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species.
insect.zh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
insect.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

literature.en: For a time literature showed no interest in this public stage.
literature.zh: 有段时间，文学界对这个公共舞台毫无兴趣。
literature.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

literature.en: His concern is mainly with the humanities: literature, languages, philosophy and so on.
literature.zh: 他主要关注的是人文学科：文学、语言学、哲学等等。

mostly.en: These are mostly students who had no opportunity as children to travel to wilderness areas, wildlife refuges or national parks.
mostly.zh: 这些学生大多在儿时没有机会前往荒野地区、野生动物保护区或国家公园。
mostly.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

mostly.en: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.
mostly.zh: 与此同时，美国邮政还有超过1200亿美元的未备资金负债，其中大部分用于员工医疗和退休福利支出。
mostly.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

neighborhood.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
neighborhood.zh: 今年夏天，当您尽情享受家门口的街道节庆时，希望您能记住，正是有了社区的支持，这些活动才得以存在。
neighborhood.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

neighborhood.en: Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of Chicago as a whole.
neighborhood.zh: 芝加哥的夏季音乐节不仅是娱乐活动，更是直接惠及所在社区乃至整个芝加哥市的经济引擎。
neighborhood.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

norm.en: Different cultures have their norms and expectations regarding dress, which can influence the types of clothing people wear and the meanings attributed to them.
norm.zh: 不同的文化对着装有各自的规范和预期，这会影响人们选择的服装类型及其所代表的含义。
norm.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

norm.en: Today's tip requests are often not connected to the salary and service norms that used to determine when and how people tip.
norm.zh: 如今的小费请求往往与过去决定人们何时以及如何给小费的薪资和服务规范脱节。
norm.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

novel.en: Two centuries ago, the idea of preserving nature, rather than exploiting it, was a novel one to many US settlers.
novel.zh: 两个世纪前，对许多美国殖民者而言，保护自然而非开发自然的理念还是一种新奇的想法。

novel.en: And so he reads – everything from encyclopedias to science fiction novels.
novel.zh: 于是他开始博览群书——从百科全书到科幻小说，无所不读。
novel.src: 2018 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

nuclear.en: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.
nuclear.zh: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》发表的一篇论文中，研究人员指出，西方核心家庭是近代的产物，它打破了人类的进化史。
nuclear.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

nuclear.en: The conflict has been surfacing since 2002, when the corporation bought Vermont's only nuclear power plant, an aging reactor in Vernon.
nuclear.zh: 这场纠纷早在2002年就已初现端倪，当时该公司收购了佛蒙特州唯一的核电站——位于弗农市的一座老旧反应堆。
nuclear.src: 2012 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

operate.en: "The people who are stealing our movies and our television shows and operating piracy sites are not mom and pop operations," says Charlie Rivkin, chief executive officer of the MPA.
operate.zh: 美国电影协会首席执行官查理·里夫金表示：“那些窃取我们的电影和电视节目并运营盗版网站的人并非小打小闹的夫妻店。”
operate.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

operate.en: Both the wildlife park and zoo claimed to be operating for the benefit of the animals and for conservation purposes.
operate.zh: 野生动物园和动物园都声称其运营是为了动物的利益和保护目的。
operate.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

personality.en: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood, and identity.
personality.zh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
personality.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

personality.en: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact
personality.zh: 性格会影响人对眼神接触的反应方式
personality.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

pose.en: Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms, she said.
pose.zh: 她说，要想规避所有这些人类驾驶员带来的危险，需要编写太多的算法。
pose.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

pose.en: remarks that significant moves may pose challenges to children.
pose.zh: 称重大搬家可能给孩子带来困难
pose.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

practical.en: In a very practical way, the Internet is becoming an external hard drive for our memories, a process known as "cognitive offloading."
practical.zh: 从非常实际的角度来看，互联网正成为我们记忆的外部硬盘，这一过程被称为'认知卸载'。
practical.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

practical.en: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
practical.zh: 如果说“有 entitlement 心态”是人们用来形容千禧一代（1981年至1995年出生的人）最常见的形容词——无论这种说法是否公平——那么Z世代的关键词则是务实和谨慎。
practical.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

psychology.en: The influence of wearables on psychology refers to how the clothes we wear affect our thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.
psychology.zh: 穿戴物对心理的影响，是指我们所穿的衣服如何影响我们的思维、情感和行为。
psychology.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

psychology.en: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.
psychology.zh: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》发表的一篇论文中，研究人员指出，西方核心家庭是近代的产物，它打破了人类的进化史。
psychology.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

pursue.en: Give priority to pursuing its net-zero strategy.
pursue.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

pursue.en: As adults, it seems that we are constantly pursuing happiness, often with mixed results.
pursue.zh: 作为成年人，我们似乎一直在追求幸福，但其结果往往喜忧参半。
pursue.src: 2016 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

railroad.en: Your outline should smoothly conduct you from one point to the next, but do not permit it to railroad you.
railroad.zh: 你的提纲应当引导你从一个观点自然过渡到下一个观点，但不要让它束缚你的思路。
railroad.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

railroad.en: "Do we really want railroads to be the arbiters of who wins and who loses in the marketplace?" asks Martin Bercovici, a Washington lawyer who frequently represents shippers.
railroad.zh: 华盛顿律师马丁·伯科维奇经常代表托运人，他问道：“我们真的希望铁路公司成为市场上决定谁胜谁负的仲裁者吗？”
railroad.src: 2003 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

relevant.en: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?
relevant.zh: 为何水石书店要将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍移至其相关分类区域？
relevant.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

relevant.en: And third, growth was reflected in changes in the proportion of the relevant age group enrolled in institutions of higher education.
relevant.zh: 第三，高等教育的发展体现在相关年龄段人群中高等教育机构入学比例的变化上。
relevant.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

request.en: We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city's largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations.
request.zh: 我们经常听到人们询问，为什么我们要在大门入口处募集捐款，尤其是在像芝加哥爵士音乐节这样的大型城市节日都不要求捐赠的情况下。
request.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

request.en: If you struggle with low self-esteem, you might find it especially difficult to reach out for help because you have the added worry of the other person declining your request.
request.zh: 如果你饱受自卑困扰，可能会发现求助格外困难，因为你还会额外担心对方拒绝你的请求。
request.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

software.en: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
software.zh: 在组建增长团队之前，软件公司BitTorrent有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。
software.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

software.en: Microsoft's own Office dominates the market for "productivity" software, but the start-ups represented a new wave of technology designed from the ground up for the smartphone world.
software.zh: 微软自家的Office软件主导着"生产力"软件市场，但这些初创公司代表了为智能手机世界从头打造的新一轮技术浪潮。
software.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

stable.en: According to the website Lexica, which tracks over 10 million Stable Diffusion images and prompts, Rutkowski's name has been used as a prompt around 93,000 times.
stable.zh: 据追踪超过1000万张Stable Diffusion图像和提示词的网站Lexica统计，鲁特科夫斯基的名字已被用作提示词约93,000次。
stable.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

stable.en: His distinctive style is now one of the most commonly used prompts in the new open-source AI art generator Stable Diffusion.
stable.zh: 他独特的风格如今已成为新开源AI艺术生成器Stable Diffusion中最常用的提示词之一。
stable.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

strike.en: The Government has pledged to change the law to introduce a minimum service requirement so that, even when strikes occur, services can continue to operate.
strike.zh: 政府已承诺修改法律，引入最低服务要求，以确保即使发生罢工，铁路服务也能继续运营。
strike.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

strike.en: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
strike.zh: 在一系列研究中，研究人员指示芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通的通勤者与身边的人攀谈。
strike.src: 2021 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

talent.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
talent.zh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
talent.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

talent.en: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
talent.zh: 专家表示，在至少一项课外活动中展现才华有助于大学申请，尤其是在顶尖本科院校的申请过程中。
talent.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

technique.en: Since the 1960s, underwater archaeology techniques and tools had made huge advances.
technique.zh: 自20世纪60年代以来，水下考古技术和工具取得了巨大进步。
technique.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

technique.en: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
technique.zh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

transform.en: Solar panels had a few niche uses until they became cheap; now they are transforming the global energy system.
transform.zh: 太阳能电池板在价格亲民之前仅有少数特定用途；如今，它们正在改变全球能源系统。
transform.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

transform.en: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
transform.zh: 它们改变了当地居民的愿景抱负；它们将城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的新高度。
transform.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

typical.en: A typical digital SLR camera shoots 20 frames a second.
typical.zh: 一款典型的数码单反相机每秒可拍摄20帧。

typical.en: We know that a typical infant will instinctively gaze into its mother's eyes, and she will look back.
typical.zh: 我们知道，普通婴儿会本能地凝视母亲的眼睛，而母亲也会回以注视。
typical.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

unlikely.en: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
unlikely.zh: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论人士认为短期内似乎不太可能出台全面的联邦隐私法规。
unlikely.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

unlikely.en: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable.
unlikely.zh: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就结束学业；他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持就业能力。
unlikely.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

acquire.en: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
acquire.zh: 专业人士想要学习新技能时，将能够在不负债的情况下实现这一目标。
acquire.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

acquire.en: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
acquire.zh: 因此，各学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

acquisition.en: What is true about Wunderlist and Sunrise after their acquisitions?
acquisition.zh: Wunderlist和Sunrise在被收购后情况如何？
acquisition.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

acquisition.en: This week, it asked the five most valuable US tech companies for information about their many small acquisitions over the past decade.
acquisition.zh: 本周，该委员会要求美国市值最高的五家科技公司提供它们在过去十年中众多小型收购案的相关信息。
acquisition.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

admission.en: However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in.
admission.zh: 然而，大学招生专家表示，准大学生课外活动的质量比其参与的活动数量更为重要。
admission.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

admission.en: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
admission.zh: 专家表示，在至少一项课外活动中展现才华有助于大学申请，尤其是在顶尖本科院校的申请过程中。
admission.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

alter.en: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species.
alter.zh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
alter.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

alter.en: "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."
alter.zh: 他们对食物链的改变，其影响程度就连他们自己可能都没有完全意识到。
alter.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

battle.en: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
battle.zh: 战争日益依赖于雷达和近炸引信等新型军事技术。
battle.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

battle.en: I first discovered the Napoleonic cryptographic battle a few years ago when I was reading Sir Charles Oman's epic History of the Peninsular War.
battle.zh: 几年前，我在阅读查尔斯·奥曼爵士的鸿篇巨著《半岛战争史》时，首次发现了拿破仑战争时期这场密码战的存在。
battle.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

boom.en: Some will say the audiobook boom revives it, though I suppose you can then worry about the decline of reading.
boom.zh: 有人会说有声书的兴起让它得以复兴，不过我想接下来你可能又要担心阅读能力的下降了。
boom.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

boom.en: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
boom.zh: 然而，如果认为我们当前只是在经历经济繁荣与萧条周期中的阵痛，那就错了。
boom.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）
