branch.en: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald's.
branch.zh: 当我走访全国各地的图书馆时，令我惊讶的是，图书馆的数量（2,892家）竟然是麦当劳门店数量的两倍还多。
branch.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

branch.en: Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.
branch.zh: 水石书店各分店收入大幅减少。
branch.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

budget.en: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
budget.zh: 市面上有如此多的产品在巨额广告和营销预算的推波助澜下进行促销，以至于人们很容易成为受害者。
budget.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

budget.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires – nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
budget.zh: 2015年，美国林务局首次将其55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于火灾扑救——这一比例几乎是20年前的两倍。
budget.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

candidate.en: AI looks at resumes in greater numbers than humans would be able to, and selects the more promising candidates.
candidate.zh: 人工智能能够处理的简历数量远超人类，并且能够筛选出更有潜力的候选人。
candidate.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

candidate.en: AI looks at resumes in greater numbers than humans would be able to, and selects the more promising candidates.
candidate.zh: 人工智能能够处理比人类多得多的简历，并筛选出更有潜力的候选人。
candidate.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

chemical.en: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.
chemical.zh: 植物产生的挥发性化学物质可以传播很远，并且具有非常独特的特征：每种植物或树木都有其特定的气味特征。
chemical.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

chemical.en: Van Oosten calls those chemicals "sunscreens" because their goal was to prevent further light damage and rebuild worn polymer fibers.
chemical.zh: 范·奥斯坦将这些化学物质称为“防晒霜”，因为它们的目的是防止进一步的光损伤并修复受损的聚合物纤维。
chemical.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

classical.en: He specializes in classical painting digitalization.
classical.zh: 他擅长将古典绘画风格数字化
classical.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

classical.en: A Polish digital artist who uses classical painting styles to create dreamy fantasy landscapes, Greg Rutkowski has made illustrations for games such as Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering.
classical.zh: 格雷格·鲁特科夫斯基是一位波兰数字艺术家，他运用古典绘画风格创作梦幻般的奇幻风景，曾为《龙与地下城》和《万智牌》等游戏绘制插画。
classical.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

constitution.en: It may go against the Constitution.
constitution.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

constitution.en: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections.
constitution.zh: 新兴的颠覆性技术有时需要我们以全新方式应用宪法赋予的各项保护。
constitution.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

context.en: The context of any exhibit is more important to me than whether the object being displayed is 2,000 years old or 2 months old.
context.zh: 对我而言，任何展览的背景信息都比展品本身是有2000年历史还是仅2个月历史更为重要。
context.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

context.en: Enlist the support of professionals and share with them your goals and context.
context.zh: 争取专业人士的支持，并向他们说明你的目标和所处环境。
context.src: 2016 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

cope.en: For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.
cope.zh: 例如，老年人口众多的社区或难以应对高温的非正式住房区，可以获得特殊预警或增设降温中心。
cope.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

cope.en: "Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system," he said.
cope.zh: 他说：“孩子们在应对重大搬家时可能会面临严重困难，尤其是当搬家让他们离开现在的学校或支持系统时。”
cope.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

differ.en: Although these methods differ, the main principles remain the same.
differ.zh: 尽管这些方法各不相同，但其主要原理保持一致。
differ.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

differ.en: Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it differs so greatly from that of animals that so-called evidence of plants' intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
differ.zh: 作者写道，植物生物学复杂而迷人，但其与动物生物学存在巨大差异，因此所谓植物拥有智能的证据并不确凿。
differ.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

emphasis.en: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.
emphasis.zh: 而过分强调他们的意见可能会毁掉一笔极好的购房交易。
emphasis.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

emphasis.en: The current emphasis on standardized testing highlights analysis and procedure, meaning that few of us inherently use our innovative and collaborative modes of thought.
emphasis.zh: 当前对标准化测试的重视，突出了分析和程序化思维，这意味着我们中很少有人会本能地运用创新和协作的思维模式。
emphasis.src: 2009 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

entire.en: If there's congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
entire.zh: 如果发生拥堵，或者例如有一辆区间列车发生故障，整个高铁网络都会受到影响。
entire.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

entire.en: To prevent entire ecosystems from going up in smoke, Martin said, people must bring healthy fire back to places that need it.
entire.zh: 马丁表示，为了防止整个生态系统毁于一旦，人们必须将“健康的火种”带回那些真正需要它的地方。
entire.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

epidemic.en: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
epidemic.zh: 如今，乌托邦式的理想已不再流行，因为我们对面临的各种威胁有了更深刻的认识，从小行星撞击到流感大流行，再到气候变化。
epidemic.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

epidemic.en: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
epidemic.zh: 鉴于目前近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——可以说这是一场由沟通失败引发的流行病。
epidemic.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

era.en: It led to a new era of isolating culture.
era.zh: 它开启了一个孤立文化的新时代。
era.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

era.en: In the information era, large data sets, small teams and financial restrictions have slowed scientific process.
era.zh: 在信息时代，庞大的数据集、小型团队和资金限制减缓了科学进程。
era.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

escape.en: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature.
escape.zh: 国家公园为美国民众提供了巨大价值，既是休闲避难之所，也是自然的象征。
escape.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

escape.en: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape.
escape.zh: 在实验过程中，社交型机器鼠会跟随活鼠四处活动，玩同样的玩具，并会打开笼门让被困的老鼠逃脱。
escape.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

guide.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
guide.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
guide.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

guide.en: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations.
guide.zh: 高空平台系统还可以指导住宅翻新工作或修改建筑法规。
guide.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

habitat.en: The earliest habitats of donkeys are hardly traceable.
habitat.zh: 驴的最早栖息地已几乎无迹可寻。
habitat.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

habitat.en: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat, and gardening habits—paving over gardens and using pesticides—aren't helping either.
habitat.zh: 全球变暖对某些物种有利，但另一些物种因过于孤立而无法找到合适的新栖息地，而园艺习惯——将花园铺上硬路面和使用杀虫剂——也无济于事。

implication.en: For businesses, the implications are worrying.
implication.zh: 对于企业而言，其影响令人担忧。
implication.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

implication.en: The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president's social media platform.
implication.zh: 这意味着千禧一代更希望白宫新闻通过其他渠道过滤后发布，而非总统的社交媒体平台。
implication.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

inflation.en: This year's rise, an average of 2.7 per cent, may be a fraction lower than last year's, but it is still well above the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) measure of inflation.
inflation.zh: 今年的票价平均上涨2.7%，虽比去年略低，但仍远高于官方消费者价格指数（CPI）衡量的通胀水平。
inflation.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

inflation.en: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation.
inflation.zh: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费用和这些“文章处理费”的成本一直在以高于通胀的速度稳步上涨。
inflation.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

legitimate.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
legitimate.zh: 咨询公司帕克斯协会预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失在未来两年将达到1130亿美元。
legitimate.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

legitimate.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
legitimate.zh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
legitimate.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

locate.en: The animals could benefit from more research: Currently, there are no published genomes from donkeys located south of the Equator in Africa.
locate.zh: 这些动物可能会从更多的研究中受益：目前，赤道以南的非洲驴类尚无已发布的基因组数据。
locate.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

locate.en: Free-ranging elephants presumably also use this information to locate their preferred food.
locate.zh: 自由活动的大象很可能也利用这些信息来寻找它们偏爱的食物。
locate.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

massive.en: What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event, welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down.
massive.zh: 这一起初只是小规模的邻里聚会，后来发展壮大成为一项盛大的文化盛事，在近二十年的时间里，每年都吸引数万民众参与，直到最后戛然而止。
massive.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

massive.en: That makes it sound easy, and artificial, but Peters insists it is still a massive challenge.
massive.zh: 这听起来简单又做作，但彼得斯坚持认为这仍然是一个巨大的挑战。

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile, the number of annual visitors has increased by more than 50% since 1980, and now stands at 330 million visitors per year.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，自1980年以来，年游客量增长了50%以上，目前已达到每年3.3亿人次。
meanwhile.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile, Schwitzgebel—who had predicted no effect—will be eating his words.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，曾预测不会产生任何效果的施维茨格贝尔可要收回自己的话了。
meanwhile.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

necessity.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
necessity.zh: 科罗拉多大学的鲍尔奇教授表示，与此同时，人们仍然将火灾视为一种需要全面控制的事件，只有在必要时才让其发生。
necessity.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

necessity.en: Of necessity, colonial America was a projection of Europe.
necessity.zh: 必然地，殖民时期的美洲是欧洲的一种延伸。
necessity.src: 2015 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

odd.en: This narrowing of the regulatory scope was a victory for builders, mining operators and other commercial interests often at odds with environmental rules.
odd.zh: 监管范围的这种缩小对建筑商、采矿运营商以及其他常常与环境法规存在冲突的商业利益集团而言是一场胜利。
odd.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

odd.en: At the same time, Dickens, who had a reporter's eye for transcribing the life around him, especially anything comic or odd, submitted short sketches to obscure magazines.
odd.zh: 与此同时，狄更斯以记者特有的敏锐观察记录着身边的生活，尤其善于捕捉那些滑稽或奇特的事物，并向一些名不见经传的杂志投稿短篇随笔。

oppose.en: While some locals opposed the designation, the decision was largely accepted—and Jackson's photos played a key role in the fight to protect the area.
oppose.zh: 尽管一些当地人反对这一 designation，但该决定总体上获得了认可——而杰克逊的照片在保护该地区的斗争中发挥了关键作用。

oppose.en: It has been opposed by a judge.
oppose.zh: 一位法官已否决了这一决定。
oppose.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

partly.en: The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
partly.zh: 意大利国家铁路公司表示，该国陈旧基础设施的大规模改造工程是造成交通中断的部分原因。
partly.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

partly.en: This is partly because universities continue to produce ever more PhDs.
partly.zh: 部分原因是大学一直在培养越来越多的博士。

preference.en: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
preference.zh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
preference.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

preference.en: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
preference.zh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
preference.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

prompt.en: These systems often prompted customers to tip for services that were not previously tipped.
prompt.zh: 这些系统常常会提示顾客为以前不需要给小费的服务支付小费。
prompt.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

prompt.en: The tool, along with other popular image-generation AI models, allows anyone to create impressive images based on text prompts.
prompt.zh: 这款工具与其他流行的图像生成AI模型一样，任何人都能通过文字提示创建出令人印象深刻的图像。
prompt.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

random.en: True: for more than 80 pre-digital years, linear speech broadcasting brought the gift of serendipity, random enlivening of a car journey or dull manual task.
random.zh: 的确，在数字时代到来前的 80 多年里，线性广播带来了意外发现的乐趣，为驾车出行或枯燥的体力活增添了随机的活力。
random.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

random.en: Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House (PRH), a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.
random.zh: 这两本书均由企鹅兰登书屋（PRH）于下周出版，该公司目前正与水石书店陷入对峙。
random.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reject.en: This means that people should avoid crisping their roast potatoes, reject thin-crust pizzas and only partially toast their bread.
reject.zh: 这意味着人们应该避免将烤土豆烤至酥脆，拒绝薄皮披萨，并且只将面包烤至半熟。
reject.src: 2020 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

reject.en: Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim.
reject.zh: 所有大法官都理所当然地驳回了这一异乎寻常的主张。
reject.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

representative.en: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
representative.zh: 但该裁决强调，确保公民平等接触政府的责任在于公民及其民选代表，而非法院。
representative.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

representative.en: They are the most representative honor.
representative.zh: 它们是最具代表性的荣誉。
representative.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

restore.en: Climate change is a driving factor in the push to restore forests, but it also raises questions, such as where trees can thrive in the future.
restore.zh: 气候变化是推动森林恢复的一个驱动因素，但也引发了一些问题，例如未来哪些地方适合树木生长。
restore.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

restore.en: It has restored the balance among neighboring jurisdictions.
restore.zh: 它恢复了相邻辖区之间的平衡。
restore.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

rural.en: Pay greater attention to boosting rural economies.
rural.zh: 更加重视促进农村经济发展
rural.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rural.en: That's likely because the rural poor are using the money as makeshift insurance policies against inclement weather, Ferraro says.
rural.zh: 费拉罗说，这可能是因为农村贫困人口将这笔钱用作应对恶劣天气的临时保障措施。
rural.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

stage.en: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
stage.zh: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉姆斯（Eric Williams）发起的银色房间街头派对（Silver Room Block Party）宣布，该活动将不会在2024年回归。
stage.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

stage.en: Although only a research project at this stage, the request has raised the prospect of regulators wading into early-stage tech markets that until now have been beyond their reach.
stage.zh: 尽管目前这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已经引发了监管机构介入早期科技市场的可能性，而这些市场此前一直是他们难以触及的领域。
stage.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trace.en: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
trace.zh: 随后，他们追踪了这些动物在大约 2,500 年后是如何穿过大陆其余地区，进而扩散到欧洲和亚洲的。
trace.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

trace.en: Now, researchers have used genomes of over 200 donkeys to trace their domestication back to a single event around 7,000 years ago in East Africa — about 3,000 years before humans tamed horses.
trace.zh: 现在，研究人员通过对 200 多头驴的基因组进行分析，追溯到它们的驯化起源于约 7000 年前东非的一次单一事件——这比人类驯服马的时间早了约 3000 年。
trace.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

trait.en: The researchers studied "prosocial" and rebellious traits in more than 200 children and young adults, ranging from 11 to 28 years old.
trait.zh: 研究人员对200多名11至28岁的儿童和年轻人的“亲社会”特质与叛逆特质进行了研究。
trait.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trait.en: But a comparative study of linguistic traits published online today supplies a reality check.
trait.zh: 但今日在线发表的一项语言特征比较研究为我们提供了现实检验。
trait.src: 2012 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

trial.en: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils aged nine and ten—at 45 state primary schools that had not been "previously exposed to RSC pedagogy".
trial.zh: 这项随机对照试验涉及45所州立小学的数百名9至10岁五年级学生，这些学校此前"未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团教学法"。
trial.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）
2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

underestimate.zh: 他们的威胁一直被低估了。
underestimate.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

underestimate.zh: 他们的库存量被低估了。
underestimate.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

widespread.en: Psychologists have been interested in this question for decades, not least because people's widespread reluctance to ask for help has led to some high-profile failures.
widespread.zh: 心理学家对这个问题的研究已有数十年之久，尤其是因为人们普遍不愿寻求帮助，这已导致了一些备受瞩目的失败案例。
widespread.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

widespread.en: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
widespread.zh: 她表示，只是个人行动见效太慢，不足以成为改变普遍行为的唯一甚至主要途径。
widespread.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

wild.en: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
wild.zh: 研究团队重建了这些动物的进化树，并利用计算机模型精准定位了这次驯化事件，即肯尼亚和非洲之角的牧民驯服野驴的时间点。
wild.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

wild.en: They also looked at genomes from 15 wild equids and 31 earlier donkeys that lived between about 4,000 and 100 years ago.
wild.zh: 他们还研究了来自 15 种野生马科动物以及 31 头生活在大约 4,000 年至 100 年前的早期驴类的基因组。
wild.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

adapt.en: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
adapt.zh: 为了帮助改进健康行动计划（HAPs），城市规划师拉贾什里·科萨尔卡尔的团队正在制定一个模型计划，其中概述了最佳实践，并可根据当地情况进行调整。
adapt.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

adapt.en: In other words, human memory is not deteriorating but "adapting to new communications technology," Sparrow says.
adapt.zh: 斯派洛说，换句话说，人类的记忆力并没有衰退，而是在'适应新的通信技术'。
adapt.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

admit.en: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
admit.zh: 在签署这项法案时，加利福尼亚州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确基于性别对人进行分类的法律可能违宪。
admit.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

admit.en: A large part of evaluation is calling out bad arguments, but we also need to admit good arguments by opponents and to apply the same critical standards to ourselves.
admit.zh: 评估的很大一部分在于指出不良论点，但我们也需要承认对手的合理论点，并将同样的批判标准应用于自身。

advanced.en: They started out as a novelty feature, but as their use has grown, their benefits have extended within our technologically advanced world.
advanced.zh: 它们最初只是新奇的特色装置，但随着使用范围的扩大，其优势在我们这个技术先进的世界中得到了进一步拓展。
advanced.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

advanced.en: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.
advanced.zh: 半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院成立了高级视觉研究中心（CAVS），旨在探索科技在文化中的作用。
advanced.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

anxiety.en: According to Dr. Nikhil Chaudhary, an evolutionary anthropologist at Cambridge University, these practices, known as alloparenting, could lead to less anxiety for children and parents.
anxiety.zh: 剑桥大学进化人类学家尼克希尔·乔杜里博士表示，这些被称为“异亲抚育”的做法可以减轻孩子和父母的焦虑。
anxiety.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

anxiety.en: But you will reap benefits such as less anxiety and improve sleep right away.
anxiety.zh: 但你会立即收获诸多益处，比如焦虑减轻和睡眠改善。
anxiety.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

attractive.en: While attractive, new ideas can be distracting; the team leader must recognize when these ideas don't serve the current goal and need to be put on the back burner.
attractive.zh: 新想法虽然诱人，但可能会分散注意力；团队领导者必须识别出哪些想法无助于当前目标实现，需要暂时搁置。
attractive.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

attractive.en: "Overtime is not attractive to this generation. They really want to live their lives," she says.
attractive.zh: 她说：“这一代人对加班并不感冒。他们真心想过自己的生活。”
attractive.src: 2017 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

certainly.en: Certainly, it's incredibly hard to maintain patience at all times with your children.
certainly.zh: 当然，要时刻对孩子保持耐心绝非易事。
certainly.src: 2020 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

certainly.en: Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment.
certainly.zh: 当然，不应布置学生无法独立完成或需要昂贵设备才能完成的家庭作业。
certainly.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

constant.en: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
constant.zh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
constant.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

constant.en: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war.
constant.zh: 二战结束时，这些社会的高等教育入学率与战前几十年大致持平，约为相应年龄段人口的3%-5%。
constant.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

contain.en: Written accounts contain vital clues for donkey research.
contain.zh: 文献记载为驴的研究提供了关键线索。
contain.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

contain.en: But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study's duration of several weeks.
contain.zh: 但在参与肉类伦理讨论的学生受试者中，含肉类的餐食购买比例从52%下降到45%——并且这一效果在数周的研究期间保持稳定。
contain.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

convey.en: What message is conveyed in Brooks' statement?
convey.zh: 布鲁克斯的陈述传达了什么信息？
convey.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

convey.en: Whether we opt for bold, colorful outfits or prefer more understated styles, our dress choices convey messages about who we are and how we want to be perceived.
convey.zh: 无论我们选择大胆鲜艳的装扮，还是倾向于低调内敛的风格，我们的着装都在传递信息，展现我们的个性以及我们希望在他人眼中的形象。
convey.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

core.en: Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.
core.zh: 艺术家和科学家都沉浸在发现与发明之中，而挑战和批判也是两者的核心所在。
core.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

core.en: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory.
core.zh: 教育，不仅仅是在校园里获得的知识，将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心部分。
core.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

costly.en: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.
costly.zh: 为收回钉子而不惜烧毁整栋房屋的想法，凸显了这项看似简单的技术在当时是多么稀缺、昂贵且珍贵。
costly.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

costly.en: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
costly.zh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
costly.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

council.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
council.zh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
council.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

council.en: They prove impractical for city councils.
council.zh: 这些措施对市议会来说并不实用。
council.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

crime.en: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
crime.zh: 法国立法者上周初步批准了一项法律，将雇佣超瘦模特走上T台定为犯罪行为。
crime.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

crime.en: Changes in the social structure may indirectly affect juvenile crime rates.
crime.zh: 社会结构的变化可能间接影响青少年犯罪率。
crime.src: 2004 英语（未分卷） 完形填空（四选一）

curb.en: They rid the forest of dead and sick trees, reducing competition and curbing the spread of disease.
curb.zh: 它们清除了森林中的枯树和病树，减少了竞争并遏制了疾病的传播。
curb.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

curb.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
curb.zh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
curb.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

decrease.zh: 它们的频率已显著下降。
decrease.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

decrease.en: Thanks to his invention, we have a real chance to decrease the world's carbon emissions.
decrease.zh: 多亏了他的发明，我们才有真正的机会减少全球碳排放。
decrease.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

democratic.en: One previous study looked at the Efé people of the Democratic Republic of Congo.
democratic.zh: 此前有一项研究关注了刚果民主共和国的埃费族人。
democratic.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

democratic.en: It doesn't feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit.
democratic.zh: 即便双方都能从中获益，这也不像是一种人性化或民主化的关系。
democratic.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

detect.en: What is more, they can be detected even when they are not actually visible.
detect.zh: 更重要的是，即使这些植物或树木不在视线范围内，其挥发性化学物质也能被探测到。
detect.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

detect.en: Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice.
detect.zh: Scopus数据库本身就拥有检测这种不当行为所需的全部数据。
detect.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

diet.en: No matter how you "enhance" enclosures, they do not allow for freedom, a natural diet or adequate exercise.
diet.zh: 无论你如何“改善”圈养环境，它们都无法提供自由、自然饮食或充足的活动空间。
diet.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

diet.en: But switching to a mainly plant-based diet wouldn't help.
diet.zh: 但是转向以植物为主的饮食也无济于事。
diet.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

discipline.en: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a mental discipline in thinking skills – and in their choices on when to share on social media.
discipline.zh: 因此，当年轻人对过度使用推特的总统提出批评时，他们展现出了思维能力方面的自律——以及在决定何时在社交媒体上分享信息时的自律。
discipline.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

discipline.en: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
discipline.zh: 因此，各学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

dispute.en: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed.
dispute.zh: 自2010年以来关闭的图书馆数量尚存争议。
dispute.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

dispute.en: What can be one consequence of the current dispute?
dispute.zh: 当前这场争端可能带来什么后果？
dispute.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

domestic.en: At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
domestic.zh: 无论如何，这一变化最终将受到越来越多国内外消费者的欢迎，不管当前的消费模式能持续多久。

domestic.en: The kinds of interpersonal violence that women are exposed to tend to be in domestic situations, by, unfortunately, parents or other family members, and they tend not to be one-shot deals.
domestic.zh: 不幸的是，女性遭受的人际暴力往往发生在家庭环境中，施暴者多为父母或其他家庭成员，而且这些暴力行为往往不是一次性的。
domestic.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

dominant.en: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
dominant.zh: 英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)成立之初便极具远见：提供高质量、及时的医疗服务，以满足其所服务人群的主要需求。
dominant.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

dominant.en: The Administration is dominant over immigration issues.
dominant.zh: 联邦政府在移民事务上拥有主导权。
dominant.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

draft.en: Once you have a first draft on paper, you can delete material that is unrelated to your thesis and add material necessary to illustrate your points and make your paper convincing.
draft.zh: 一旦你完成了初稿，就可以删除与论文主题无关的内容，并添加必要的材料来阐明你的观点，使论文更具说服力。
draft.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

draft.en: If a relevant and important idea occurs to you now, work it into the draft.
draft.zh: 如果此刻你想到一个相关且重要的观点，就把它融入草稿中。
draft.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

ease.en: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
ease.zh: 通常情况下，阐明这一原则并不能简化界定界限的挑战。
ease.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ease.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
ease.zh: 无论是否获得许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、司法管辖区域和身份的界限。
ease.src: 2013 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

element.en: Soil is an important element to be taken into account in forest restoration.
element.zh: 土壤是森林恢复过程中需要考虑的重要因素。
element.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

element.en: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
element.zh: 其他科学家也免费从事专业的同行评审工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心要素。
element.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

enormous.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
enormous.zh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
enormous.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

enormous.en: And so we would call on state lawmakers from Richmond to Albany to consider reviewing their own wetlands protections and see for themselves the enormous stakes involved.
enormous.zh: 因此，我们呼吁从里士满到奥尔巴尼的各州立法者考虑审查各自的湿地保护措施，并亲自了解其中涉及的重大利害关系。
enormous.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

equal.en: Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.
equal.zh: 在表达完你的观点（是作为一种立场，而非事实）之后，要对他人的看法表现出同样的好奇心。
equal.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

equal.en: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society – that all are equal in treatment by government – is undermined.
equal.zh: 如果人脉关系可以买卖，那么民主社会的一个基本前提——即所有人在政府面前都应得到平等对待——就会受到损害。
equal.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

exposure.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
exposure.zh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
exposure.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

exposure.en: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
exposure.zh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

fairly.en: And today, even writers who are fairly well-known often have to do other work to supplement their writing income.
fairly.zh: 而如今，即便是颇有名气的作家，也常常需要从事其他工作来补贴写作收入。
fairly.src: 2022 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

fairly.en: To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling.
fairly.zh: 要在这样的体系中引领企业，需要的知识量相当惊人。
fairly.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fulfill.en: Traditionally, this role was fulfilled by data banks, libraries, and other humans.
fulfill.zh: 传统上，这一角色是由数据库、图书馆和其他人来承担的。
fulfill.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fulfill.en: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
fulfill.zh: 然而，尽管年轻人和老一辈在什么是美满生活的终点这一问题上基本达成共识，但在如何实现这一目标的路径选择上却存在显著差异。
fulfill.src: 2016 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

hire.en: Employers need to hire new staff.
hire.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

hire.en: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
hire.zh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
hire.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

humor.en: You may have a circle of friends who provide constant good humor, help and companionship.
humor.zh: 你可能有一群朋友，他们总是给你带来欢声笑语、无私帮助和真挚陪伴。
humor.src: 2015 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

humor.en: Look at your talk and pick out a few words or sentences which you can turn about and inject with humor.
humor.zh: 审视一下自己的演讲稿，挑选一些词句进行巧妙转换，注入幽默元素。
humor.src: 2002 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

infant.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
infant.zh: 从预期寿命到癌症及婴儿死亡率，我们都落后于许多同类国家。
infant.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

infant.en: It found that infants had an average of 14 alloparents a day by the time they were 18 weeks old and were passed between caregivers eight times an hour.
infant.zh: 该研究发现，18周大的婴儿平均每天有14位养育人，每小时会在不同照护者之间被传递8次。
infant.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

integrate.en: Their interests as stewards of the land need to be better integrated with those who have the money to support restoration.
integrate.zh: 他们作为土地管家的利益需要与那些拥有资金支持修复的人士的利益更好地结合起来。
integrate.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

integrate.en: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
integrate.zh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
integrate.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

leading.en: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.
leading.zh: 深度思维公司（DeepMind）是全球领先的人工智能（AI）企业之一。
leading.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

leading.en: Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
leading.zh: 不幸的是，尽管《问题的核心》这份报告历时两年半才完成，却未能触及真正的核心问题：美国顶尖高等院校中人文教育的非人文本质。
leading.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

mechanism.en: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
mechanism.zh: 然而，该法案提出的机制过于繁琐，并且在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
mechanism.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

mechanism.en: There could be many mechanisms working together that drive us in choosing genetically similar friends rather than "functional kinship" of being friends with benefits!
mechanism.zh: 可能有多种机制共同作用，驱使我们选择基因相似的朋友，而非追求那种能带来好处的“功能性亲属关系”！
mechanism.src: 2015 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

mood.en: When we wear clothes that make us feel comfortable and confident, it can positively affect our self-esteem and overall mood.
mood.zh: 当我们穿着令自己感到舒适且自信的衣服时，这能对我们的自尊心和整体情绪产生积极影响。
mood.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

mood.en: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood, and identity.
mood.zh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
mood.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

moreover.en: Moreover, cultural and societal influences play a significant role in shaping our dress choices.
moreover.zh: 此外，文化和社会影响在塑造我们的着装选择方面起着重要作用。
moreover.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

moreover.en: Moreover, we are grieving various kinds of loss: a friendship, a romantic relationship or a house.
moreover.zh: 此外，我们还在为各种各样的失去而悲伤：一段友谊、一段爱情或一所房子。
moreover.src: 2015 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

narrow.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
narrow.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
narrow.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

narrow.en: But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.
narrow.zh: 但在那些狭隘的兴趣圈子之外，有一片浩瀚的海洋正等待着人们去探索，那里充满了各种酝酿中的思想、智力上的冒险，以及想象力的洗礼。

ought.en: The goals of researchers ought to be realistic.
ought.zh: 研究人员的目标应当切合实际。
ought.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ought.en: They ought to improve their carer-to-child ratio.
ought.zh: 他们应该提高保育员与儿童的配比。
ought.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

partner.en: During conversations with short gaps, people feel more connected to their conversation partners.
partner.zh: 在对话中有短暂间隔时，人们会感觉与交谈对象的联系更紧密。
partner.src: 2025 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

partner.en: "They bought the seedlings and closed them down," complained Paul Arnold, a partner at San Francisco-based Switch Ventures, putting an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors.
partner.zh: 总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道：“他们买下这些幼苗企业，然后就把它们扼杀了”，终止了那些有朝一日可能成为竞争对手的企业。
partner.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

peak.en: But 2022 was the peak of peak TV.
peak.zh: 但 2022 年是‘剧集大爆发’的巅峰之年。
peak.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

peak.en: We were kept afloat by "peak TV", the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.
peak.zh: 过去，我们依靠“电视巅峰时代”得以维持，那是流媒体服务爆炸式增长所催生出的内容过剩时期。
peak.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

percentage.en: The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades.
percentage.zh: 过去三十年来，处于退休年龄却仍在劳动力市场的人口比例翻了一番。
percentage.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

percentage.en: Today, 28 per cent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among the OECD countries.
percentage.zh: 如今，英国28%的大学毕业生从事着无需学位的工作，这一比例是经济合作与发展组织（OECD）国家平均水平的两倍。
percentage.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

permission.en: But these open-source programs are built by scraping images from the Internet, often without permission and proper attribution to artists.
permission.zh: 但这些开源程序是通过从互联网上抓取图片构建而成的，而且往往未获得艺术家的许可，也未给予他们应有的署名。
permission.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

permission.zh: 请求允许表达不同意见
permission.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

platform.en: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
platform.zh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
platform.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

platform.en: subscribers grew wary of large platforms.
platform.zh: 订阅者对大型平台开始产生警惕心理。
platform.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

politician.en: They are deemed too mild for politicians.
politician.zh: 这些措施在政客看来过于温和。
politician.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

politician.en: The building has housed some of the nation's most significant diplomats and politicians and has been the scene of many historic events.
politician.zh: 这座建筑曾容纳过美国一些最重要的外交官和政治家，也见证了诸多历史性事件。

possibly.en: Builders possibly need to submit new estimates of their projects.
possibly.zh: 建筑商可能需要重新提交项目预算。
possibly.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

possibly.en: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
possibly.zh: 铁路运营商又一次提高客运票价，这究竟如何说得过去？
possibly.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

quote.en: Premiers love to quote Mr. Romanow's report selectively, especially the parts about more federal money.
quote.zh: 各省省长们喜欢断章取义地引用罗曼诺先生的报告，尤其是关于要求联邦政府增加拨款的部分。
quote.src: 2005 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

quote.en: Former Colorado governor Richard Lamm has been quoted as saying that the old and infirm "have a duty to die and get out of the way", so that younger, healthier people can realize their potential.
quote.zh: 有引述前科罗拉多州州长理查德·拉姆的话说，年老体弱者“有责任死去并腾出位置”，以便更年轻、更健康的人能够发挥他们的潜力。
quote.src: 2003 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

radical.en: It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries.
radical.zh: 这引发了商业渔业的根本性改革。
radical.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

radical.en: The 17th and 18th centuries were times of radical change and curiosity.
radical.zh: 17和18世纪是充满彻底变革与探索精神的时代。
radical.src: 2020 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

react.en: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact
react.zh: 性格会影响人对眼神接触的反应方式
react.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

react.en: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact
react.zh: 性格会影响一个人对眼神接触的反应方式
react.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

regulate.en: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations.
regulate.zh: 根据我们的研究，25%的受访者已决定在组织内彻底禁止使用人工智能，或对其使用进行规范。
regulate.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

regulate.en: "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?" Hom said.
regulate.zh: 霍姆说：“我认为问题在于，开发商明明是在建造酒店，却把它伪装成非酒店性质的建筑，难道不应该像对待酒店一样对其进行管理、征税和监管吗？”
regulate.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

retire.en: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?
retire.zh: 为何水石书店要将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍移至其相关分类区域？
retire.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

retire.en: "It's not just a financial decision, but an emotional one. Many people believe they can't retire."
retire.zh: 这不仅仅是一个财务决定，更是一个情感决定。许多人认为自己无法退休。
retire.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rival.en: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
rival.zh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
rival.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

rival.en: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before.
rival.zh: 现在，竞争对手也将开始征收此前未征收的销售税。
rival.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

routine.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

routine.en: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
routine.zh: 相比之下，货运飞机或许更容易重新安排时间，常规军事飞行也一样。
routine.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

strength.en: FaceTime with a relative as you strength train or stretch at home.
strength.zh: 在家进行力量训练或拉伸时，可以和亲戚进行FaceTime视频通话。
strength.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

suspect.en: They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone – a vast storehouse of digital information – is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse.
suspect.zh: 他们首先应当驳斥加利福尼亚州毫无说服力的论点，即查看智能手机（一个庞大的数字信息库）的内容类似于搜查嫌疑人的钱包。
suspect.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

suspect.en: In theory, the success of an applicant should not depend on the few others chosen randomly for interview during the same day, but Dr Simonsohn suspected the truth was otherwise.
suspect.zh: 理论上，申请者能否成功不应取决于同一天随机选中参加面试的其他几名申请者，但西蒙松博士怀疑实际情况并非如此。
suspect.src: 2013 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

sympathy.en: Karen R. Sime: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
sympathy.zh: 卡伦·R·赛姆：虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人踏上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
sympathy.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

sympathy.en: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
sympathy.zh: 虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
sympathy.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

technical.zh: 主播们失去了他们的技术优势。
technical.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

technical.en: The International Association of Scientific, Technical and Medical Publishers says that there are more than 2,000 publishers worldwide specializing in these subjects.
technical.zh: 国际科学、技术与医学出版商协会表示，全球有超过2000家出版商专门从事这些领域的出版。
technical.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

thrive.en: Climate change is a driving factor in the push to restore forests, but it also raises questions, such as where trees can thrive in the future.
thrive.zh: 气候变化是推动森林恢复的一个驱动因素，但也引发了一些问题，例如未来哪些地方适合树木生长。
thrive.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

thrive.en: But the remaining trees draw a greater share of the available moisture, so they grow and thrive, restoring the forest's capacity to pull carbon from the air.
thrive.zh: 但剩余的树木会吸收更多可用水分，因此它们能够茁壮成长，进而恢复森林从空气中吸收碳的能力。
thrive.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

unlike.en: Unlike some photographers, who "cheat" by keeping insects in a fridge to slow them down, Peters refuses to tamper with wild butterflies.
unlike.zh: 有些摄影师会把昆虫放进冰箱使其行动迟缓来"作弊"，而彼得斯则拒绝以这种方式干扰野生蝴蝶。

unlike.en: But unlike in friendships, you need coworkers.
unlike.zh: 但与友谊不同的是，同事是你工作中必须接触的人。
unlike.src: 2020 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

urge.en: Urge legislation to restrict its use.
urge.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

urge.en: One of these urges has to do with creating a state of peace in the midst of turbulence, a "still point of the turning world," to borrow a phrase from T. S. Eliot.
urge.zh: 这些渴望之一与在动荡中创造一种宁静状态有关，借用T.S.艾略特的话来说，就是一个“旋转世界的静止点”。
urge.src: 2013 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

vast.en: But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.
vast.zh: 但在那些狭隘的兴趣圈子之外，有一片浩瀚的海洋正等待着人们去探索，那里充满了各种酝酿中的思想、智力上的冒险，以及想象力的洗礼。

vast.en: That is before we look for the space to grow the grains, sugars, seeds and oils that provide us with the vast bulk of our current calorie intake.
vast.zh: 这还不算我们需要寻找土地来种植谷物、糖类、种子和油料作物——这些作物目前为我们提供了绝大部分的卡路里摄入。
vast.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

vision.en: A citizen science-based approach can extend the field of vision and include more ideas and different brains to problem-solve and create, making innovation faster and more effective.
vision.zh: 基于公民科学的方法能够拓展视野，汇集更多创意和多元智慧来解决问题与创新，从而使创新过程更快、更有效。
vision.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

vision.en: Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two.
vision.zh: 通过视力测试也能使这些驾驶员的致命撞车事故率产生类似幅度的下降，不过将这两项措施结合起来似乎并无额外益处。
vision.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

voluntary.en: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
voluntary.zh: 在丹麦、美国和其他一些国家，时尚行业正尝试为模特和时尚形象制定自愿性标准，这些标准的执行更多依赖同行压力。
voluntary.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

voluntary.en: They are only classified as voluntary part-time workers if they tell the survey taker they chose to work less than 35 hours a week.
voluntary.zh: 只有当受访者告知调查人员他们选择每周工作少于35小时时，他们才会被归类为自愿兼职工作者。
voluntary.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

aggressive.zh: 眼神交流也可能带有攻击性。
aggressive.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

aggressive.zh: 眼神交流也可能带有攻击性。
aggressive.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

ahead.en: Any plans submitted before that date are considered to be under the previous rules, and can go ahead as long as work starts before 15 June next year.
ahead.zh: 任何在该日期前提交的规划申请均按旧规处理，只要在明年6月15日前开工即可推进。
ahead.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

ahead.en: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
ahead.zh: 这场演出是在11月英国格拉斯哥联合国气候变化大会召开前发出的富有创意的行动号召。
ahead.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

alternative.en: In his Oxford lectures, Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality, a "glimpsed alternative" that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large.
alternative.zh: 西amus·希尼在牛津大学的讲座中指出，诗歌描绘了一种现实图景，即一种“瞥见的替代性可能”。这种可能从细微到宏大等各个层面，都与你当下的现实构成了矛盾。
转而选择可持续的替代方案
alternative.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

approval.en: But under anti-bribery laws, proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation.
approval.zh: 但根据反贿赂法，必须有具体利益的证据，例如合同或法规的批准。
approval.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

approval.en: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
approval.zh: 法国立法者上周初步批准了一项法律，将雇佣超瘦模特走上T台定为犯罪行为。
approval.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

assumption.en: One simple way to avoid engaging in personalisation and mind reading is to challenge your negative assumptions of what's happened.
assumption.zh: 避免陷入‘个人化’和‘读心术’误区的一个简单方法，就是去质疑你对已发生事情的负面假设。
assumption.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

assumption.en: Following the British assumption of control in New York, the street was renamed Broadway.
assumption.zh: 英国接管纽约后，这条街更名为百老汇。
assumption.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

aware.en: Some believe that AI is negatively impacting on the marketer's role by reducing creativity and removing jobs, but they are aware that it is a way of reducing costs and creating new information.
aware.zh: 一些人认为，人工智能通过降低创造力和减少就业机会，对营销人员的角色产生了负面影响，但他们也意识到，人工智能是一种降低成本和创造新信息的方式。
aware.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

aware.en: Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
aware.zh: 企业和非营利组织的领导者应当了解暗模式，并努力避免由此产生的灰色地带。
aware.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

beginning.en: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
beginning.zh: 我们仍处于这场革命的开端，当下的微小选择未来可能会产生巨大的影响。
beginning.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

beginning.en: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.
beginning.zh: 从一开始，这一价格标签就成了预检计划的致命缺陷。
beginning.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

brand.en: By allowing AI to develop content some brand marketers may find that they are losing control over the brand narrative.
brand.zh: 如果允许人工智能生成内容，一些品牌营销人员可能会发现他们正在失去对品牌叙事的控制。
brand.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

brand.en: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
brand.zh: 我们要么将他们誉为正在成长的美国人，要么将他们贴上“应驱逐出境的外国人”的标签。
brand.src: 2013 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

characterize.en: Which of the following characterizes the scientific publishing model?
characterize.zh: 以下哪项是科学出版模式的特征？
characterize.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

characterize.en: Since the days of Aristotle, a search for universal principles has characterized the scientific enterprise.
characterize.zh: 自亚里士多德时代以来，对普遍原理的探求一直是科学事业的显著特征。
characterize.src: 2012 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

commit.en: She uses outdated research and decades-old examples to undermine the noble mission of organizations committed to connecting children to a world beyond their own.
commit.zh: 她用过时的研究和几十年前的例子来诋毁那些致力于带领孩子们了解更广阔世界的组织所肩负的崇高使命。
commit.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

commit.en: Seymour made the change, went into his backyard, and expressed his displeasure by committing suicide.
commit.zh: 西摩按要求修改了画作，随后走进后院，以自杀的方式表达了他的不满。

complaint.en: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
complaint.zh: 联邦贸易委员会在起诉书中指控，“尽管该公司明确做出了隐私承诺，但仍控制了用户的敏感生育数据并将其分享给第三方。”
complaint.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

complaint.en: The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
complaint.zh: 除非彻底改革农场工人的移民政策，否则这些抱怨不太可能停止。
complaint.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

controversy.en: It will settle the prior controversies.
controversy.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

controversy.en: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
controversy.zh: 当前这场争议的部分责任在于天文学家。
controversy.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

counterpart.en: That's why the California Film Commission and its Los Angeles counterpart, Film LA, now should act, before it's too late.
counterpart.zh: 正因如此，加州电影委员会及其在洛杉矶的对应机构 Film LA 现在应当采取行动，以免为时已晚。
counterpart.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

counterpart.en: It sends a mixed message, and your counterpart gets to choose what signals to read.
counterpart.zh: 这会传递出混杂的信号，让对方自行解读你的意图。
counterpart.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

credit.en: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
credit.zh: 佐治亚州为电影和电视制作成本提供高达 30% 的可转让税收抵免。此外，如果项目包含了佐治亚州的宣传标识，还可以在基础税收抵免之上再获得 10% 的额度提升。
credit.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

credit.en: Once someone starts to help, perhaps they'll take over, or get credit for your earlier efforts.
credit.zh: 一旦有人开始帮忙，他们可能会喧宾夺主，或者把你之前的努力归功于自己。
credit.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

definition.en: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
definition.zh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
definition.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

definition.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
definition.zh: 我们需要超越对合法与非法的严格定义。
definition.src: 2013 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

delay.en: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
delay.zh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。
delay.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

delay.en: It's also a good idea to delay the conversation if you are in a meeting or other public space.
delay.zh: 如果你正在开会或身处其他公共场合，最好也推迟讨论。
delay.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

desperate.en: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate.
desperate.zh: 然而，经济适用房的形势却十分严峻。
desperate.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

desperate.en: Yet these desperate measures have proved the right ones and, sadly for many journalists, they can be pushed further.
desperate.zh: 然而，事实证明这些孤注一掷的措施是正确的，而对许多记者而言不幸的是，这些措施还可以进一步推进。
desperate.src: 2011 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

embrace.en: But people can't be expected to embrace the changes if they're not seeing the benefits—if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed.
embrace.zh: 但是，如果人们看不到变革带来的好处——如果他们只看到好工作在不断消失——那么我们就不能指望他们会欣然接受这些变革。
embrace.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

embrace.en: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
embrace.zh: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然势头强劲，但是，要使合作取得成功，双方都需要投入时间，并乐于接受惊喜与挑战。
embrace.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

excessive.en: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections.
excessive.zh: 社会也因过度的就业保护而受到损害。
excessive.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

excessive.en: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
excessive.zh: 议会还同意禁止那些通过宣扬极端节食来“煽动过度瘦身”的网站。
excessive.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

extension.en: Net-Zero Rules Set to Send Cost of New Homes and Extensions Soaring
extension.zh: 净零排放新规将导致新建住宅及扩建成本飙升
extension.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

extension.en: The new rules will affect people whose home extensions include new windows or doors.
extension.zh: 新规将影响那些在房屋扩建中包含新窗户或新门的业主。
extension.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

extreme.en: Travellers on the Silk Road faced the possibility of being attacked by thieves or being subjected to extreme weather conditions.
extreme.zh: 丝绸之路上的旅人面临着被强盗袭击或遭遇极端天气的风险。
extreme.src: 2023 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

extreme.en: Just 23 per cent of the fruit and vegetables consumed in the UK are currently home-grown, so even with the most extreme measures we could meet only 30 per cent of our fresh produce needs.
extreme.zh: 目前英国消费的水果和蔬菜中仅23%是本土种植的，因此即使采取最极端的措施，我们也只能满足30%的新鲜农产品需求。
extreme.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

fiction.en: Fiction invites you to loiter unseen in the lives of others.
fiction.zh: 小说邀请你隐身于他人的生活之中，流连忘返。

fiction.en: She draws on letters, diaries and fiction, and a 1939 field notebook of verbatim audience research by Winifred Gill.
fiction.zh: 她参考了信件、日记和小说，以及温妮弗雷德·吉尔于 1939 年通过现场调研记录的一本观众研究逐字稿。
fiction.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

frame.en: After he's captured the butterfly taking off, he layers 10 to 15 frames together in Photoshop.
frame.zh: 在捕捉到蝴蝶起飞的瞬间后，他在Photoshop中将10到15帧画面叠加在一起。

frame.en: He uses a high-speed OM System which shoots 120 frames a second.
frame.zh: 他使用高速OM系统，该系统每秒可拍摄120帧。

gather.en: In 1967 a scientific survey of the Peloponnesian coast was gathering data to analyze changes in sea levels when British oceanographer Nicholas Flemming first spotted the sunken structures.
gather.zh: 1967年，一项针对伯罗奔尼撒半岛海岸的科学调查正在收集数据以分析海平面变化，此时英国海洋学家尼古拉斯·弗莱明首次发现了这些沉没的建筑物。
gather.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

gather.zh: 这两份请愿书分别收集到了7,276个和11,282个签名。
gather.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

inspire.en: Artifacts in museums have the power to inspire, and perhaps spark that need to learn and understand the nature of their creators.
inspire.zh: 博物馆中的文物具有启发人心的力量，或许还能激发人们去了解和理解其创造者的本质。
inspire.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

inspire.en: It inspired me to learn more about the culture that it represented.
inspire.zh: 它激发了我去更多地了解这件雕塑所代表的文化。
inspire.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

interpret.en: Or, two of your friends cancel your planned get-together at the pub and you interpret this as meaning they're bored of you.
interpret.zh: 或者，你的两个朋友取消了原本在酒吧的聚会，而你却将此解读为他们已经厌倦了你。
interpret.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

interpret.en: When you take things personally, you're interpreting these situations as saying something significant and negative about you as a person.
interpret.zh: 当你把事情看作是针对个人时，你实际上是将这些情况解读为对自己人格的重大否定。
interpret.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

label.en: Today we have a(n) tendency to label obesity as a disgrace.
label.zh: 如今，我们往往将肥胖视为一种耻辱。
label.src: 2014 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

label.en: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable – meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that – and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
label.zh: 这些品牌鼓励追求时尚的消费者将服装视为一次性用品——本就只打算穿一两水，尽管它们不会这样宣传——并每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。
label.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

mechanical.en: He is a teacher at a New Hampshire high school where learning is not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical.
mechanical.zh: 他是新罕布什尔州一所高中的教师，在这所学校里，学习并非书本、考试和机械记忆的代名词，而是注重实践。
mechanical.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

mechanical.en: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.
mechanical.zh: 例如，今日永存基金会（Long Now Foundation）的旗舰项目是一台机械钟，其设计目标是在数千年后仍能计时。
mechanical.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

minister.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
minister.zh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
minister.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

minister.en: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
minister.zh: 部长们还应致力于增强租赁市场环境的确定性，这将对注册住房供应商依靠收入为新开发项目融资的能力产生重大影响。
minister.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

mix.en: The miracle of the Chesapeake Bay lies not in its depths, but in the complexity of its natural construction, the interaction of fresh and saline waters, and the mix of land and water.
mix.zh: 切萨皮克湾的奇迹不在于其深度，而在于其复杂的自然构造、淡水与咸水的交汇融合，以及陆地与水域的相互交织。
mix.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

mix.en: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.
mix.zh: 这一双重目标被混为一谈：过分强调成功而非参与的做法，让新手望而却步。
mix.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

notion.en: It can catch someone's attention in a crowded room, "Eye contact and smile" can signal availability and confidence, a common-sense notion supported in studies by psychologist Monica Moore.
notion.zh: 在拥挤的房间里，眼神交流可以吸引他人的注意；而“眼神交流配合微笑”则能传递出乐于交往和自信的信号——心理学家莫妮卡·摩尔的研究也证实了这一常识性观点。
notion.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

notion.en: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
notion.zh: 更理想的做法是帮助提升美的概念，使其超越特定行业的物质标准。
notion.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

operator.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
operator.zh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
operator.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

operator.en: This narrowing of the regulatory scope was a victory for builders, mining operators and other commercial interests often at odds with environmental rules.
operator.zh: 监管范围的这种缩小对建筑商、采矿运营商以及其他常常与环境法规存在冲突的商业利益集团而言是一场胜利。
operator.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ordinary.en: There is no good reason that these artifacts should be beyond the ordinary reach of the educational objectives or inspiration of the generations to which they were left.
ordinary.zh: 没有充分理由让这些文物脱离其本应传承给的后代子孙的教育目标或灵感启迪的寻常可达范围。
ordinary.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

ordinary.en: Consequently—and paradoxically—laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
ordinary.zh: 因此，矛盾的是，那些旨在保护普通劳动者工作的法律，反而可能将这些工作置于危险之中。
ordinary.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

overlook.en: Yet still our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated.
overlook.zh: 然而，我们的图书馆往往仍被忽视，且其价值未得到充分认可。
overlook.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

overlook.en: When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation's diversity of gifts.
overlook.zh: 当教育变成一刀切的模式时，就可能忽视一个国家人民天赋的多样性。
overlook.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

painful.en: Why do people read negative Internet comments and do other things that will obviously be painful?
painful.zh: 为什么人们会阅读负面的网络评论，以及做其他明显会带来痛苦的事情呢？
painful.src: 2018 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

painful.en: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
painful.zh: 长期以来，一小群直言不讳的夏威夷人和环保人士将这些望远镜的存在视为对圣地的亵渎，也是对这片曾经主权国家被占领历史的痛苦 reminder。
painful.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

property.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
property.zh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
property.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

property.en: As the rules came into effect last Wednesday, property developers were rushing to file plans just before the deadline.
property.zh: 随着新规于上周三正式生效，房地产开发商们纷纷赶在截止日期前提交规划申请。
property.src: 2023 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

proposal.en: What is the author's attitude towards the proposal?
proposal.zh: 作者对这项提议持什么态度？
proposal.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

proposal.en: Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.
proposal.zh: 文化大臣杰里米·赖特（Jeremy Wright）应当欣然接纳这一积极且充满希望的提案，并将其付诸行动。
proposal.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

prosperity.en: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
prosperity.zh: 严格的解雇法规会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并阻碍繁荣发展和整体福祉。
prosperity.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

prosperity.en: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
prosperity.zh: 肯尼迪写道，这一规则"限制了各州追求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平竞争环境中竞争。"
prosperity.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

provision.en: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?
provision.zh: 考虑到那些数字信息和无形格式的创造者很少为其长期保存做出安排，你是否思考过这些产物的生命周期？
provision.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

provision.en: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.
provision.zh: 但这些条款在适用于高薪管理人员和高管时，给企业带来了困难。
provision.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

quit.en: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
quit.zh: 例如，单靠自己带购物袋去杂货店或停用塑料吸管，收效甚微，对我们的要求也极低。
quit.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

quit.en: In recent weeks the No. 2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.
quit.zh: 最近几周，雅芳和美国运通的两位二号高管先后辞职，解释称他们正在寻求首席执行官的职位。
quit.src: 2011 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

quota.en: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
quota.zh: 这些法案与加州最近通过的一项措施类似，加州去年成为首个要求私营公司实行性别配额的州。
quota.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

quota.en: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
quota.zh: 挪威在全国范围内实行企业性别配额制度后，就恰好发生了这种情况。
quota.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reasonable.en: Then I counter with another reasonable argument: that a higher minimum wage will force businesses to employ fewer people for less time.
reasonable.zh: 那么我会用另一个合理的论点反驳：提高最低工资会迫使企业减少雇佣人数、缩短雇佣时间。

reasonable.en: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
reasonable.zh: 相反，假设你提出一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应被迫生活在贫困中。

recovery.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
recovery.zh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
recovery.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

recovery.en: When the recovery began, worker shortages first appeared in the high-skilled trades.
recovery.zh: 经济复苏开始时，高技能行业首先出现了工人短缺的情况。
recovery.src: 2017 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

relate.en: Extracurricular activities related to the college major declared on a college application are beneficial, experts suggest.
relate.zh: 专家建议，与大学申请中填报的专业相关的课外活动是有益的。
relate.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

relate.en: Perhaps museums and governments might explore some role for the use of nearly exact reproductions as a means of resolving issues relating to returning works of art and antiquities.
relate.zh: 或许博物馆和政府可以探索利用近乎精确的复制品，将其作为解决艺术品和古物返还相关问题的一种途径。
relate.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

setting.en: It's common to have a "cubicle mate" or special confidant in a work setting.
setting.zh: 在工作环境中，有一位“隔间伙伴”或特别的知己是很常见的。
setting.src: 2020 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

setting.en: In some settings, red sneakers or dress T-shirts can convey status; in others not so much.
setting.zh: 在某些场合，红色运动鞋或休闲T恤能彰显身份地位；而在另一些场合则不然。
setting.src: 2016 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

sex.en: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
sex.zh: 在签署这项法案时，加利福尼亚州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确基于性别对人进行分类的法律可能违宪。
sex.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

sex.en: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
sex.zh: 在南非，一项名为“loveLife”的艾滋病预防倡议招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。
sex.src: 2012 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

significance.en: Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
significance.zh: 其次，大多数使用联网计算机上传内容的人甚至没有意识到自己行为的重要意义。
significance.src: 2012 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

significance.en: In the final paragraph about the significance of the setting in "A&P," the student brings together the reasons Sammy quit his job by referring to his refusal to accept Lengel's store policies.
significance.zh: 在关于《A&P》中场景设置重要性的最后一段，该学生通过提及萨米拒绝接受伦格尔的 store policies，将他辞职的原因整合在一起。
significance.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

timber.en: Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
timber.zh: 目前，英国木材需求量中仅有20%来自本土供应，而该国仍是全球第二大木材净进口国。
timber.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

timber.en: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
timber.zh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
timber.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

undermine.en: But the thing is, whether your self-worth really is being undermined is, to a large degree, subjective.
undermine.zh: 但问题在于，你的自我价值感是否真的受到了损害，在很大程度上取决于主观感受。
undermine.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

undermine.en: Any comments or experiences that undermine those feelings of self-worth can be uncomfortable and it's only natural to want to avoid them.
undermine.zh: 任何贬低自我价值感的言论或经历都会让人感到不适，而想要逃避这些自然是人之常情。
undermine.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

urgent.en: it is urgent to assess the use of planned fires.
urgent.zh: 评估计划火烧的使用已刻不容缓。
urgent.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

urgent.en: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an "urgent rethink" of the hospital-centric model we retain.
urgent.zh: 我们共同呼吁就英国医疗卫生的未来开展更加开放和坦诚的对话，并“紧急反思”我们目前仍在沿用的以医院为中心的模式。
urgent.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

witness.en: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
witness.zh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

witness.en: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
witness.zh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
witness.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

zone.en: Which of the following is true about Madrid's clean air zone?
zone.zh: 关于马德里的清洁空气区，以下哪项是正确的？
zone.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

zone.en: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.
zone.zh: 新的超低排放区（Ulez）很可能成为明年市长选举中的一个重大议题。
zone.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

aircraft.en: Copying Birds May Save Aircraft Fuel
aircraft.zh: 效仿鸟类飞行或可节省飞机燃油
aircraft.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

aircraft.en: Findings of the Stanford University researchers will promote the sales of new Boeing and Airbus aircraft.
aircraft.zh: 斯坦福大学研究人员的发现将促进波音和空客新飞机的销售。
aircraft.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

alert.en: That day's high temperature of roughly 36°C was 1°C shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.
alert.zh: 当日最高气温约为36°C，比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1°C。
alert.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

alert.en: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.
alert.zh: 在某些地区，仅日间高温就可能足以触发警报。
alert.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

announce.en: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
announce.zh: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉姆斯（Eric Williams）发起的银色房间街头派对（Silver Room Block Party）宣布，该活动将不会在2024年回归。
announce.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

announce.en: India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022."
announce.zh: 印度刚刚宣布将在2022年前“在全国范围内消除所有一次性塑料制品。”
announce.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

attach.en: The online search brought back work that had his name attached to it but wasn't his.
attach.zh: 他在网上搜索时，发现了一些标着自己名字却并非自己创作的作品。
attach.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

attach.en: In volume V he had attached an appendix, The Scovell Ciphers.
attach.zh: 在第五卷中，他附上了一个名为《斯科维尔密码》的附录。
attach.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

attribute.en: Different cultures have their norms and expectations regarding dress, which can influence the types of clothing people wear and the meanings attributed to them.
attribute.zh: 不同的文化对着装有各自的规范和预期，这会影响人们选择的服装类型及其所代表的含义。
attribute.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

attribute.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.
attribute.zh: 该行业押注，那些愿意为散养、非转基因和牧场饲养等优质属性支付更高价格的消费者，同样会欣然接受可持续理念。
attribute.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

automatic.en: Each automatic door system analyses the light, sound, weight or movement in its vicinity as a signal to open.
automatic.zh: 每个自动门系统都会分析其附近的光线、声音、重量或移动情况，并将这些作为开门信号。
automatic.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

automatic.en: Without the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential in improving disabled access to buildings and helping provide general convenience to commercial buildings.
automatic.zh: 自动门无需手动触碰即可开关，对于改善残障人士的建筑物出入条件以及为商业建筑提供普遍便利至关重要。
automatic.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

barely.en: In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart.
barely.zh: 短短十多年间，有机鸡蛋就从天然食品店中无人问津的小众产品，摇身一变进入了沃尔玛的货架。
barely.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

barely.en: During their six- to twelve-week voyage, they survived on barely enough food allotted to them.
barely.zh: 在六到十二周的航程中，他们仅靠配给的勉强够量的食物维持生命。
barely.src: 2015 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

bay.en: His pictures of a Glanville fritillary rising from the sea-pinks beside the chalk cliffs of Compton Bay on the Isle of Wight are particularly glorious.
bay.zh: 他拍摄的格兰维尔豹纹蝶从怀特岛康普顿湾白垩悬崖旁的海石竹中振翅而起的照片尤为壮丽。

bay.en: What can be inferred about the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program?
bay.zh: 关于美国环境保护局（EPA）在切萨皮克湾项目中的参与，可以推断出什么？
bay.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

capable.en: "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
capable.zh: 我觉得现在的人再也无法做到那样了。
capable.src: 2016 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

capable.en: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant.
capable.zh: 我们的心理健康其实从未离开；它就像乌云后的太阳，可能暂时隐匿不见，但完全能够在瞬间重焕光芒。
capable.src: 2016 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

cautious.en: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
cautious.zh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
cautious.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cautious.en: If the criterion changed to safety, you would get more cautious drivers who obeyed traffic laws.
cautious.zh: 如果评判标准改为安全，司机就会变得更加谨慎，遵守交通法规。
cautious.src: 2021 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

chain.en: "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."
chain.zh: 他们对食物链的改变，其影响程度就连他们自己可能都没有完全意识到。
chain.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

chain.en: Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries.
chain.zh: 此外，美国大公司的全球化程度前所未有，其供应链遍布更多国家。
chain.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

circuit.en: "What people don't realise is that in order to complete these tasks they need to use both the focus and unfocus circuits in their brain," says Pillay.
circuit.zh: 皮莱说：“人们没有意识到的是，要完成这些任务，他们需要同时使用大脑中的专注回路和非专注回路。”
circuit.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

circuit.en: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that have narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
circuit.zh: 联邦巡回上诉法院的这一举措，紧随最高法院近期作出的一系列裁决之后，这些裁决已缩小了对专利持有人的保护范围。
circuit.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

client.en: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
client.zh: 但几乎没有哪个国家的客户比美国客户更有理由抱怨。
client.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

client.en: Within weeks the world's two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them.
client.zh: 几周之内，全球两大拍卖行——苏富比和佳士得，不得不向那些委托其出售艺术品的客户支付近2亿美元的保证金。
client.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

compete.en: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
compete.zh: 肯尼迪写道，这一规则"限制了各州追求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平竞争环境中竞争。"
compete.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

compete.en: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
compete.zh: 然而，在那门课程学习期间，我意识到自己在这个领域的才华不足以在未来与其他富有创造力的人才竞争，因此我断定这并非我的正确道路。
compete.src: 2017 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

concentrate.en: Reading will keep you better informed about the world but it can also improve our tech-shattered ability to concentrate.
concentrate.zh: 阅读不仅能让你更全面地了解世界，还能修复因科技干扰而受损的专注力。

concentrate.en: For a long time, scientists and policy makers concentrated on the idea that teenagers were a problem that needed to be solved.
concentrate.zh: 长期以来，科学家和政策制定者都秉持着这样一种观点：青少年是一个需要解决的问题。
concentrate.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conventional.en: "Further contradicting conventional wisdom, we found that women as well as men have lower levels of stress at work than at home," writes one of the researchers, Sarah Damaske.
conventional.zh: 研究员萨拉·达马斯克（Sarah Damaske）写道：“我们的发现进一步与传统观念相悖——无论男性还是女性，在工作中的压力水平都低于在家中。”
conventional.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

conventional.en: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
conventional.zh: 如今消费者做出购买决策的方式意味着，市场营销的影响力来源于传统付费媒体之外的广泛因素。
conventional.src: 2011 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

convince.en: One of the biggest challenges in keeping unsafe aging drivers off the road is convincing them that it's time to turn over the keys.
convince.zh: 防止不安全的老年驾驶员上路，最大的挑战之一是说服他们是时候交出车钥匙了。
convince.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

convince.en: You will be happy to convince people with bad arguments.
convince.zh: 你会乐于用站不住脚的论据来说服他人。

crash.en: Some are drawn to what I think of as "business car crash" books — the stories of Theranos, Purdue, or WeWork.
crash.zh: 有些人被我称之为“商业车祸”类的书籍所吸引——即关于 Theranos、普渡制药（Purdue）或 WeWork 的那些故事。

crash.en: As long as there are other cars on the roads, self-driving cars won't solve the problems of crashes, said Dugan.
crash.zh: 杜根表示，只要道路上还有其他车辆，自动驾驶汽车就无法解决撞车问题。
crash.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

criterion.en: In fact, a listing in Scopus seems to be a criterion to be targeted in this type of citation manipulation.
criterion.zh: 事实上，被Scopus收录似乎已成为这类引用操纵行为的目标筛选标准。
criterion.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

criterion.en: But both these criteria would be at the expense of time.
criterion.zh: 但这两个标准都会以牺牲时间为代价。
criterion.src: 2021 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

disappear.en: As of May, those rates had spiked up to 13.3 per cent and 13.7 per cent, and although many worker shortages had disappeared, not all had done so.
disappear.zh: 截至5月，两国失业率已分别飙升至13.3%和13.7%，尽管许多劳动力短缺问题已不复存在，但并非所有短缺都已缓解。
disappear.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

disappear.en: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared.
disappear.zh: 更糟糕的是，用于养活自己和家人、支付各种账单的关键收入来源消失了。
disappear.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

dramatic.en: Through carefully selected words and phrases, poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.
dramatic.zh: 通过精心挑选的词语和短语，诗歌可以充满戏剧性、幽默风趣、优美动人、感人肺腑且鼓舞人心。
dramatic.src: 2023 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

dramatic.en: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
dramatic.zh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
dramatic.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

economics.en: At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, a research firm – double the figure five years earlier.
economics.zh: 研究公司Arts Economics的创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁（Clare McAndrew）估计，在2007年的顶峰时期，艺术品市场价值约650亿美元，是五年前的两倍。
economics.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

economics.en: In just one generation, millions of mothers have gone to work, transforming basic family economics.
economics.zh: 仅仅一代人的时间里，数百万母亲步入职场，彻底改变了家庭的基本经济状况。
economics.src: 2007 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

electricity.en: According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 per cent of the world's electricity.
electricity.zh: 根据国际能源署的数据，这些建筑目前消耗约占全球1%的电力。
electricity.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

electricity.en: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
electricity.zh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
electricity.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

engagement.en: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
engagement.zh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
engagement.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

engagement.en: Citizen science provides an opportunity for greater public engagement and the democratisation of science.
engagement.zh: 公民科学为公众更广泛参与和科学民主化提供了机会。
engagement.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

entrepreneur.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
entrepreneur.zh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
entrepreneur.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

entrepreneur.en: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit, you need to find a way to take it to the next level.
entrepreneur.zh: 以下是当今众多创业者共同面临的一种常见情况：你是一家小型企业的首席执行官，尽管企业盈利可观，但你需要找到方法将其提升到一个新的水平。
entrepreneur.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

error.en: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships.
error.zh: 而内疚感通过促使我们更深刻地反思自己的道德品质，可以鼓励人们弥补过失并修复关系。
error.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

error.en: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
error.zh: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人认为虚假新闻现象的首要原因是“读者错误”，这一因素超过了虚构故事或报道中的事实错误。
error.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

exhibit.en: Visit any antiques store and you'll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-65 World's Fair, the ephemera of history.
exhibit.zh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会邂逅往昔的遗物：照片、信件、一本详述1964-1965年世界博览会上辛克莱恐龙展的小册子，以及各种历史短存之物。
exhibit.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

exhibit.en: A student who exhibits abilities in doing business can impress colleges.
exhibit.zh: 展现出经商才能的学生往往能给大学留下深刻印象。
exhibit.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

expense.en: Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts.
expense.zh: 该公司表示，他们最常用的方式包括削减总体开支、购买人寿保险或最大限度地增加对退休账户的供款。
expense.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expense.en: But both these criteria would be at the expense of time.
expense.zh: 但这两个标准都会以牺牲时间为代价。
expense.src: 2021 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

feedback.en: The fact your boss took the time to give you feedback at all means they care enough to want to help you improve.
feedback.zh: 你的老板愿意花时间给你提供反馈，这一事实本身就说明他们足够重视你，并希望帮助你进步。
feedback.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

feedback.en: All good targets should have multiple criteria relating to critical factors such as time, money, quality and customer feedback.
feedback.zh: 所有良好的目标都应包含与关键因素相关的多重标准，例如时间、成本、质量和客户反馈。
feedback.src: 2021 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

file.en: Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this?
file.zh: 你是否曾无助地盯着一张ZIP磁盘，心想：我该如何把文件从这里导出来？
file.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

file.en: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
file.zh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
file.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

finance.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
finance.zh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
finance.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

finance.en: "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement."
finance.zh: 这不仅仅与经济因素有关。工作的价值也促使人们在退休后继续工作。
finance.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

foster.en: Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
foster.zh: 街头节庆活动不仅为当地商家带来了客流，也培育了使我们这座城市与众不同的文化活力。
