foster.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

foster.en: Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.
foster.zh: 这不仅会引发政治和社会动荡，正如科伊尔所指出的，还可能阻碍区域经济增长所需的各类人工智能技术的发展。
foster.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

frequent.en: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
frequent.zh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。
frequent.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

frequent.en: Instead, a growing body of research showed that frequent, low-severity fires made many ecosystems healthier.
frequent.zh: 相反，越来越多的研究表明，频繁且低烈度的火灾能让许多生态系统变得更加健康。
frequent.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

host.en: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
host.zh: 该法案要求每位民宿房东在州政府登记注册，强制他们购买保险，并在新增的州税基础上为地方税的征收创造了可能性。
host.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

host.en: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
host.zh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
host.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

imagination.en: Our imagination — remember that? — is rekindled.
imagination.zh: 我们的想象力——还记得吗？——被重新点燃了。
在这一年，尽情释放你的想象力。

import.en: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
import.zh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
import.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

import.en: Brexit is seen by some as an opportunity to reverse a recent trend towards the UK importing food.
import.zh: 一些人将英国脱欧视为扭转英国近期食品进口趋势的契机。
import.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

interact.en: Algorithms used to simulate human interactions are creating many of these concerns, especially as no-one is quite sure what the outcomes of using AI to interact with customers will be.
interact.zh: 用于模拟人际互动的算法引发了诸多此类担忧，尤其是因为没有人能完全确定使用人工智能与客户互动会产生何种结果。
interact.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

interact.en: While that may well be true, researchers have also recently found that interacting with strangers actually brings a boost in mood and feelings of belonging that we didn't expect.
interact.zh: 虽然这很可能是事实，但研究人员最近还发现，与陌生人互动实际上能带来我们未曾预料到的情绪提升和归属感增强。
interact.src: 2021 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

item.en: The foreign countries have no right to hold back returning the items.
item.zh: 外国无权拒绝归还这些物品。
item.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

item.en: Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen "nature carpets"—large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins, cabbages, and watermelons.
item.zh: 这些作品包括玫瑰花丛等小型物件，以及几十块“自然地毯”——这些大型矩形作品装饰着泡沫制成的南瓜、卷心菜和西瓜。
item.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

laughter.en: They are noting that the Victorians suddenly seem to become more human as the hundred-or-so years that separate us fade away through our common experience of laughter.
laughter.zh: 人们注意到，当分隔我们的百余年时光通过共同的欢笑体验渐渐消散时，维多利亚时代的人们突然显得更具人情味了。
laughter.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

laughter.en: We tend to think that friends and family members are our biggest sources of connection, laughter, and warmth.
laughter.zh: 我们往往认为朋友和家人是我们获取情感联结、欢声笑语和温暖关怀的最大来源。
laughter.src: 2021 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

launch.en: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
launch.zh: 自2008年罗马至米兰的高铁网络开通以来，火车已成为当地人和游客在意大利境内旅行的首选交通工具。
launch.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

launch.en: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
launch.zh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
launch.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

male.en: In Cambodia, the choice of a spouse is a complex one for the young male.
male.zh: 在柬埔寨，年轻男性选择配偶是一件复杂的事情。
male.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

male.en: Divorced persons may remarry, but a gender prejudice shows up: The divorced male doesn't have a waiting period before he can remarry while the woman must wait ten months.
male.zh: 离婚人士可以再婚，但存在性别偏见：离婚男性可以立即再婚，无需等待期，而女性则必须等待十个月。
male.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

military.en: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
military.zh: 战争日益依赖于雷达和近炸引信等新型军事技术。
military.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

military.en: G.I. is just a military abbreviation meaning Government Issue, and it was on all of the articles handed out to soldiers.
military.zh: G.I.只是一个军事缩写，意为“政府配给”，所有分发给士兵的物品上都印有这个标识。
military.src: 2012 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

motion.en: For example, a busy street might not suit a motion-sensored door, as it would constantly be opening for passers-by.
motion.zh: 例如，繁忙的街道可能不适合安装运动感应门，因为它会不断为路人自动开启。
motion.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）
2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

muscle.en: The action will remind you of the joy the activity brought you and prime your muscles for when you can get out there again.
muscle.zh: 这些动作会让你想起这项运动曾带给你的快乐，并为肌肉做好准备，以便你能再次回到运动场上。
muscle.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

muscle.en: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
muscle.zh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
muscle.src: 2021 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

originate.en: In the United States, the desire to provide the public with a general, nontechnical education in science originated as far back as the late 1800s.
originate.zh: 在美国，为大众提供非技术性科普教育的初衷最早可以追溯到 19 世纪晚期。
originate.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

originate.en: The group in question is a particular people originated from central Europe.
originate.zh: 文中所指的这个群体是一个起源于中欧的特定民族。
originate.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 完形填空（四选一）

owe.en: Customers now routinely see menus of suggested default options—often well above 20% of what they owe.
owe.zh: 顾客现在经常会看到建议的默认选项菜单——通常远高于账单金额的20%。
owe.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

owe.en: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
owe.zh: 如果商家没有向顾客收取销售税，顾客通常需要自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数人并未意识到自己有此义务，因此很少有人实际缴纳。
owe.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ownership.en: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
ownership.zh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
ownership.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

ownership.en: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
ownership.zh: 成本如此高昂的另一个原因是该行业限制性的行会式所有权结构。
ownership.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

permanent.en: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
permanent.zh: 这笔资金的大部分将来自两个方面：一是永久性地将每封信的邮资提高1美分，二是将邮政退休人员转入联邦医疗保险(Medicare)体系。
permanent.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

permanent.en: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood.
permanent.zh: 但专业剧团在其固定剧院中蓬勃发展，而怀有文学抱负的大学才子们迅速转向这些剧院，将其视为谋生手段。
permanent.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

philosopher.en: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
philosopher.zh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
philosopher.src: 2016 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

philosopher.en: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim—a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
philosopher.zh: 最终，一个科学发现声明获得可信度是一个过程——这一过程与哲学家安妮特·拜尔所描述的“思想的公共领域”相符。
philosopher.src: 2012 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

poll.en: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
poll.zh: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然势头强劲，但是，要使合作取得成功，双方都需要投入时间，并乐于接受惊喜与挑战。
poll.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

poll.en: Fewer artists than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements.
poll.zh: 在《自然》杂志的这项调查中，艺术家的回应人数少于科学家；然而，一些受访者指出，艺术家并非仅仅是帮助科学家满足其传播需求。
poll.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

province.en: Ferraro analyzed satellite data showing annual forest loss from 2008 to 2012—including during Indonesia's phase-in of the antipoverty program—in 7,468 forested villages across 15 provinces.
province.zh: 费拉罗分析了2008年至2012年间的卫星数据，这些数据显示了印度尼西亚15个省份7468个森林村庄的年度森林损失情况，其中包括该国扶贫计划的逐步实施阶段。
province.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

province.en: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
province.zh: 伦敦如此，英国其他地区更是如此。
province.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

recall.en: When Tom Swetnam joined the U.S. Forest Service in the 1970s, his mandate was to "put everything out," he recalled.
recall.zh: 汤姆·斯威特南回想起他在 20 世纪 70 年代加入美国林业局时，得到的指示是“扑灭一切火情”。
recall.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

recall.en: The latter group made no effort to recall the information when quizzed on it later, because they knew they could find it on their computers.
recall.zh: 后者在随后接受测试时并未努力回忆这些信息，因为他们知道可以在电脑上找到。
recall.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

recognition.en: His status in Lord Wellington's headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.
recognition.zh: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及因其工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队中的阶级政治紧密相连。
recognition.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

recognition.en: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
recognition.zh: 该研究指出，视觉识别是“一种自动的心理过程，它快速且直观地发生，几乎或完全没有明显的有意识思考”。
recognition.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

recruit.en: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
recruit.zh: 这表明，为日益艰巨的工作岗位招募顶尖人才符合更广泛的企业利益。
recruit.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

recruit.en: Other industries are recruiting them with similar or better pay.
recruit.zh: 其他行业正以相当或更高的薪资招募他们。
recruit.src: 2017 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

reference.en: Nowadays, his reading material has changed from science fiction and reference books: recently, he revealed that he reads at least 50 nonfiction books a year.
reference.zh: 如今，他的阅读材料已不再是科幻小说和参考书：最近，他透露自己每年至少阅读50本非虚构类书籍。
reference.src: 2018 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

reference.en: In effect, you try to reconstruct the likely meanings or effects that any given sentence, image or reference might have had: These might be the ones the author intended.
reference.zh: 实际上，你会尝试重构任何特定句子、图像或引用可能具有的潜在含义或效果：这些可能就是作者想要表达的。
reference.src: 2015 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

register.en: Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city's Inspectional Services Department.
register.zh: 波士顿则更进一步，要求短租房东在该市的检查服务部门进行登记。
register.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

register.en: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
register.zh: 该法案要求每位民宿房东在州政府登记注册，强制他们购买保险，并在新增的州税基础上为地方税的征收创造了可能性。
register.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reliable.en: "Machine learning often provides a more reliable form of statistics which makes data more valuable," says Winston.
reliable.zh: 温斯顿表示：“机器学习往往能提供更可靠的统计方式，从而提升数据的价值。”
reliable.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

relieve.en: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily.
relieve.zh: 7月29日，他们如释重负，至少暂时如此。
relieve.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

relieve.en: The Supreme Court's decisions on physician-assisted suicide carry important implications for how medicine seeks to relieve dying patients of pain and suffering.
relieve.zh: 最高法院关于医生协助自杀的裁决，对医学界如何致力于减轻临终患者的痛苦具有重要意义。
relieve.src: 2002 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

religion.en: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion.
religion.zh: 正是这种思维方式导致许多人试图避免争论，尤其是关于政治和宗教的争论。

religion.en: Meanwhile, many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's, as one clergyman learned in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion.
religion.zh: 与此同时，许多移民的宗教信仰远不如戴恩那般虔诚。正如一位牧师在与沿海居民交流时所了解到的，这些人嘲讽道，他们来新大陆并非为了宗教。
religion.src: 2009 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

reluctant.en: pupils may be reluctant to work on other old dramatists
reluctant.zh: 学生们可能不愿学习其他老一辈剧作家的作品
reluctant.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reluctant.en: Texas is reluctant to rewrite its science textbooks.
reluctant.zh: 得克萨斯州不愿重写其科学教科书。
reluctant.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

remind.en: To overcome these difficulties, try to remind yourself that everyone needs help sometimes.
remind.zh: 要克服这些困难，试着提醒自己：每个人有时都需要帮助。
remind.src: 2025 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

remind.en: Remind its users to obey existing rules.
remind.zh: 提醒其用户遵守现有规则。
remind.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

retail.en: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
retail.zh: 零售分析师尼尔·桑德斯表示，输家是那些纯在线零售商，尤其是规模较小的商家。
retail.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

retail.en: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
retail.zh: 零售贸易组织对这一裁决表示赞赏，称其为本地企业和在线企业创造了公平的竞争环境。
retail.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reverse.en: Brexit is seen by some as an opportunity to reverse a recent trend towards the UK importing food.
reverse.zh: 一些人将英国脱欧视为扭转英国近期食品进口趋势的契机。
reverse.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reverse.en: For example, Business Week predicted in 1975 that electronic means of payment would soon "revolutionize the very concept of money itself," only to reverse itself several years later.
reverse.zh: 例如，《商业周刊》在1975年曾预测，电子支付方式很快将“彻底改变货币本身的概念”，然而几年后却推翻了这一预测。
reverse.src: 2013 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

scene.en: Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes, characters and mental states.
scene.zh: 当我们模拟场景、角色和心理状态时，大脑的不同区域会参与其中。

scene.en: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons.
scene.zh: 上个月，悉尼交响乐团演奏了安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》的改编版本，这正是艺术家与科学家携手共创精彩的一个范例。
scene.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

settle.en: It will settle the prior controversies.
settle.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

settle.en: Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single.
settle.zh: 如今的农场工人虽然仍主要出生于墨西哥，但他们更有可能已定居下来而非流动作业，且更有可能已婚而非单身。
settle.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

shock.en: When left alone in the room, the students who did not know which ones would shock them clicked more pens and incurred more shocks than the students who knew what would happen.
shock.zh: 当被单独留在房间里时，那些不知道哪些钢笔会产生电击的学生比知道会发生什么的学生点击了更多钢笔，也遭受了更多次电击。
shock.src: 2018 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

shock.en: Half of the pens would deliver an electric shock when clicked.
shock.zh: 其中一半的钢笔在按下时会产生电击。
shock.src: 2018 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

spark.en: In online spaces, desire paths have sparked a fascination that can approach obsession, with the Reddit page serving as a hub.
spark.zh: 在网络空间中，"欲望小径"引发了近乎痴迷的狂热，而Reddit相关板块则成为了这一现象的中心。
spark.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

spark.en: Artifacts in museums have the power to inspire, and perhaps spark that need to learn and understand the nature of their creators.
spark.zh: 博物馆中的文物具有启发人心的力量，或许还能激发人们去了解和理解其创造者的本质。
spark.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

substantial.en: In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance.
substantial.zh: 《华尔街日报》在其最新的CEO薪酬调查中发现，高管薪酬的“很大一部分”现在与业绩挂钩。
substantial.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

substantial.en: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby.
substantial.zh: 掌握欧洲批发业复杂运作的零售商完全有望因此获得丰厚利润。

subtle.en: Thankfully, there is a way out of this trap – but it involves striking a subtle balance.
subtle.zh: 值得庆幸的是，我们有办法摆脱这一困境——但这需要达成一种微妙的平衡。
subtle.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

subtle.en: But the headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all – and the subtle devaluing of anything less – misses an important point: That's not the only thing the American economy needs.
subtle.zh: 但是，盲目地推动所有人都去攻读学士学位——以及对低于学士学位的教育进行微妙贬低——忽略了一个重要问题：这并非美国经济唯一需要的东西。
subtle.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

sufficient.en: they are unable to get sufficient facilities.
sufficient.zh: 他们无法获得充足的设施。
sufficient.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

sufficient.en: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
sufficient.zh: 其前提是，普通合同法未能为劳动者提供足够的保护，以抵御管理层的任意行为。
sufficient.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

suit.en: For example, a busy street might not suit a motion-sensored door, as it would constantly be opening for passers-by.
suit.zh: 例如，繁忙的街道可能不适合安装运动感应门，因为它会不断为路人自动开启。
suit.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

suit.en: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but are bad for high achievers.
suit.zh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员制度的文化规范适合那些希望安于现状的人，但对业绩优异者不利。
suit.src: 2012 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

suitable.en: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat, and gardening habits—paving over gardens and using pesticides—aren't helping either.
suitable.zh: 全球变暖对某些物种有利，但另一些物种因过于孤立而无法找到合适的新栖息地，而园艺习惯——将花园铺上硬路面和使用杀虫剂——也无济于事。

suitable.en: What intrinsic factors make the West a suitable home for these artifacts but preclude them from being preserved and displayed by their countries of origin?
suitable.zh: 究竟是哪些内在因素让西方成为这些文物的合适存放地，却又妨碍它们回归原产国进行保存和展示呢？
suitable.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

tendency.en: Attempts have been made to curb this tendency, for example, by trying to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant's papers.
tendency.zh: 人们已尝试遏制这种趋势，例如在评估申请者的论文时，既要考量数量，也要纳入质量衡量标准。
tendency.src: 2019 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

tendency.en: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
tendency.zh: 她通过照料者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，对每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及在道德失范行为后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。
tendency.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

tolerant.en: A more practical goal is to try, to the best of your ability, to be as tolerant and composed as you can when faced with trying situations involving your children.
tolerant.zh: 一个更实际的目标是，在面对与孩子相关的棘手情况时，尽你所能地保持宽容和冷静。
tolerant.src: 2020 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

tolerant.en: Sometimes parents get exhausted and frustrated and are unable to maintain a tolerant and composed style with their kids.
tolerant.zh: 有时候父母会感到疲惫和沮丧，无法对孩子保持宽容和冷静的态度。
tolerant.src: 2020 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

trail.en: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
trail.zh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
trail.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trail.en: This trail, when Dutch colonists arrived, was widened and made into one of the main trade roads across the island, known at the time as de Heere Straat, or Gentlemen's Street.
trail.zh: 荷兰殖民者到来后，这条小径被拓宽，成为横贯全岛的主要贸易通道之一，当时被称为de Heere Straat，即“绅士街”。
trail.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trap.en: The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other.
trap.zh: 艺术与科学合作的影响范围需要超越研究传播这一必要目的，并且参与者不应陷入对彼此产生刻板印象的误区。
trap.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

trap.en: It set the trapped rats free.
trap.zh: 它会打开笼门，让被困的老鼠逃脱。
trap.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trick.en: Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel.
trick.zh: 想想那些让你感到被欺骗或沮丧的时刻：某个会员或订阅服务注册过程异常顺畅，可后来却难以取消。
trick.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trick.en: The trick is not only to specify just one or even two dimensions of the objective, but also to understand how to help people better achieve the objective.
trick.zh: 关键在于不仅要明确目标的一个甚至两个维度，还要理解如何帮助人们更好地实现目标。
trick.src: 2021 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

trigger.en: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.
trigger.zh: 在某些地区，仅日间高温就可能足以触发警报。
trigger.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

trigger.en: And their triggering thresholds often are not customized to the local climate.
trigger.zh: 而且它们的触发阈值往往没有根据当地气候进行定制。
trigger.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, the polyurethane foam he used is inherently unstable.
unfortunately.zh: 不幸的是，他所使用的聚氨酯泡沫本质上就不稳定。
unfortunately.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, the long-term costs of using simple quantitative metrics to assess researcher merit are likely to be quite great.
unfortunately.zh: 不幸的是，使用简单的量化指标来评估研究人员水平，其长期代价可能相当高昂。
unfortunately.src: 2019 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

universal.en: As degrees became universal, they became devalued.
universal.zh: 随着大学学历变得普及，其价值也随之下降。
universal.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

universal.en: This universal protection sends the message: "Please don't approach me."
universal.zh: 这种普遍的自我保护发出了一个信号：'请不要靠近我。'
universal.src: 2015 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

vary.en: The size or regularity of markets can vary from season to season, depending on the area's agricultural calendar, and you're likely to find different produce on sale at different times of the year.
vary.zh: 农贸市场的规模和举办频率会随季节变化，这取决于当地的农业生产周期，而且在一年中的不同时节，你可能会发现市场上售卖的农产品也各不相同。
vary.src: 2024 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

vary.en: While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly, there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
vary.zh: 尽管法律新闻报道的质量参差不齐，但许多记者却过度依赖律师提供的解读。
vary.src: 2007 英语（未分卷） 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

virtual.en: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet.
virtual.zh: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳应用方式尚未被发明出来。
virtual.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

virtual.en: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
virtual.zh: 鉴于目前近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——可以说这是一场由沟通失败引发的流行病。
virtual.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

vote.en: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
vote.zh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
vote.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

vote.en: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
vote.zh: 然而，该法案提出的机制过于繁琐，并且在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
vote.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

yield.en: Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew they produce when they feed, so Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.
yield.zh: 就像某些蚂蚁养殖蚜虫以获取它们进食时分泌的蜜露一样，谷歌也在“养殖”我们，以获取我们数字生活所产生的数据。
yield.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

yield.en: In the absence of work, a society designed with other ends in mind could yield strikingly different circumstances for the future of labor and leisure.
yield.zh: 如果没有工作，一个为其他目标而设计的社会可能会为劳动和休闲的未来带来截然不同的情景。
yield.src: 2017 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

abandon.zh: 保守党可能会放弃“计划外”建设。
abandon.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

abandon.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
abandon.zh: 最成功的君主制国家都在努力摒弃或隐藏其旧有的贵族做派。
abandon.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

absorb.en: Helping forests flourish as valuable "carbon sinks" long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now.
absorb.zh: 要想让森林在未来长期作为宝贵的“碳汇”蓬勃发展，可能需要现在就降低它们的碳吸收能力。
absorb.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

absorb.en: The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb.
absorb.zh: 我们正在加速的气候变化，终有一天可能会使森林释放的碳超过其吸收的碳。
absorb.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

accelerate.en: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.
accelerate.zh: 近年来，这种鲜为人知的做法使用频率急剧上升，因为各大学持续竭尽全力留住学生（并让他们支付学费），同时提高毕业率。
accelerate.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

accelerate.en: Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate.
accelerate.zh: 更糟糕的是，这一数字如今正以加速之势下降。
accelerate.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

addition.en: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
addition.zh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
addition.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

addition.en: There's just one thing you should try to keep at least some time for, in addition to your writing—and that's reading.
addition.zh: 除了写作之外，有一件事你应该尽量保留至少一些时间去做——那就是阅读。
addition.src: 2022 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

ancestor.en: They seemed mysterious to human ancestors.
ancestor.zh: 对于人类祖先而言，它们似乎显得十分神秘。
ancestor.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

ancestor.en: He notes that each individual has many ancestors – numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back.
ancestor.zh: 他指出，每个人都有许多祖先——仅回溯几百年，祖先数量就多达数百位。
ancestor.src: 2009 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

anxious.en: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
anxious.zh: 尽管经济蓬勃发展，但似乎难以缓解这一代人内心深处的焦虑紧迫感，尤其是那些背负大学债务的年轻人。
anxious.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

anxious.en: Many of us are weighed down by the past or anxious about the future.
anxious.zh: 我们很多人都被过去所累，或对未来感到焦虑。
anxious.src: 2015 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

assemble.en: How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery although it is the subject of current research.
assemble.zh: 尽管这是当前研究的主题，但大脑如何将这些信息整合并最终形成完整图像的感知过程仍然是一个未解之谜。
assemble.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

assemble.en: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
assemble.zh: 学生们也可以通过组装自行车来学习几何学。
assemble.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

assistant.en: Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants' eating habits and students' video exposure.
assistant.zh: 目前，研究人员正在深入探究教学风格、助教饮食习惯以及学生观看视频情况所产生的具体影响。
assistant.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

assistant.en: Srini Pillay, an assistant professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School, believes this counterintuitive link between downtime and productivity may be due to the way our brains operate.
assistant.zh: 哈佛医学院精神病学助理教授斯里尼·皮莱认为，这种休息时间与工作效率之间看似矛盾的联系可能与我们大脑的运作方式有关。
assistant.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

attend.en: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war.
attend.zh: 并且，这些社会中兴起的接受高等教育的需求，延伸到了战前从未考虑过上大学的群体和社会阶层。
attend.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

attend.en: I've attended research conferences where a scientist has been asked what he thinks about the advisability of continuing a certain experiment.
attend.zh: 我曾参加过一些研究会议，会上有人问一位科学家，他认为继续某项实验是否可取。
attend.src: 1999 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

belong.en: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
belong.zh: 关键问题在于，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业。
belong.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

belong.en: While fossil fuels – coal, oil, gas – still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
belong.zh: 虽然化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍占全球能源供应的约85%，但未来属于风能和太阳能等可再生能源这一点比以往任何时候都更加明确。
belong.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

biology.en: There are around 40 official do-it-yourself biology centres across the globe in locations including Paris, London, Sydney, and Tel Aviv.
biology.zh: 全球约有40个官方的自助生物学中心，分布在巴黎、伦敦、悉尼和特拉维夫等城市。
biology.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

biology.en: The rise of citizen science has grown alongside the rise of do-it-yourself biology laboratories around the world.
biology.zh: 公民科学的兴起与全球范围内DIY生物实验室的增多相伴而行。
biology.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

brief.zh: 眼睛注视的时间很短暂
brief.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）
2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

central.en: As the war unfolded, science rapidly assumed a central role.
central.zh: 随着战争的展开，科学迅速占据了中心地位。
central.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

central.en: This concept has served as a central goal for curriculum developers, local school boards, business and community leaders, and policymakers ever since its introduction nearly 80 years ago.
central.zh: 自近80年前被提出以来，这一概念一直是课程开发者、地方学校委员会、商业与社区领袖以及决策者们的中心目标。
central.src: 2026 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

clothing.en: Different cultures have their norms and expectations regarding dress, which can influence the types of clothing people wear and the meanings attributed to them.
clothing.zh: 不同的文化对着装有各自的规范和预期，这会影响人们选择的服装类型及其所代表的含义。
clothing.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

clothing.en: Additionally, clothing can impact our confidence levels.
clothing.zh: 此外，穿着打扮也会影响我们的自信程度。
clothing.src: 2026 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

compromise.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
compromise.zh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
compromise.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

compromise.en: We neither understand nor respect each other, and we have no basis for compromise or cooperation.
compromise.zh: 我们既不理解也不尊重对方，更没有达成妥协或合作的基础。

concentration.en: "This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power," says literary agent Andrew Lownie.
concentration.zh: 文学经纪人安德鲁·劳尼表示：“这一切都是权力集中这一更大趋势的一部分。”
concentration.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

concentration.en: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
concentration.zh: 将这项技术应用于医疗保健领域，其潜力巨大，但同时也可能导致科技巨头的权力进一步集中。
concentration.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

convention.en: Recent decades have seen science move into a convention where engagement in the subject can only be done through institutions such as a university.
convention.zh: 近几十年来，科学界逐渐形成了一种惯例：只有通过大学等机构才能参与科学研究。
convention.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

convention.zh: 它们反映了19世纪的社会习俗。
convention.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

creature.en: Some creatures in the forest that multiply fast can become a great threat to forest restoration.
creature.zh: 森林中一些繁殖迅速的生物可能会对森林恢复造成巨大威胁。
creature.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

creature.en: To pressure zoos to spend less on their animals would lead to inhumane outcomes for the precious creatures in their care.
creature.zh: 迫使动物园减少在动物身上的投入，将给那些受其照料的珍贵生灵带来不人道的后果。
creature.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

crude.en: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
crude.zh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

crude.en: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need.
crude.zh: 一个神圣的安宁之地，无论多么简陋，都是人类特有的需求，而与之相对的庇护所则是动物特有的需求。
crude.src: 2013 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

democracy.en: In a direct democracy, citizens take turns governing themselves, rather than electing representatives to govern for them.
democracy.zh: 在直接民主制度中，公民轮流自我治理，而非选举代表代其治理。
democracy.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

democracy.en: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
democracy.zh: 陪审团也被认为是现存最能体现直接民主而非代议制民主的典范。
democracy.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

dependent.en: In adolescence, helpless and dependent children who have relied on grown-ups for just about everything become independent people who can take care of themselves and help each other.
dependent.zh: 在青春期，曾经事事依赖成年人的无助孩童，会转变为能够自理并互助的独立个体。
dependent.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

dependent.en: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
dependent.zh: 虽然几乎没有工匠或农夫——更不用说家属和仆人了——留下可供分析的文字作品，但显然他们的观点远未达到充分的理性化。
dependent.src: 2009 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

desirable.en: Sharpening judgment by absorbing and reflecting on law is a desirable component of a journalist's intellectual preparation for his or her career.
desirable.zh: 通过理解和思考法律来提高判断力，是记者为其职业生涯进行知识准备的重要组成部分。
desirable.src: 2007 英语（未分卷） 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

distinction.en: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
distinction.zh: 但这种区分忽略了一个关键点：赋予数据价值的是对数据的处理和整合，而非仅仅拥有这些数据。
distinction.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

distinction.en: Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court, or for the choir boys of St. Paul's and the royal chapel, who, however, gave plays in public as well as at court.
distinction.zh: 追求文学造诣的戏剧作品当时多为学校、宫廷或圣保罗大教堂与皇家礼拜堂的唱诗班男孩们而作，不过这些唱诗班男孩们不仅在宫廷演出，也会进行公开表演。
distinction.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

district.en: The Chesapeake draws from a 64,000-square-mile watershed that extends into Virginia, Pennsylvania, New York, West Virginia, the District of Columbia and Delaware.
district.zh: 切萨皮克湾的流域面积达64,000平方英里，延伸至弗吉尼亚州、宾夕法尼亚州、纽约州、西弗吉尼亚州、哥伦比亚特区和特拉华州。
district.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

district.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.
district.zh: 另一个全国性担忧是，其他机构的公共资金是否正投入到火灾易发区的建设中。
district.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

divorce.en: Divorce is legal and easy to obtain, but not common.
divorce.zh: 离婚是合法的，也容易办理，但并不常见。
divorce.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

divorce.en: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
divorce.zh: 鉴于目前近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——可以说这是一场由沟通失败引发的流行病。
divorce.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

dominate.en: Still, AI also has the potential hazard of dominating our experiences in ways we might find difficult to control.
dominate.zh: 尽管如此，AI 仍存在潜在风险，即可能以我们难以掌控的方式主导我们的体验。
dominate.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

dominate.en: Microsoft's own Office dominates the market for "productivity" software, but the start-ups represented a new wave of technology designed from the ground up for the smartphone world.
dominate.zh: 微软自家的Office软件主导着"生产力"软件市场，但这些初创公司代表了为智能手机世界从头打造的新一轮技术浪潮。
dominate.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

equipment.en: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
equipment.zh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

equipment.en: A number of companies, particularly in energy and transportation, use AI image processing technology to inspect infrastructure and prevent equipment failure or leaks before they happen.
equipment.zh: 许多公司，特别是能源和运输行业的公司，正在使用人工智能图像处理技术来检查基础设施，并在设备故障或泄漏发生前加以预防。
equipment.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

exception.en: Congress allocates only $3 billion a year to the national park system—an amount that has been flat since 2001 (in inflation-adjusted dollars) with the exception of a onetime boost in 2009.
exception.zh: 国会每年仅为国家公园系统拨款30亿美元——经通货膨胀调整后，这一金额自2001年以来基本持平，仅在2009年有过一次临时增加。
exception.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

exception.en: But they are the exception, not the norm that Ms. Marris implies.
exception.zh: 但这些只是例外情况，而非马里斯女士所暗示的普遍现象。
exception.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

external.en: In a very practical way, the Internet is becoming an external hard drive for our memories, a process known as "cognitive offloading."
external.zh: 从非常实际的角度来看，互联网正成为我们记忆的外部硬盘，这一过程被称为'认知卸载'。
external.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

external.en: Today many people find it difficult to trust their own opinion and seek balance by gaining objectivity from external sources.
external.zh: 如今，许多人难以相信自己的观点，而试图通过外部来源获取客观意见来寻求平衡。
external.src: 2015 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

facility.en: they are unable to get sufficient facilities.
facility.zh: 他们无法获得充足的设施。
facility.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

facility.en: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations.
facility.zh: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和法规时，问题就出现了。
facility.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

flaw.en: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.
flaw.zh: 从一开始，这一价格标签就成了预检计划的致命缺陷。
flaw.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

flaw.en: Many argue that it is a flawed concept.
flaw.zh: 许多人认为这是一个有缺陷的概念。
flaw.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

folk.en: "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement."
folk.zh: 这不仅仅与经济因素有关。工作的价值也促使人们在退休后继续工作。
folk.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

folk.en: Within the span of a hundred years, in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, a tide of emigration – one of the great folk wanderings of history – swept from Europe to America.
folk.zh: 在17世纪至18世纪初的百年间，一股移民潮——历史上规模宏大的民众迁徙之一——从欧洲席卷至美洲。
folk.src: 2015 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

foundation.en: "Elephants never forget"—or so they say—and that piece of folklore seems to have some foundation.
foundation.zh: 人们常说“大象永远不会忘记”——而这一民间说法似乎确有一定依据。
foundation.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

foundation.en: The history of the EEOB began long before its foundations were laid.
foundation.zh: 艾森豪威尔行政办公大楼的历史远在其奠基石铺设之前就已开始。

generous.en: And, as our research emphasizes, tipping now seems to be more coercive, less generous and often completely dissociated from service quality.
generous.zh: 而且，正如我们的研究所强调的，如今的小费似乎更具强制性，少了些慷慨，并且往往与服务质量完全脱节。
generous.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

generous.en: Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.
generous.zh: 取而代之的是，申领者获得的是有时间限制的"补贴"，条件是必须积极寻找工作；没有任何应得权益，也没有保险可言，每周仅71.70英镑，这是欧盟中最吝啬的福利之一。
generous.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

household.en: And for women who work outside the home, they often are playing catch-up with household tasks.
household.zh: 而对于外出工作的女性而言，她们往往还要忙着补上家务劳动。
household.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

household.en: What the study doesn't measure is whether people are still doing work when they're at home, whether it is household work or work brought home from the office.
household.zh: 该研究并未衡量人们在家时是否仍在工作——无论是家务劳动还是从办公室带回的工作。
household.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

impression.en: This is especially true in first impressions.
impression.zh: 这一点在第一印象中尤为重要。
impression.src: 2016 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

impression.en: History and news become confused, and one's impressions tend to be a mixture of skepticism and optimism.
impression.zh: 历史与新闻变得混淆不清，人们的印象往往是怀疑与乐观交织的复杂感受。
impression.src: 2005 英语（未分卷） 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

independence.en: Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive's proposals.
independence.zh: 由于他们在其他领域已经积累了财富和声望，因此想必拥有足够的独立性来对首席执行官的提议提出异议。
independence.src: 2011 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

independence.en: The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
independence.zh: 具体细节或许无法得知，但会计准则制定者的独立性——这对资本市场的正常运作至关重要——正在受到损害。
independence.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

initiative.en: Your boss proposes a new initiative you think won't work.
initiative.zh: 你的老板提出了一项你认为行不通的新举措。
initiative.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

initiative.en: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
initiative.zh: 在我们瞬息万变的经济环境中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些在工作场合能够主动采取行动并发挥想象力以应对突发事件的人才。
initiative.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

internal.en: This will help to grow your internal network, in addition to being a nice break in the work day.
internal.zh: 这不仅能为你的工作日带来愉快的调剂，还有助于拓展你在公司内部的人脉网络。
internal.src: 2020 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

internal.en: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
internal.zh: 期刊内部编辑、现有评审编辑委员会或外部同行评审员将标记出需要额外审查的稿件。
internal.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

lean.en: Meanwhile there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental well-being.
lean.zh: 与此同时，随着年龄增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并维持肌肉量，以保护你的身心健康。
lean.src: 2021 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

lean.en: "It surely seems plausible that happy people would be more forward-thinking and creative and lean towards R&D more than the average," said one researcher.
lean.zh: 一位研究人员表示：“快乐的人比普通人更具前瞻性和创造力，并且更倾向于研发投入，这似乎是合理的。”
lean.src: 2016 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

location.en: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations, there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year.
location.zh: 尽管加利福尼亚州流失了大量的影视制作业务到其他地区，但在今年之前，洛杉矶仍有大量的电影拍摄工作正在进行。
location.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

location.en: A year later, he returned with a few students to examine the location and map the site.
location.zh: 一年后，他带着几名学生回到此地考察，并绘制了该遗址的地图。
location.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

manner.en: The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.
manner.zh: 因此，计算机对电视构成的挑战，与黑胶唱片机被CD播放机取代这类格式更替几乎没有相似之处。
manner.src: 2012 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

manner.en: On the other, it links these concepts to everyday realities in a manner which is parallel to the links journalists forge on a daily basis as they cover and comment on the news.
manner.zh: 另一方面，它将这些概念与日常现实联系起来，其方式类似于记者在日常报道和评论新闻时所建立的联系。
manner.src: 2007 英语（未分卷） 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

mere.en: A hundred years on from Marconi and Reith, is the art of mere listening endangered?
mere.zh: 从马可尼和里思的时代至今已过百年，单纯“听”的艺术是否已面临消亡？
mere.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

mere.en: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
mere.zh: 但这种区分忽略了一个关键点：赋予数据价值的是对数据的处理和整合，而非仅仅拥有这些数据。
mere.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

obscure.en: At the same time, Dickens, who had a reporter's eye for transcribing the life around him, especially anything comic or odd, submitted short sketches to obscure magazines.
obscure.zh: 与此同时，狄更斯以记者特有的敏锐观察记录着身边的生活，尤其善于捕捉那些滑稽或奇特的事物，并向一些名不见经传的杂志投稿短篇随笔。

obscure.en: Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.
obscure.zh: 然而，其报告掩盖了国会要求其阐明的挑战的深度和广度，很可能会阻碍改革的进程。
obscure.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

philosophy.en: Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion.
philosophy.zh: 在四个大型哲学班中，一半的学生阅读了一篇关于工厂化养殖肉类伦理问题的文章，还可以选择观看一个11分钟的相关主题视频，并参与了50分钟的讨论。
philosophy.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

philosophy.en: It was with these great revelations that a new kind of philosophy founded in reason was born.
philosophy.zh: 正是基于这些重大启示，一种以理性为基础的新哲学应运而生。
philosophy.src: 2020 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

prior.en: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
prior.zh: 在组建增长团队之前，软件公司BitTorrent有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。
prior.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

prior.en: The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau.
prior.zh: 美国人口普查局数据显示，2018年65岁及以上人口占比为16%，较前一年增长32%。
prior.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

profitable.en: They are profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important than the condition of the animals.
profitable.zh: 它们是盈利性机构，其盈亏底线远比动物的生存状况重要得多。
profitable.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

profitable.en: The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable.
profitable.zh: 可持续发展的概念已被定义为有利可图的。
profitable.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

reliance.en: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.
reliance.zh: 我们需要在社区和初级医疗方面加大投入，以减少对医院的依赖。
reliance.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

reliance.en: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
reliance.zh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
reliance.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

remark.en: remarks that significant moves may pose challenges to children.
remark.zh: 称重大搬家可能给孩子带来困难
remark.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

remark.en: "It's a really hard thing to do and it's a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business," Peretti remarked.
remark.zh: 佩雷蒂表示：“这确实是一件棘手的事，而BuzzFeed没有传统业务包袱，这实在是一种巨大的优势。”
remark.src: 2016 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

restrict.en: Urge legislation to restrict its use.
restrict.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

restrict.en: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
restrict.zh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
restrict.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

retain.en: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
retain.zh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
retain.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

retain.en: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an "urgent rethink" of the hospital-centric model we retain.
retain.zh: 我们共同呼吁就英国医疗卫生的未来开展更加开放和坦诚的对话，并“紧急反思”我们目前仍在沿用的以医院为中心的模式。
retain.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

scheme.en: In Germany, one scheme has paired an old people's home with a nursery.
scheme.zh: 在德国，有一项计划将养老院与托儿所配对合作。
scheme.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

scheme.en: What prompted the chancellor to develop his scheme?
scheme.zh: 是什么促使财政大臣制定了他的计划？
scheme.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

somewhat.en: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
somewhat.zh: 因此，除非客户愿意签署数据使用授权协议，否则人工智能的应用在未来可能会受到一定限制。
somewhat.src: 2023 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

somewhat.en: Likewise, among the elderly, being somewhat overweight is often an indicator of good health.
somewhat.zh: 同样，在老年人中，体重略超通常是健康状况良好的标志。
somewhat.src: 2014 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

sponsor.en: They include materials sponsored by energy industry associations.
sponsor.zh: 其中包括由能源行业协会赞助的材料。
sponsor.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

sponsor.en: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provides a case in point.
sponsor.zh: 马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德提出的两项法案旨在确保各委员会和董事会实现"性别平等"，这就是一个恰当的例子。
sponsor.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

stem.en: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
stem.zh: 研究人员此前曾报告称，尽管植物没有大脑，但其茎和叶中电信号的传递仍会引发暗示意识存在的反应。
stem.src: 2022 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

stem.en: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
stem.zh: 部分增长源于政府和有远见的企业承诺为清洁能源提供资金支持。
stem.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

suicide.en: Seymour made the change, went into his backyard, and expressed his displeasure by committing suicide.
suicide.zh: 西摩按要求修改了画作，随后走进后院，以自杀的方式表达了他的不满。

suicide.en: Just three weeks before the Court's ruling on physician-assisted suicide, the National Academy of Science (NAS) released a two-volume report, Approaching Death: Improving Care at the End of Life.
suicide.zh: 就在最高法院对医生协助自杀作出裁决的三周前，美国国家科学院（NAS）发布了一份两卷本报告——《走近死亡：改善生命末期护理》。
suicide.src: 2002 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

telescope.en: It was a musician who discovered the planet Uranus in the 18th century by making his own telescope with mirrors composed of copper and tin.
telescope.zh: 18世纪，一位音乐家亲手制作了一台由铜锡合金镜面组成的望远镜，并通过这台望远镜发现了天王星。
telescope.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

telescope.en: Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
telescope.zh: 莫纳克亚山矗立在太平洋中，其峰顶高耸于地球大部分浓密大气层之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得清晰度无与伦比的图像。
telescope.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

tolerance.en: Scientific method, reductionism and the questioning of Church ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance and progress.
tolerance.zh: 科学方法、还原论和对教会理念的质疑应当得到鼓励，自由、宽容和进步的思想亦是如此。
tolerance.src: 2020 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

tolerance.en: We are all becoming increasingly aware of the importance of modeling tolerance and patience for the younger generation.
tolerance.zh: 我们都越来越意识到，为年轻一代树立宽容和耐心的榜样至关重要。
tolerance.src: 2020 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

universe.en: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.
universe.zh: 在他们各自的发现问世之前，当时的许多思想家一直秉持着更为古老的思维方式，其中包括地球是宇宙中心的地心说观点。
universe.src: 2020 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

universe.en: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
universe.zh: 如果从更广阔的视角审视人类在宇宙中的位置，我们就会清楚地认识到，人类即使不能存活数十万年，也完全有机会存活数万年。
universe.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

visual.en: As an effective Washington operator, Hayden sensed that he could capitalize on the expedition's stunning visuals.
visual.zh: 作为一名在华盛顿颇具影响力的活动家，海登意识到他可以利用这次探险中令人惊叹的视觉资料。

visual.en: The founders deliberately focused their projects around light—hence the "visual studies" in the name.
visual.zh: 创始人特意将他们的项目围绕“光”展开——因此机构名称中才有“视觉研究”一词。
visual.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

vital.en: Written accounts contain vital clues for donkey research.
vital.zh: 文献记载为驴的研究提供了关键线索。
vital.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

vital.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
vital.zh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
vital.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

vulnerable.en: It's especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi's pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling.
vulnerable.zh: 这种泡沫特别容易受到光照损害，到20世纪90年代中期，吉拉迪创作的南瓜、玫瑰及其他形象已经开始开裂破碎。
vulnerable.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

vulnerable.en: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
vulnerable.zh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
vulnerable.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

absence.en: In the absence of work, a society designed with other ends in mind could yield strikingly different circumstances for the future of labor and leisure.
absence.zh: 如果没有工作，一个为其他目标而设计的社会可能会为劳动和休闲的未来带来截然不同的情景。
absence.src: 2017 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

absence.en: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
absence.zh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
absence.src: 2016 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

academy.en: That is what a study, published from the University of California and Yale University in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, has concluded.
academy.zh: 这是加州大学和耶鲁大学发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上的一项研究得出的结论。
academy.src: 2015 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

academy.en: In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
academy.zh: 作为回应，美国人文与科学院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。
academy.src: 2014 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

accomplish.en: We're also giving our customers better channels versus picking up the phone to accomplish something beyond human scale.
accomplish.zh: 我们也在为客户提供更优质的渠道，让他们不必再通过打电话来完成那些超出人力范围的事情。
accomplish.src: 2021 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

accomplish.en: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
accomplish.zh: 例如，单靠自己带购物袋去杂货店或停用塑料吸管，收效甚微，对我们的要求也极低。
accomplish.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

alongside.en: The rise of citizen science has grown alongside the rise of do-it-yourself biology laboratories around the world.
alongside.zh: 公民科学的兴起与全球范围内DIY生物实验室的增多相伴而行。
alongside.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

alongside.en: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
alongside.zh: 该提案建议，这一奖项应与现有的“文化之城”称号并行设立，赫尔市曾于2017年获得该称号，考文垂市则被授予2021年“文化之城”称号。
alongside.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

apparent.en: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present.
apparent.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来，影视制作便一直在流出好莱坞，但其影响从未像现在这样明显。
apparent.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

apparent.en: Other artists besides Rutkowski have been surprised by the apparent popularity of their work in text-to-image generators—and some are now fighting back.
apparent.zh: 除了鲁特科夫斯基之外，其他艺术家也对自己的作品在文本转图像生成器中意外走红感到惊讶——有些人现在开始反击了。
apparent.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

arouse.en: But many middle-class occupations – trucking, financial advice, software engineering – have aroused their interest, or soon will.
arouse.zh: 但许多中产阶级职业——如货运、财务咨询、软件工程——已经引起了它们的兴趣，或者很快就会引起兴趣。
arouse.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

arouse.en: He helped popularize the idea that some diseases not previously thought to have a bacterial cause were actually infections, which aroused much controversy when it was first suggested.
arouse.zh: 他曾助力普及这样一种观点：某些先前不被认为由细菌引起的疾病实际上是感染性疾病。这一观点在首次提出时曾引发诸多争议。
arouse.src: 2008 英语（未分卷） 完形填空（四选一）

atmosphere.en: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can't track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it's coming from and who's producing it?
atmosphere.zh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中的二氧化碳含量、其来源以及排放者，又怎能告知决策者降低碳排放的最佳方法呢？
atmosphere.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

atmosphere.en: Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
atmosphere.zh: 莫纳克亚山矗立在太平洋中，其峰顶高耸于地球大部分浓密大气层之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得清晰度无与伦比的图像。
atmosphere.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

civil.en: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
civil.zh: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的多项指标上都取得了显著改善。
civil.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

civil.en: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but are bad for high achievers.
civil.zh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员制度的文化规范适合那些希望安于现状的人，但对业绩优异者不利。
civil.src: 2012 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cognitive.en: Their well-developed hippocampal structures may enable elephants, like rats and people, to construct cognitive maps.
cognitive.zh: 它们发达的海马体结构或许能让大象像老鼠和人类一样构建认知地图。
cognitive.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

cognitive.en: In a very practical way, the Internet is becoming an external hard drive for our memories, a process known as "cognitive offloading."
cognitive.zh: 从非常实际的角度来看，互联网正成为我们记忆的外部硬盘，这一过程被称为'认知卸载'。
cognitive.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

considerable.en: The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more.
considerable.zh: 人造草坪行业还指出，天然草坪需要大量浇水、施用除草剂及其他养护处理，而铺设人造草坪的人往往会更多地使用他们的花园。
considerable.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

considerable.en: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
considerable.zh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
considerable.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

contrary.en: James Herriot, contrary to popular opinion, did not find it easy in his early days of, as he put it, "having a go at the writing game".
contrary.zh: 与普遍看法相反，詹姆斯·赫里奥特在他自己所说的“尝试写作生涯”初期，并未觉得这是件容易的事。
contrary.src: 2019 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

contrary.en: A new study suggests that contrary to most surveys, people are actually more stressed at home than at work.
contrary.zh: 一项新研究表明，与大多数调查结果相反，人们实际上在家中比在工作中压力更大。
contrary.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

controversial.en: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
controversial.zh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
controversial.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

controversial.en: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
controversial.zh: 在亚利桑那州诉联邦政府一案中，多数大法官推翻了亚利桑那州颇具争议的移民计划中四项受质疑条款中的三项。该计划允许州和地方警察执行联邦移民法。
controversial.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cooperate.en: It results from the wish to cooperate.
cooperate.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

cooperate.en: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.
cooperate.zh: 老鼠和其他动物需要高度敏锐地感知来自同类的社交信号，这样它们才能识别出可以合作的朋友和需要避开的敌人。
cooperate.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

cycle.en: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?
cycle.zh: 考虑到那些数字信息和无形格式的创造者很少为其长期保存做出安排，你是否思考过这些产物的生命周期？
cycle.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

cycle.en: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
cycle.zh: 这类社会救助项目被称为有条件现金转移支付(CCTs)，旨在减少不平等现象并打破贫困循环。
cycle.src: 2021 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

deserve.en: Karen R. Sime: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
deserve.zh: 卡伦·R·赛姆：虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人踏上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
deserve.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

deserve.en: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
deserve.zh: 虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
deserve.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

diminish.en: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes' wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
diminish.zh: 在湍流增强的区域，飞机尾流消散速度会更快，其效果也会减弱。
diminish.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

diminish.en: Again, differences between people and the opportunity for natural selection to take advantage of it have diminished.
diminish.zh: 此外，人与人之间的差异以及自然选择利用这些差异的机会也已经减少。
diminish.src: 2000 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

disorder.en: Pushed by science, or what claims to be science, society is reclassifying what once were considered character flaws or moral failings as personality disorders akin to physical disabilities.
disorder.zh: 在科学（或者那些自称为科学的事物）的推动下，社会正将过去被视为性格缺陷或道德过失的问题重新归类为类似于身体残疾的人格障碍。
disorder.src: 2006 英语（未分卷） 选句填空（7选5）

disorder.en: And a significant number of the homeless have serious mental disorders.
disorder.zh: 而且相当多的无家可归者患有严重的精神疾病。
disorder.src: 2006 英语（未分卷） 完形填空（四选一）

distance.en: When finding their way to waterholes, they headed off in exactly the right direction, on one occasion from a distance of roughly thirty miles.
distance.zh: 在寻找水源地时，它们总能准确地朝着正确方向出发，有一次甚至是从约30英里外的地方直接前往。
distance.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

distance.en: Increase time, distance, and intensity gradually.
distance.zh: 逐步增加运动时间、距离和强度。
distance.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

distribute.en: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
distribute.zh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
distribute.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

distribute.en: The African savanna elephant, also known as the African bush elephant, is distributed across 37 African countries.
distribute.zh: 非洲草原象，也被称为非洲丛林象，分布在37个非洲国家。
distribute.src: 2024 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

drama.en: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
drama.zh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
drama.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

drama.en: Shakespeare's lifetime was coincident with a period of extraordinary activity and achievement in the drama.
drama.zh: 莎士比亚的一生恰逢戏剧艺术空前活跃和成就斐然的时期。
drama.src: 2018 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

endeavor.en: AI can be a collaborative tool in a wide range of creative endeavors.
endeavor.zh: AI 可以在广泛的创意领域中成为一种协作工具。
endeavor.src: 2026 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

endeavor.en: These results suggest that imagining the outcome of following through on one's curiosity ahead of time can help determine whether it is worth the endeavor.
endeavor.zh: 这些结果表明，提前设想满足好奇心可能带来的后果，有助于判断这样做是否值得。
endeavor.src: 2018 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

endure.en: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years – so why shouldn't we?
endure.zh: 化石记录显示，许多物种已经存活了数百万年——那么我们人类为什么不能呢？
endure.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

endure.en: Having endured a painful period of unsustainability in his own life made it clear to him that sustainability-oriented values must be expressed through everyday action and choice.
endure.zh: 经历了自己生活中一段痛苦的不可持续时期后，他清楚地认识到，以可持续发展为导向的价值观必须通过日常行动和选择来体现。
endure.src: 2010 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

engineering.en: Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.
engineering.zh: 基于这一洞见，市场营销团队与工程团队联手合作，通过向免费版用户重点推广高级版来提高用户认知度。
engineering.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

engineering.en: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
engineering.zh: 通过从市场营销的角度审视工程问题，团队清晰地认识到，用户不愿升级并非产品质量问题。
engineering.src: 2023 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

expansion.en: Make a plan for their expansions.
expansion.zh: 为他们的扩张制定计划。
expansion.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

expansion.en: These demands resulted in a very rapid expansion of the systems of higher education, beginning in the 1960s and developing very rapidly (though unevenly) during the 1970s and 1980s.
expansion.zh: 这些需求促使高等教育体系从20世纪60年代开始迅速扩张，并在70年代和80年代以极快的速度发展（尽管发展并不均衡）。
expansion.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

extent.en: How we read a given text also depends to some extent on our particular interest in reading it.
extent.zh: 我们如何阅读特定文本，在一定程度上也取决于我们阅读它的特定兴趣。
extent.src: 2015 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

extent.en: To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame.
extent.zh: 在一定程度上，住房部门必须承担责任。
extent.src: 2014 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

faith.en: On the other hand, putting your faith in the wrong place often carries a high price.
faith.zh: 另一方面，错信他人往往会付出高昂的代价。
faith.src: 2018 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

faith.en: While most leaders sought to maintain Catholicism as the official religion of the new states, some sought to end the exclusion of other faiths.
faith.zh: 尽管大多数领导人希望将天主教保留为新国家的官方宗教，但也有一些领导人试图结束对其他宗教信仰的排斥。
faith.src: 2007 英语（未分卷） 完形填空（四选一）

forecast.en: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
forecast.zh: 但如果政策制定者能将精力重新集中在改善民众福祉上，而非仅仅纠结于GDP数据，就能避免预测中的厄运，甚至可能看到进步。
forecast.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

forecast.en: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
forecast.zh: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的判决，裁定Myriad Genetics公司确实可以拥有两项基因的专利，这两项基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。
forecast.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

guilty.en: Yet as we report now, the food police are determined that this enjoyment should be rendered yet another guilty pleasure guaranteed to damage our health.
guilty.zh: 然而，正如我们现在所报道的，食品监管部门却决心要将这种享受也归为又一种必定损害健康的“罪恶快感”。
guilty.src: 2020 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

guilty.en: For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty.
guilty.zh: 对于那些同情心较低的孩子来说，他们分享巧克力币的多少似乎取决于他们感到内疚的倾向程度。
guilty.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

immune.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures.
immune.zh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
immune.src: 2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

immune.en: For women, the association may be attributable to changes in immunity that resulted from excess abdominal fat; in men, the immune system did not appear to be involved.
immune.zh: 对于女性而言，这种关联可能源于腹部脂肪过多导致的免疫力变化；而对于男性，免疫系统似乎并未参与其中。
immune.src: 2021 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

implement.en: States have begun implementing their own solutions to shore up protections for consumer-generated health data.
implement.zh: 各州已开始实施各自的解决方案，以加强对消费者生成的健康数据的保护。
implement.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

implement.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether.
implement.zh: 这可能意味着需要实施一些政策，例如征收塑料税，让那些对环境造成问题的行为付出代价，或者完全禁止一次性塑料制品。
implement.src: 2019 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

indispensable.en: John Fraser: Marris distorts our findings which actually prove that zoos serve as an indispensable link between man and nature.
indispensable.zh: 约翰·弗雷泽：马里斯歪曲了我们的研究结果，而实际上我们的研究证明动物园是人与自然之间不可或缺的纽带。
indispensable.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

indispensable.en: Marris distorts our findings which actually prove that zoos serve as an indispensable link between man and nature.
indispensable.zh: 马里斯歪曲了我们的研究结果，而实际上这些结果证明动物园是人与自然之间不可或缺的纽带。
indispensable.src: 2022 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

inherent.en: Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
inherent.zh: 善治的基础是理解每个人的内在价值。
inherent.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

inherent.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
inherent.zh: 如果你还不相信休学一年探索兴趣的内在价值，那么不妨考虑一下它对未来学业选择的经济影响。
inherent.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

initial.en: Despite the exciting initial finds, the site would lie undisturbed for decades before archaeologists would return.
initial.zh: 尽管最初的发现令人振奋，但该遗址在考古学家再次前来之前，仍被尘封了数十年。
initial.src: 2025 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

initial.en: Honestly, if we got stuck in the rut of "hi", "hello", "how are you?" and "what is going on?", you will fail to give the initial jolt to the conversation that can make it so memorable.
initial.zh: 说实话，如果我们总是陷在“嗨”“你好”“最近怎么样”“在忙什么”这类陈词滥调中，就无法给谈话注入最初的活力，使其变得如此难忘。
initial.src: 2018 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

injury.en: "Too much too soon either results in injury or burnout," says Mary Yoke, PhD, a faculty member in the kinesiology department at Indiana University in Bloomington.
injury.zh: 印第安纳大学布卢明顿分校运动机能学系教员玛丽·约克博士表示：“急于求成、过度运动要么会导致受伤，要么会让人精疲力尽。”
injury.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

injury.en: "We're really sorry he has become paralyzed, but helmets aren't designed to prevent those kinds of injuries," says Nimmons.
injury.zh: 尼蒙斯表示：“对于他的瘫痪我们深感遗憾，但头盔的设计初衷并非为了防止此类伤害。”
injury.src: 1999 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

insight.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
insight.zh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
insight.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

insight.en: Genetic analysis offers insight into the history of donkeys.
insight.zh: 基因分析为研究驴的历史提供了见解。
insight.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

intelligent.en: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
intelligent.zh: 换而言之：我们如何确保智能机器的思维能够反映人类的最高价值观？
intelligent.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

intelligent.en: We think of it simply as a healthy and helpful flow of intelligent thought.
intelligent.zh: 我们不妨将其简单理解为一种健康有益的智慧思维流。
intelligent.src: 2016 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

investigate.en: The researchers investigated one class session's impact on eating meat.
investigate.zh: 研究人员调查了一节课对肉类食用的影响。
investigate.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

investigate.en: Biological factors behind eye contact are being investigated
investigate.zh: 眼神交流背后的生物学因素正在研究中
investigate.src: 2020 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

journey.en: True: for more than 80 pre-digital years, linear speech broadcasting brought the gift of serendipity, random enlivening of a car journey or dull manual task.
journey.zh: 的确，在数字时代到来前的 80 多年里，线性广播带来了意外发现的乐趣，为驾车出行或枯燥的体力活增添了随机的活力。
journey.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

journey.en: Indeed, it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and stock up on supplies for their own journeys.
journey.zh: 事实上，这里往往是商人们寻找销售商品并为自己的旅程补充 supplies 的第一站。
journey.src: 2023 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

latter.en: The latter group made no effort to recall the information when quizzed on it later, because they knew they could find it on their computers.
latter.zh: 后者在随后接受测试时并未努力回忆这些信息，因为他们知道可以在电脑上找到。
latter.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

latter.en: It fell short of the latter's expectations.
latter.zh: 这未能满足后者的期望。
latter.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

lecture.en: In his Oxford lectures, Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality, a "glimpsed alternative" that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large.
lecture.zh: 西amus·希尼在牛津大学的讲座中指出，诗歌描绘了一种现实图景，即一种“瞥见的替代性可能”。这种可能从细微到宏大等各个层面，都与你当下的现实构成了矛盾。

lecture.en: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
lecture.zh: 最后是视角调整，这包括认识到在人生的宏大蓝图中，一次演讲真的无关紧要。
lecture.src: 2014 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

margin.en: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
margin.zh: 在出版行业其他领域深陷生存危机之际，科学出版商却持续公布其业务利润率接近40%。
margin.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

margin.en: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
margin.zh: 而被边缘化、失去重要性的词汇则是正义、公平、宽容、均衡和责任。
margin.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

minimum.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
minimum.zh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
minimum.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

minimum.en: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage.
minimum.zh: 美国顾客历来会给那些他们认为主要靠小费收入的人小费，比如收入低于最低工资的餐厅服务员。
minimum.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

mobile.en: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
mobile.zh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
mobile.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

mobile.en: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
mobile.zh: 雷德斯基通过让母子（女）二人组参与一项食物测试活动，研究了他们在进餐时间使用手机和平板电脑的情况。
mobile.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

mode.en: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.
mode.zh: 首先，大多数人没有意识到，一些强大的商业议程正在起作用，目的是让他们一直处于被动消费模式。
mode.src: 2012 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

mode.en: For all the possibilities of our new culture machines, most people are still stuck in download mode.
mode.zh: 尽管我们的新文化机器蕴藏着无限可能，但大多数人仍停留在下载模式。
mode.src: 2012 英语一 选句填空（7选5）

modest.en: From then on his sketches, which appeared under the pen name "Boz" in The Evening Chronicle, earned him a modest reputation.
modest.zh: 从那以后，他以“博兹”为笔名在《纪事晚报》上发表的速写为他赢得了小小的名气。

modest.en: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice.
modest.zh: 如果最高法院采纳加州的建议，那将是一种鲁莽的保守。
modest.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

monopoly.en: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
monopoly.zh: 关键问题在于，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业。
monopoly.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

monopoly.en: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
monopoly.zh: 因此，各学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

motivate.en: With so much research left to do, leaders in the field have been doing some soul-searching, and acknowledging that restoration can be motivated by — and designed to meet — different needs.
motivate.zh: 面对繁重的研究任务，该领域的领军人物一直在进行反思，并承认修复工作的动力和设计初衷可以源于不同的需求。
motivate.src: 2026 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

motivate.en: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
motivate.zh: 这种对个人成就感的新关注有助于在关于工作与生活平衡的争论日益激烈的情况下，保持员工的积极性。
motivate.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

nowadays.en: Nowadays, his reading material has changed from science fiction and reference books: recently, he revealed that he reads at least 50 nonfiction books a year.
nowadays.zh: 如今，他的阅读材料已不再是科幻小说和参考书：最近，他透露自己每年至少阅读50本非虚构类书籍。
nowadays.src: 2018 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

nowadays.en: Additional social stresses may also occur because of the population explosion or problems arising from mass migration movements—themselves made relatively easy nowadays by modern means of transport.
nowadays.zh: 此外，人口爆炸或大规模迁移所引发的问题也可能带来新的社会压力——而现代交通工具的发展使得大规模迁移变得相对容易。
nowadays.src: 2000 英语（未分卷） 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

occupy.en: As well as making access both in and out of buildings easier for people, the difference in the way many of these doors open helps reduce the total area occupied by them.
occupy.zh: 除了为人们进出建筑物提供便利外，这些门的多种开启方式还有助于减少其总体占地面积。
occupy.src: 2024 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

occupy.en: Just 25 per cent of the country's land is suitable for crop-growing, most of which is already occupied by arable fields.
occupy.zh: 该国仅有25%的土地适合农作物种植，其中大部分已被耕地占用。
occupy.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

organize.en: Yet researchers can take some comfort in the fact that there are a multitude of librarians devoted to discovering, organizing, and preserving digital information for researchers current and future.
organize.zh: 然而，研究人员可以稍感慰藉的是，有众多图书管理员致力于为当下及未来的研究人员发现、整理和保存数字信息。
organize.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

organize.en: Mies's signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot.
organize.zh: 密斯的标志性格言意味着，经过恰当布局的简约装饰比繁复装饰更具冲击力。
organize.src: 2011 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

outline.en: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
outline.zh: 为了帮助改进健康行动计划（HAPs），城市规划师拉贾什里·科萨尔卡尔的团队正在制定一个模型计划，其中概述了最佳实践，并可根据当地情况进行调整。
outline.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

outline.en: Your senior colleague outlines a project timeline you believe is unrealistic.
outline.zh: 你的资深同事制定了你认为不切实际的项目时间表。
outline.src: 2021 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

parallel.en: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
parallel.zh: 亚利桑那州曾试图制定与现行联邦政策并行的州级政策。
parallel.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

parallel.en: His reports paralleled the "Willie" cartoons of famed Stars and Stripes artist Bill Mauldin.
parallel.zh: 他的报道与《星条旗报》著名漫画家比尔·莫尔丁的'威利'系列漫画如出一辙。
parallel.src: 2012 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

participate.en: High school students participating in a popular activity should excel in it.
participate.zh: 参与热门活动的高中生应当在其中表现出色。
participate.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

participate.en: However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in.
participate.zh: 然而，大学招生专家表示，准大学生课外活动的质量比其参与的活动数量更为重要。
participate.src: 2024 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

passion.en: But if your work is your "passion," you'll be more likely to devote yourself to it, even if that means going home for dinner and then working long after the kids are in bed.
passion.zh: 但如果你的工作就是你的“激情所在”，你就更有可能全身心投入其中，即便这意味着回家吃过晚饭，还要在孩子们入睡后继续工作到深夜。
passion.src: 2015 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

passion.en: "It was a really bad move because that's not my passion," says Ning, whose dilemma about the job translated, predictably, into a lack of sales.
passion.zh: 宁说：“这真是个糟糕的决定，因为那不是我的热情所在。”可以预见，他对这份工作的纠结也体现在了销售业绩不佳上。
passion.src: 2010 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

peculiar.en: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals.
peculiar.zh: 奇怪的是，编辑理应效力的期刊根本没有从中获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用。
peculiar.src: 2023 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

peculiar.en: Each of these manifestations of growth carried its own peculiar problems in its wake.
peculiar.zh: 这种增长的每种表现形式都随之带来了其特有的问题。
peculiar.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

physician.en: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue".
physician.zh: 研究方法论的内科医生约翰·约安尼迪斯表示，这一政策是“向前迈出的非常受欢迎的一步”，而且“早就应该实施了”。
physician.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

physician.en: Physicians—frustrated by their inability to cure the disease and fearing loss of hope in the patient—too often offer aggressive treatment far beyond what is scientifically justified.
physician.zh: 医生们因无力治愈这种疾病而感到沮丧，又担心患者失去希望，常常采取超出科学依据的激进治疗方案。
physician.src: 2003 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

possess.en: His paternal grandparents, a steward and a housekeeper, possessed even less status, having been servants, and Dickens later concealed their background.
possess.zh: 他的祖父母是管家和佣人，曾做过仆役，社会地位更低，狄更斯后来隐瞒了他们的出身背景。

possess.en: For them, history did nothing, it possessed no immense wealth nor waged battles: "It is man, real, living man who does all that."
possess.zh: 在他们看来，历史本身无能为力，它既不占有巨大财富，也不发动战争：“是人类，是现实中活生生的人创造了这一切。”
possess.src: 2012 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

prejudice.en: But he's also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
prejudice.zh: 但他也发现了一种潜在的偏见。
prejudice.src: 2018 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

prejudice.en: Divorced persons may remarry, but a gender prejudice shows up: The divorced male doesn't have a waiting period before he can remarry while the woman must wait ten months.
prejudice.zh: 离婚人士可以再婚，但存在性别偏见：离婚男性可以立即再婚，无需等待期，而女性则必须等待十个月。
prejudice.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

privilege.en: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history – and sometimes the way they behave today – embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
privilege.zh: 尽管君主们声称自己是国家统一的象征，但他们的历史——有时还有他们如今的行事方式——却体现着过时且站不住脚的特权与不平等。
privilege.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

privilege.en: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
privilege.zh: 唯一的主要反对意见来自大法官安东宁·斯卡利亚，他对州特权提出了更为有力的辩护，其依据可追溯至《外侨与煽动叛乱法》。
privilege.src: 2013 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

productive.en: Provide more support for productive tree planting.
productive.zh: 加大对生产性植树的支持力度
productive.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

productive.en: The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
productive.zh: 英国当前局面的成因复杂多样，既包括对生产性林业的过时认知，也涉及灰松鼠对树木的大规模破坏。
productive.src: 2024 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

rarely.en: Although we try our best, sometimes our paintings rarely turn out as originally planned.
rarely.zh: 尽管我们竭尽全力，但有时画作很少能如最初设想的那样呈现出来。
rarely.src: 2022 英语二 英译汉（段落翻译）

rarely.en: And a survey conducted for BuzzFeed News found 44 percent of Facebook users rarely or never trust news from the media giant.
rarely.zh: 此外，为BuzzFeed新闻网开展的一项调查发现，44%的Facebook用户很少或从不信任这家媒体巨头发布的新闻。
rarely.src: 2018 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

realistic.en: Be optimistic but realistic, and you will stand out.
realistic.zh: 保持乐观但也要务实，这样你就能脱颖而出。
realistic.src: 2025 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

realistic.en: The goals of researchers ought to be realistic.
realistic.zh: 研究人员的目标应当切合实际。
realistic.src: 2025 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

relative.en: FaceTime with a relative as you strength train or stretch at home.
relative.zh: 在家进行力量训练或拉伸时，可以和亲戚进行FaceTime视频通话。
relative.src: 2022 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

relative.en: It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy.
relative.zh: 虽然说出来可能不太受欢迎，但他们薪酬大幅上涨的一个原因是，相较于美国经济中的许多其他劳动者，首席执行官们确实提升了自己的能力。
relative.src: 2020 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

resident.en: The residents help to look after the children, an arrangement akin to alloparenting.
resident.zh: 养老院的老人们帮忙照看孩子，这一安排类似于“异亲抚育”。
resident.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

resident.en: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature.
resident.zh: 国家公园为美国民众提供了巨大价值，既是休闲避难之所，也是自然的象征。
resident.src: 2023 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）
