resistance.en: The subtle and intelligent little book The Marketplace of Ideas: Reform and Resistance in the American University should be read by every student thinking of applying to take a doctoral degree.
resistance.zh: 《思想市场：美国大学的改革与抵制》这本精妙而睿智的小书，值得每一位考虑申请攻读博士学位的学生一读。

resistance.en: The upwash experience may save propelling energy as well as reducing resistance.
resistance.zh: 处于上升气流中的飞行体验既可以节省推进能量，也能减少阻力。
resistance.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

resolve.en: Perhaps museums and governments might explore some role for the use of nearly exact reproductions as a means of resolving issues relating to returning works of art and antiquities.
resolve.zh: 或许博物馆和政府可以探索利用近乎精确的复制品，将其作为解决艺术品和古物返还相关问题的一种途径。
resolve.src: 2024 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

resolve.en: They should also learn how to solve problems and resolve conflicts, ways to brainstorm and think critically.
resolve.zh: 他们还应该学会如何解决问题、化解冲突，以及如何集思广益和进行批判性思考。
resolve.src: 2007 英语（未分卷） 段落小标题（7选5）

ritual.en: School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual.
ritual.zh: 全美各地的学区，最近包括洛杉矶联合学区，都在重新审视这种教育惯例。
ritual.src: 2012 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

ritual.en: Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
ritual.zh: 润肤乳被宣传为晨间美容仪式的一部分，穿插在梳头和化妆之间。
ritual.src: 2010 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

ruin.en: It is believed that around 12,000 to 15,000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, although only about 3,000 are known to remain today, many of which are in ruins.
ruin.zh: 据信，丝绸之路沿线曾修建了约12,000至15,000座商队驿站，然而如今已知仅存约3,000座，其中许多已是断壁残垣。
ruin.src: 2023 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

ruin.en: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.
ruin.zh: 而过分强调他们的意见可能会毁掉一笔极好的购房交易。
ruin.src: 2019 英语二 多项对应（信息匹配）

salary.en: Today's tip requests are often not connected to the salary and service norms that used to determine when and how people tip.
salary.zh: 如今的小费请求往往与过去决定人们何时以及如何给小费的薪资和服务规范脱节。
salary.src: 2025 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）
2022 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

sample.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
sample.zh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
sample.src: 2025 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

sample.en: The same people were used in both samples.
sample.zh: 两组样本使用的是同一批研究对象。
sample.src: 2015 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

skilled.en: Later civilisations would value the skilled blacksmith's labour in a nail even more than the raw material.
skilled.zh: 后世文明更看重钉子中蕴含的铁匠精湛技艺，而非其原材料本身。
skilled.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

skilled.en: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
skilled.zh: 罗森伯格令人信服地指出，公共卫生倡导者应当向广告商学习，后者深谙如何运用同辈压力。
skilled.src: 2012 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

snap.en: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.
snap.zh: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释说，只有将这种快速反应建立在长期的"深度剖析"研究基础上，我们才能可靠地对信息进行快速"薄片式"解读。
snap.src: 2013 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

snap.en: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
snap.zh: 但是，对快速刺激做出的瞬时决策并不局限于人际交往领域。
snap.src: 2013 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

spouse.en: After a spouse has been selected, each family investigates the other to make sure its child is marrying into a good family.
spouse.zh: 选定配偶后，双方家庭会互相考察，以确保自己的孩子能嫁入或娶入一个好家庭。
spouse.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

spouse.en: In theory, a girl may veto the spouse her parents have chosen.
spouse.zh: 理论上，女孩可以否决父母为其选择的配偶。
spouse.src: 2016 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

statistical.en: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
statistical.zh: 细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应懂得如何分析数据，但已发表的研究中统计错误却多得出奇。
statistical.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

statistical.en: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
statistical.zh: 《科学》杂志与美国统计协会合作，已任命七位专家组成统计审稿编辑委员会（SBoRE）。
statistical.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

strain.en: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
strain.zh: 例如，高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政结构，尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。
strain.src: 2021 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

strain.en: In fact, instead of straining muscles to build them, as exercise does, laughter apparently accomplishes the opposite.
strain.zh: 事实上，运动通过拉伸肌肉来强健肌肉，而笑显然起到相反的作用。
strain.src: 2011 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

strive.en: Most of us strive for self-respect — to see ourselves in a positive light, to be proud of who we are.
strive.zh: 我们大多数人都在追求自尊——希望以积极的眼光看待自己，并为自己的身份感到自豪。
strive.src: 2026 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

strive.en: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
strive.zh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
strive.src: 2016 英语二 段落小标题（7选5）

sustain.en: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
sustain.zh: "文化之镇"不仅关乎艺术，还在于彰显小镇的独特魅力——助力维持商业街活力，支持本地设施建设，最重要的是颂扬当地民众。
sustain.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

sustain.en: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.
sustain.zh: 在他们各自的发现问世之前，当时的许多思想家一直秉持着更为古老的思维方式，其中包括地球是宇宙中心的地心说观点。
sustain.src: 2020 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

systematic.en: To find their sites, archaeologists today rely heavily on systematic survey methods and a variety of high-technology tools and techniques.
systematic.zh: 为了找到遗址，如今考古学家在很大程度上依赖系统的勘察方法以及各种高科技工具和技术。

systematic.en: Contrary to the descriptions on record, no systematic evidence was found that levels of productivity were related to changes in lighting.
systematic.zh: 与记录中的描述相反，没有发现系统性证据表明生产率水平与照明变化有关。
systematic.src: 2010 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

tackle.en: they have to tackle financial difficulties.
tackle.zh: 他们必须应对财务困难。
tackle.src: 2026 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

tackle.en: "There is a coalition growing within artist industries to figure out how to tackle or mitigate this," says Ortiz.
tackle.zh: 奥尔蒂斯表示：“艺术家行业内部正在形成一个联盟，以研究如何应对或缓解这一问题。”
tackle.src: 2024 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

transaction.en: It involves a very big business transaction.
transaction.zh: 这涉及一笔非常大的商业交易。
transaction.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

transaction.en: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
transaction.zh: 这项裁决引发了商业方法专利申请的激增，最初是新兴互联网公司试图为特定类型的在线交易争取独家权利。
transaction.src: 2010 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

triumph.src: 2020 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

triumph.en: In both oral and written English, talking is triumphing over speaking, spontaneity over craft.
triumph.zh: 无论是英语口语还是书面语，随意的闲聊正在取代正式的言说，即兴发挥也正在取代精雕细琢。
triumph.src: 2005 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）

uniform.en: Pick a standard work uniform or a few go-to options.
uniform.zh: 选择一套标准的工作制服或几款常用穿搭
uniform.src: 2016 英语一 段落小标题（7选5）

uniform.en: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
uniform.zh: 这是否意味着，对于那些身着华丽制服、过着尊贵生活的欧洲王室成员而言，他们的末日即将来临？
uniform.src: 2015 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

valley.en: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
valley.zh: 2015年，微软收购任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise时，选中的是两家在硅谷已引起不小轰动的新兴企业。
valley.src: 2021 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

valley.en: Humans overwhelmingly live in valleys, and on supplies of fresh water.
valley.zh: 绝大多数人类都居住在山谷中，依靠淡水为生。
valley.src: 2019 英语一 完形填空（四选一）

verbal.en: Like physical fights, verbal fights can leave both sides bloodied.
verbal.zh: 就像肢体冲突一样，言语争执也会让双方都伤痕累累。

verbal.en: She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children.
verbal.zh: 她发现，在实验过程中使用电子设备的母亲与孩子之间的语言交流减少了20%，非语言互动减少了39%。
verbal.src: 2017 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

violate.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
violate.zh: 谷歌还承诺不会部署其使用将违反国际法或人权的人工智能。
violate.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

violate.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
violate.zh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会“设计或部署”可能造成“全面伤害”的人工智能，也不会开发人工智能驱动的武器，或利用人工智能进行违反国际准则的监视活动。
violate.src: 2019 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

volume.en: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations, there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year.
volume.zh: 尽管加利福尼亚州流失了大量的影视制作业务到其他地区，但在今年之前，洛杉矶仍有大量的电影拍摄工作正在进行。
volume.src: 2026 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

volume.en: In volume V he had attached an appendix, The Scovell Ciphers.
volume.zh: 在第五卷中，他附上了一个名为《斯科维尔密码》的附录。
volume.src: 2022 英语一 英译汉（划线句子翻译）

wealthy.en: Some imagine that the coming work-free world will be defined by inequality: A few wealthy people will own all the capital, and the masses will struggle in an impoverished wasteland.
wealthy.zh: 一些人想象，即将到来的无工作世界将以不平等为特征：少数富人将拥有所有资本，而大众将在贫困的荒原上挣扎。
wealthy.src: 2017 英语二 完形填空（四选一）

wealthy.en: Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy.
wealthy.zh: 相反，官员必须避免双重标准，即不能给予普通民众和富人不同的接触机会。
wealthy.src: 2017 英语一 阅读理解（四选一）

worm.en: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
worm.zh: 拉里·布朗为总部位于丹佛的Nest Fresh Eggs公司供应鸡蛋，他表示：“我对我们的进展感到兴奋。”目前，他正在种植更多覆盖作物，以吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用。
worm.src: 2022 英语二 阅读理解（四选一）

worm.en: Dr. Myers and Dr. Worm argue that their work gives a correct baseline, which future management efforts must take into account.
worm.zh: 迈尔斯博士和沃尔姆博士认为，他们的研究提供了一个准确的基准，未来的管理工作必须将其纳入考量。
worm.src: 2006 英语（未分卷） 阅读理解（四选一）
